profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司联合生态伙伴发布《AI for Process——企业级流程数智化变革》蓝皮书，系统梳理了企业级 AI 落地的方法论与实践路径；同时持续深化“AI+行业”布局，面向医疗制药、运营商、互联网、汽车、快消、零售、政企、教育等重点行业，构建覆盖企业级 AI 场景的全栈能力体系与行业解决方案，形成了 100 多个客户场景模板，验证了 Agent 智能体中台工艺和方法体系，为产业数智化升级和企业竞争力重构提供可落地、可复制的新思路、新方法与新价值。报告期内，公司旗下品牌神州鲲泰依托鲲鹏与昇腾处理器，持续丰富产品形态，逐步构建起覆盖通用计算、AI 智算、边缘计算、桌面终端及解决方案一体机在内的完整产品矩阵，为金融、运营商、政府智算中心及互联网行业等重点客户提供稳定、高效的算力支撑。产业链跟踪重点为：旗下神州鲲泰提供通用服务器、AI训推服务器及一体机，参与国产算力交付。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company jointly released the "AI for Process - Digital Intelligent Transformation of Enterprise-level Processes" blue paper, which systematically sorted out the methodology and practical path for enterprise-level AI implementation; at the same time, it continued to deepen the "AI+ industry" layout, targeting key industries such as medical pharmaceuticals, operators, Internet, automobiles, FMCG, retail, government and enterprises, education, etc., and built a full-stack capability system and industry solutions covering enterprise-level AI scenarios, forming more than 100 customer scenario templates, verifying Agent The intelligent middle-end technology and method system provides implementable and replicable new ideas, new methods and new values for industrial digital intelligence upgrading and enterprise competitiveness reconstruction. During the reporting period, the company's brand Shenzhou Kuntai continued to enrich product forms relying on Kunpeng and Ascend processors, and gradually built a complete product matrix covering general computing, AI intelligent computing, edge computing, desktop terminals and solution all-in-one machines, providing stable and efficient computing power support for key customers such as finance, operators, government intelligent computing centers and the Internet industry. The focus of industry chain tracking is: its subsidiary Shenzhou Kuntai provides general servers, AI training servers and all-in-one machines, and participates in the delivery of domestic computing power.

profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, Huagong Technology Industry Co., Ltd. was established in the hinterland of "China Optics Valley" in 1999 and was born out of Huazhong University of Science and Technology, a well-known university in China. profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，主营业务公司是一家专业存储控制芯片及解决方案提供商，核心能力源于自主可控的存储主控芯片与固件方案研发，及其产业化应用的长期深耕。公司产品线涵盖固态硬盘类、嵌入式存储类、内存条类及移动存储类四大系列，已广泛应用于数据中心、手机、车载电子、PC、平板、安防监控等多元应用场景。公司持续推动研发创新，产品矩阵快速拓展，具体情况如下： 1.固态硬盘固态硬盘使用固态存储芯片阵列制成，它的出现满足了大容量存储应用场景需求，被广泛应用于 PC、数据中心、 人工智能、工控、安防、网络终端、医疗、航天、军工等诸多领域。在相关应用领域的固态硬盘产品矩阵构建上，公司形成了覆盖 SATA III、PCIe 等主流接口，以及 2.5 寸、mSATA、M.2 等多元形态的全场景产品布局，可适配工控机、服务器、嵌入式设备等多样化硬件平台，实现从 8GB 到 8TB 的全容量段覆盖，满足不同工业场景的存储容量需求。产业链跟踪重点为：专注闪存主控和存储模组，业务弹性与存储周期相关。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the main business company is a professional storage control chip and solution provider. Its core capabilities stem from the research and development of independent and controllable storage main control chips and firmware solutions, as well as its long-term development of industrial applications. The company's product lines cover four major series: solid-state drives, embedded storage, memory sticks and mobile storage, which have been widely used in diverse application scenarios such as data centers, mobile phones, vehicle electronics, PCs, tablets, and security monitoring. The company continues to promote R&D innovation and rapidly expands its product matrix. The details are as follows: 1. Solid-state drives are made of solid-state memory chip arrays. Its emergence meets the needs of large-capacity storage application scenarios and is widely used in PCs, data centers, artificial intelligence, industrial control, security, network terminals, medical care, aerospace, military industry and many other fields. Based on the solid-state drive product matrix construction in related application fields, the company has formed a full-scenario product layout covering mainstream interfaces such as SATA III and PCIe, as well as diverse forms such as 2.5-inch, mSATA, and M.2. It can be adapted to diverse hardware platforms such as industrial computers, servers, and embedded devices to achieve full capacity segment coverage from 8GB to 8TB to meet the storage capacity needs of different industrial scenarios. The focus of industry chain tracking is: focusing on flash memory controllers and storage modules, and business flexibility is related to storage cycles.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，主要产品及业务公司专业从事中高端光、电、流体连接技术与产品的研究与开发，专业为航空及防务和高端制造提供互连解决方案，自主研发各类连接产品 500 多个系列、35 万多个品种，主要产品包括光、电、流体连接器，光电子器件，线缆组件及集成化设备，广泛应用于防务、商业航空航天、通信网络、数据中心、石油装备、电力装备、工业装备、轨道交通、医疗设备、新能源汽车、消费电子等高端制造领域。在车载动力系统领域，公司片式高压大电流连接器采用超声波焊接技术，已实现铜铝导线与铜铝复合接触件的兼容，助力整车极致的轻量化；在充换电产品领域，积极布局大功率超充、轻量化的技术路线，基于液冷与 busbar 核心技术布局，成功实现产品减重、载流能力提升，大幅缩短整车充电时间，实现“油电同速”；在智能汽车领域，构建全场景一体化的解决方案，产品谱系覆盖了 L2 至 L3 及以上的高阶智能驾驶互连需求，并实现了智能座舱、车联网全场景互连方案的全覆盖。产业链跟踪重点为：连接器及互连组件厂商，数据中心配套覆盖高速、电源、光纤及液冷连接。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the main products and business companies specialize in the research and development of mid-to-high-end optical, electrical, and fluid connection technologies and products. They specialize in providing interconnection solutions for aviation, defense and high-end manufacturing, and independently develop more than 500 series and 35 types of various connection products. With more than 10,000 varieties, the main products include optical, electrical, and fluid connectors, optoelectronic devices, cable assemblies and integrated equipment, which are widely used in high-end manufacturing fields such as defense, commercial aerospace, communication networks, data centers, petroleum equipment, power equipment, industrial equipment, rail transportation, medical equipment, new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, etc. In the field of vehicle power systems, the company's chip-type high-voltage and high-current connectors use ultrasonic welding technology, which has achieved compatibility between copper-aluminum wires and copper-aluminum composite contacts, helping the vehicle to be extremely lightweight; in the field of charging and swapping products, the company has actively laid out high-power overcharging and lightweight technical routes, based on liquid cooling and busbar The core technology layout has successfully achieved product weight reduction, improved current-carrying capacity, greatly shortened the charging time of the entire vehicle, and achieved "oil and electricity at the same speed"; in the field of smart cars, it has built a full-scenario integrated solution. The product lineage covers high-end smart driving interconnection needs from L2 to L3 and above, and has achieved full coverage of smart cockpits and all-scenario interconnection solutions for the Internet of Vehicles. The focus of industry chain tracking is: connectors and interconnection component manufacturers, and data center supporting equipment covering high-speed, power supply, optical fiber and liquid cooling connections.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司产品包括光传输器件与组件，覆盖数据传输连接需求。
mappings.detailEn: The company's products include optical transmission devices and components, covering data transmission and connection needs.

mappings.sourceDetail: 连接器及互连组件厂商，数据中心配套覆盖高速、电源、光纤及液冷连接。
mappings.detailEn: Manufacturer of connectors and interconnect components, data center supporting equipment covers high-speed, power, optical fiber and liquid cooling connections.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司液冷散热系统产品服务数据中心等场景，已超出电连接器单一产品范围。
mappings.detailEn: The company's liquid cooling system products serve scenarios such as data centers, which have exceeded the scope of single products of electrical connectors.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，在人工智能领域，公司加大人工智能计算设备的研发力度，不断基于训推一体化、边缘平台构建、模型应用算法优化等提升计算产品性能与丰富产品矩阵，并拉通重点行业数字化技术与经验，打造了多款具备差异化优势的边、端侧智能硬件产品，构建全栈式智能计算产品体系；在开源鸿蒙领域，公司持续加码对开源鸿蒙行业发行版的研发投入，在多个领域打造基于开源鸿蒙的创新解决方案及软硬一体化设备。在考试领域，公司旗下海云天科技作为我国考试测评领域领军企业，长期致力于提供网上评卷、线下机考、在线机考、考试安全与考务管理标准等产品及服务，报告期内，海云天科技为全国 16 省（自治区）高考、21 省 150 多个地区中考、14 省全国硕士研究生统一招生考试提供智能评卷产品及技术服务，还新增为四川、陕西、河南、宁夏四省区新高考适应性考试提供网上评卷服务，并在人社、住建、工信、文旅、高校等领域实现突破，智能评卷与考试管理系统已服务六十余所高校。产业链跟踪重点为：国产算力整机与行业解决方案供应商，聚焦政企智算落地。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, in the field of artificial intelligence, the company has increased its research and development efforts in artificial intelligence computing equipment, continuously improving the performance of computing products and enriching its product matrix based on integration of training and promotion, construction of edge platforms, optimization of model application algorithms, etc., and integrating digital technologies and experiences in key industries. It has created a variety of edge and device-side intelligent hardware products with differentiated advantages, and built a full-stack intelligent computing product system; in the field of open source Hongmeng, the company continues to increase investment in the research and development of open source Hongmeng industry releases, and creates innovative solutions and integrated hardware and software devices based on open source Hongmeng in multiple fields. In the field of examinations, the company's subsidiary Haiyuntian Technology, as a leading enterprise in the field of examination and assessment in my country, has long been committed to providing products and services such as online marking, offline computer-based examinations, online computer-based examinations, examination security and examination management standards. During the reporting period, Haiyuntian Technology provided college entrance examinations in 16 provinces (autonomous regions), high school entrance examinations in more than 150 regions in 21 provinces, and high school entrance examinations in 14 provinces. The provincial unified entrance examination for master's students provides intelligent marking products and technical services. It also provides online marking services for the new college entrance examination adaptive examinations in the four provinces of Sichuan, Shaanxi, Henan, and Ningxia. It has achieved breakthroughs in the fields of human resources and social security, housing construction, industry and information technology, culture and tourism, and universities. The intelligent marking and examination management system has served more than 60 universities. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: domestic computing power complete machines and industry solution suppliers, focusing on the implementation of smart computing in government and enterprises.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国产算力整机与行业解决方案供应商，聚焦政企智算落地。
mappings.detailEn: Domestic computing power machine and industry solution provider, focusing on the implementation of smart computing in government and enterprises.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，主营业务、主要产品及用途公司主营业务为光电子器件、模块和子系统的的研发、生产及销售。产品主要应用于电信光传输和接入网络，以及数据中心网络，按产品应用领域可分为传输类产品、接入类产品和数据通信类产品。公司业绩实现稳步增长，主要得益于全球 AI 算力投资浪潮下数通光模块需求激增，叠加国内云服务厂商大幅加大数据中心建设投入，公司凭借领先的技术实力与综合服务能力，在国内头部客户群体中持续稳固主要供应商地位，中标份额始终保持领先。公司在全球光器件市场的稳健表现，不仅源于对市场趋势的精准把握，更得益于持续的技术创新与产品迭代：在数通光器件领域，紧跟 AI 算力需求爆发式增长趋势，成功研发并量产多款高速率、低功耗数通光模块，有效满足数据中心高密度、低延迟传输需求，赢得国内外客户广泛认可；在电信光器件市场，依托深厚技术积累，推出一系列符合行业标准且性能卓越的产品，进一步巩固市场地位；在接入光器件市场，通过持续优化产品成本结构与提升生产效率，稳固并保持全球市场的领先优势。产业链跟踪重点为：光芯片、器件与模块一体化厂商，国产化属性突出。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company’s main business, main products and uses are the research and development, production and sales of optoelectronic devices, modules and subsystems. The products are mainly used in telecommunications optical transmission and access networks, as well as data center networks. According to product application fields, they can be divided into transmission products, access products and data communication products. The company's performance has achieved steady growth, mainly due to the surge in demand for datacom optical modules amid the global wave of investment in AI computing power, coupled with domestic cloud service manufacturers' substantial increase in investment in data center construction. With its leading technical strength and comprehensive service capabilities, the company continues to consolidate its position as a major supplier among domestic leading customer groups, and has always maintained a leading share of winning bids. The company's steady performance in the global optical device market is not only due to its accurate grasp of market trends, but also benefits from continuous technological innovation and product iteration: in the field of data communication optical devices, closely following AI In response to the explosive growth in demand for computing power, we have successfully developed and mass-produced a number of high-speed, low-power digital communication optical modules, which effectively meet the high-density, low-latency transmission requirements of data centers, and have won wide recognition from domestic and foreign customers. In the telecommunications optical device market, relying on its profound technological accumulation, we have launched a series of products that meet industry standards and have excellent performance, further consolidating our market position. In the access optical device market, we have stabilized and maintained our leading position in the global market by continuously optimizing product cost structures and improving production efficiency. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: integrated manufacturers of optical chips, devices and modules, with outstanding localization attributes.

mappings.sourceDetail: 光芯片、器件与模块一体化厂商，国产化属性突出。
mappings.detailEn: An integrated manufacturer of optical chips, devices and modules with outstanding localization attributes.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2023年年度报告，公司从事的主要业务、主要产品及用途、所处市场地位公司业务覆盖工业自动化、网络能源、新能源汽车及光伏储能。主要产品包括变频器、伺服系统、电机、控制器、 人机界面、传感器、电梯驱动系统、工业互联网、电驱、车载电源、充电桩、数据中心系统、光伏及储能逆变系统等。公司致力于为客户提供差异化和专业化的行业解决方案、定制化技术服务、全球本土化运营以及数字化管理模式，以确保客户获得物超所值的产品和服务，增强其市场竞争力。在细分行业领域，公司不断深化并拓展各产品在印包、起重、木工、塑机、水泥、钢铁、石油、化工、煤炭、海工船舶等行业中的应用。公司网络能源产品已广泛应用于佛山、长沙、天津、成都、武汉、福州、台州等城市的轨道交通项目中。产业链跟踪重点为：网络能源产品覆盖UPS、配电及数据中心微模块，提供机房供电保障。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2023 annual report, the company's main businesses, main products and uses, and market position include industrial automation, network energy, new energy vehicles and photovoltaic energy storage. The main products include inverters, servo systems, motors, controllers, human-machine interfaces, sensors, elevator drive systems, industrial Internet, electric drives, vehicle power supplies, charging piles, data center systems, photovoltaic and energy storage inverter systems, etc. The company is committed to providing customers with differentiated and professional industry solutions, customized technical services, global localization operations and digital management models to ensure that customers receive value-for-money products and services and enhance their market competitiveness. In the field of subdivided industries, the company continues to deepen and expand the application of each product in industries such as printing and packaging, lifting, woodworking, plastic machinery, cement, steel, petroleum, chemical industry, coal, offshore engineering and shipbuilding. The company's network energy products have been widely used in rail transit projects in Foshan, Changsha, Tianjin, Chengdu, Wuhan, Fuzhou, Taizhou and other cities. The focus of industry chain tracking is: network energy products cover UPS, power distribution and data center micro-modules, providing power supply guarantee for computer rooms.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司网络能源产品包括精密温控及液冷解决方案，与UPS和微模块产品共同服务数据中心。
mappings.detailEn: The company's network energy products include precision temperature control and liquid cooling solutions, which together with UPS and micro module products serve data centers.

mappings.sourceDetail: 网络能源产品覆盖UPS、配电及数据中心微模块，提供机房供电保障。
mappings.detailEn: Network energy products cover UPS, power distribution and data center micro-modules, providing power supply guarantee for computer rooms.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，在智算中心领域，公司聚焦智算基础设施核心需求，深化全栈自主可控产品体系布局，构建 “多元异构算力平台”，打造从硬件产品到场景解决方案的完整服务链条，为互联网、AI、金融、政务等行业提供高效可靠的算力支撑；在智慧电能领域，公司依托高端电源核心技术与行业领先地位，持续拓展轨道交通、工业半导体、机场港口、国家级重大科技项目等应用场景，为交通、电子、石化、电力、通信、金融、医疗、教育等多个行业客户提供 “端到端”智能能源管理解决方案；在新能源领域，公司聚焦光伏与储能协同发展，以构网技术创新为引领，打造全场景光储产品矩阵，落地多项 GW 级、百 MW 级标杆项目，助力清洁能源规模化替代。公司紧扣市场需求与行业痛点，充分发挥技术研发、产品创新、生态协同及全链条交付优势，持续优化业务布局与运营效率，推动三大核心业务稳健发展，为客户创造持续价值。产业链跟踪重点为：UPS与数据中心能源龙头，覆盖供配电、储能和IDC。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, in the field of intelligent computing centers, the company focuses on the core needs of intelligent computing infrastructure, deepens the layout of the full-stack independent and controllable product system, and builds The "Multiple Heterogeneous Computing Power Platform" creates a complete service chain from hardware products to scenario solutions, providing efficient and reliable computing power support for industries such as the Internet, AI, finance, and government affairs. In the field of smart electric energy, the company relies on high-end power core technology and industry leadership to continue to expand application scenarios such as rail transit, industrial semiconductors, airports and ports, and major national science and technology projects, and provides customers in various industries such as transportation, electronics, petrochemicals, electricity, communications, finance, medical care, and education. "End-to-end" intelligent energy management solutions; in the field of new energy, the company focuses on the coordinated development of photovoltaics and energy storage, and takes the innovation of network construction technology as the guide to create a full-scenario optical storage product matrix and implement a number of GW-level and 100-MW-level benchmark projects to help the large-scale replacement of clean energy. The company closely follows market demand and industry pain points, gives full play to its advantages in technology research and development, product innovation, ecological synergy and full-chain delivery, continues to optimize business layout and operational efficiency, promotes the steady development of its three core businesses, and creates sustainable value for customers. The focus of industry chain tracking is: UPS and data center energy leaders, covering power supply and distribution, energy storage and IDC.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司液冷CDU、液冷微模块等产品与数据中心电源形成配套交付。
mappings.detailEn: The company's liquid-cooled CDU, liquid-cooled micro-module and other products are delivered in conjunction with the data center power supply.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司除电源设备外实际经营IDC服务，年报单独披露IDC服务收入。
mappings.detailEn: In addition to power equipment, the company actually operates IDC services, and its annual report separately discloses IDC service income.

mappings.sourceDetail: UPS与数据中心能源龙头，覆盖供配电、储能和IDC。
mappings.detailEn: UPS and data center energy leader, covering power supply and distribution, energy storage and IDC.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，报告期内公司从事的主要业务和经营模式未发生重大变化，主要业务和产品的基本情况如下： （一）电力电子制造板块 1、数据中心电源领域公司目前已构建涵盖 HVDC（240V/336V/800V）、 Panama（240V/400V/800V）、中低压配电、精密配电以及服务器 PSU 在内的完整产品矩阵，公司具备提供端到端电力解决方案的能力，深度适配通用计算、AI 与超算需求。公司与中国移动、中国铁塔等通信运营商长期保持密切合作，近年来在运营商集中采购招标中市场份额居于行业前列，还牵头实施了多项运营商基站供电方案创新项目，凭借专业、稳定、先进、高效的产品与细致的服务，获得了客户的广泛认可。主要产品包括： （1）模块化电源产品及解决方案模块化电源是一款高功率密度、高转换效率、多能源接入的智能化电源系统，采用智能化监控及器件，直流负载精细化管理，单系统体积小，可集成在户外一体柜或主设备安装架中，最大容量可达 600A。产业链跟踪重点为：HVDC与数据中心电源厂商，布局高压直流供电。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business and operating model did not undergo major changes during the reporting period. The basic information of the main businesses and products is as follows: (1) Power electronics manufacturing segment 1. In the field of data center power supply, the company has currently built a business covering HVDC (240V/336V/800V), Panama (240V/400V/800V), medium and low voltage power distribution, precision power distribution and server PSU With a complete product matrix, the company has the ability to provide end-to-end power solutions that are deeply adapted to general computing, AI and supercomputing needs. The company has maintained close cooperation with China Mobile, China Tower and other communication operators for a long time. In recent years, its market share has been at the forefront of the industry in operators' centralized procurement and tendering. It has also taken the lead in implementing a number of innovative projects for operators' base station power supply solutions. With its professional, stable, advanced and efficient products and meticulous services, the company has been widely recognized by customers. The main products include: (1) Modular power supply products and solutions The modular power supply is an intelligent power supply system with high power density, high conversion efficiency, and multi-energy access. It uses intelligent monitoring and devices, refined DC load management, and has a small single system size. It can be integrated in an outdoor integrated cabinet or main equipment installation rack, with a maximum capacity of up to 600A. The focus of industry chain tracking is: HVDC and data center power supply manufacturers, laying out high-voltage DC power supply.

mappings.sourceDetail: HVDC与数据中心电源厂商，布局高压直流供电。
mappings.detailEn: HVDC and data center power supply manufacturers lay out high-voltage DC power supply.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司专注于半导体基础产品的研发、生产、销售和技术服务，主要产品为电子工艺装备和电子元器件，电子工艺装备包括半导体装备、真空新能源装备；电子元器件包括电阻、电容、晶体器件、模块电源、微波组件等。公司始终坚持科技创新，不断推动产品迭代升级，积极拓展产品应用领域，以满足快速发展的市场需求。公司凭借产品技术领先、种类多样、工艺覆盖广泛等优势，以产品迭代升级和成套解决方案为客户创造更大价值。产业链跟踪重点为：国产半导体设备平台龙头，覆盖刻蚀、薄膜、清洗等环节。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company focuses on the research and development, production, sales and technical services of basic semiconductor products. Its main products are electronic process equipment and electronic components. Electronic process equipment includes semiconductor equipment and vacuum new energy equipment; electronic components include resistors, capacitors, crystal devices, module power supplies, microwave components, etc. The company has always adhered to technological innovation, constantly promoted product iteration and upgrading, and actively expanded product application areas to meet the rapidly developing market demand. Relying on its advantages of leading product technology, diverse categories, and extensive process coverage, the company creates greater value for customers with product iterative upgrades and complete sets of solutions. The focus of industry chain tracking is: domestic semiconductor equipment platform leader, covering etching, thin film, cleaning and other links.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国产半导体设备平台龙头，覆盖刻蚀、薄膜、清洗等环节。
mappings.detailEn: The leading domestic semiconductor equipment platform, covering etching, thin film, cleaning and other links.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司是一家专注于智能制造领域、具备全球化视野与布局的创新驱动型公司，以创造更互联互通的新世界为使命，以成为全球领先的智能互连方案解决商为愿景，致力于为全球顶尖科技公司提供先进产品与解决方案，最终实现人、设备以及基础设施之间的互联互通。公司主要从事电子电路、光模块（含光芯片）、精密组件、光电显示模组的全球设计、生产和销售，产品广泛应用于消费电子、汽车、数据中心、通信设备、工业控制设备等领域。公司主要产品及其用途情况如下： 产品类型产品特性介绍主要应用软板软板是一种 PCB，以聚醯亚胺或聚酯薄膜等柔性材料为基材，通过铜箔层实现电气互联。公司专注于智能互联互通领域基础核心器件，经过多年的发展，已形成丰富的产品矩阵，相关产品具有较广的行业应用性，且公司不同业务板块在研发、技术、供应链、产品和市场等方面具备较强的协同性，形成了多产品协同优势，有助于公司为客户提供全方位、一站式、技术领先的综合产品解决方案，最大程度满足客户定制化的需求。产业链跟踪重点为：国内PCB市场份额约7.5%，覆盖高端印制电路板与精密电子制造。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is an innovation-driven company that focuses on the field of intelligent manufacturing and has a global vision and layout. With the mission of creating a more interconnected new world and the vision of becoming the world's leading intelligent interconnect solution provider, the company is committed to providing advanced products and solutions to the world's top technology companies, and ultimately realizing the interconnection between people, equipment and infrastructure. The company is mainly engaged in the global design, production and sales of electronic circuits, optical modules (including optical chips), precision components, and optoelectronic display modules. The products are widely used in consumer electronics, automobiles, data centers, communication equipment, industrial control equipment and other fields. The company's main products and their uses are as follows: Product type Product characteristics Introduction Main applications Flexible board Flexible board is a kind of PCB, which uses flexible materials such as polyimide or polyester film as the base material, and realizes electrical interconnection through the copper foil layer. The company focuses on basic core devices in the field of intelligent interconnection. After years of development, it has formed a rich product matrix. Related products have wide industry applications. The company's different business sectors have strong synergy in R&D, technology, supply chain, products and markets, forming multi-product synergy advantages, which help the company provide customers with comprehensive, one-stop, technology-leading comprehensive product solutions to meet the customized needs of customers to the greatest extent. The focus of industry chain tracking is: the domestic PCB market share is approximately 7.5%, covering high-end printed circuit boards and precision electronic manufacturing.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司电子材料业务覆盖半导体前驱体材料、显示及半导体用光刻胶材料、电子级硅微粉等产品，并保留聚氨酯保温材料等传统业务。半导体前驱体用于高端存储芯片和逻辑芯片制程，光敏树脂及相关材料服务显示与半导体客户；公司通过自主研发和与芯片、显示客户协同验证推进产品产业化。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's electronic materials business covers semiconductor precursor materials, display and semiconductor photoresist materials, electronic grade silicon powder and other products, and retains traditional businesses such as polyurethane insulation materials. Semiconductor precursors are used in high-end memory chip and logic chip manufacturing processes, and photosensitive resins and related materials serve display and semiconductor customers; the company promotes product industrialization through independent research and development and collaborative verification with chip and display customers.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主营业务聚焦于“先进电子电路”和“数字化制造”两大战略方向，经过 32 年的持续深耕与发展，公司具备覆盖先进电子电路全类别产品的技术能力，基于 Tenting 减成法、Msap 改良半加成法和 SAP 半加成法工艺的持续精进，涵盖传统高多层 PCB 板、软硬结合板、高密度互连 HDI 板、类载板（SLP）、ATE 半导体测试板、封装基板（含 CSP 封装基板和 FCBGA 封装基板）等全类别产品，可为客户提供研发--设计--制造--SMT 贴装的一站式服务。在数字制造领域，公司依托于广州基地 P10 工厂的数字化转型经验，完成了标准化、自动化系统的开发与部署；在工厂数字化转型层面，由业务主导、数字化赋能，通过数据标准化和流程精益化将经验固化为规则、控制变异点，实现高效可靠的量产能力和领先的经营效率。产业链跟踪重点为：PCB及封装基板供应商，FCBGA产品覆盖服务器、AI芯片和交换芯片配套。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business focuses on the two strategic directions of "advanced electronic circuits" and "digital manufacturing". After 32 years of continuous cultivation and development, the company has the technical capabilities to cover all categories of advanced electronic circuit products. Based on the continuous improvement of Tenting subtractive method, Msap improved semi-additive method and SAP semi-additive method, it covers traditional high multi-layer PCB boards, rigid-flex boards, and high-density interconnection HDI. Boards, carrier boards (SLP), ATE semiconductor test boards, packaging substrates (including CSP packaging substrates and FCBGA packaging substrates) and other full categories of products, we can provide customers with one-stop services from R&D to design to manufacturing to SMT placement. In the field of digital manufacturing, the company relied on the digital transformation experience of the P10 factory in Guangzhou base to complete the development and deployment of standardized and automated systems. At the digital transformation level of the factory, it is business-led and digitally empowered. Through data standardization and process leanness, the company solidifies experience into rules and controls variation points, achieving efficient and reliable mass production capabilities and leading operating efficiency. The focus of industry chain tracking is: PCB and packaging substrate suppliers, FCBGA products cover servers, AI chips and switching chip accessories.

mappings.sourceDetail: PCB及封装基板供应商，FCBGA产品覆盖服务器、AI芯片和交换芯片配套。
mappings.detailEn: PCB and packaging substrate supplier, FCBGA products cover servers, AI chips and switching chip packages.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司自 1992 年成立以来，始终专注执行既定的“聚焦 PCB 主业、精益求精”的运营战略，经过多年的发展和长期积累，公司已经在技术、质量、成本、品牌、规模等方面形成相对竞争优势，居行业领先地位，是 PCB 行业内的重要品牌之一。公司连续多年入选中国印制电路行业协会（ CPCA）、行业研究机构 Prismark、 N.T.Information 等行业协会及研究机构发布的 PCB 百强企业。公司主要业务属于电子元器件行业中的 PCB 制造业。公司 PCB 产品以数据通讯、智能汽车为核心应用领域，辅以工业控制及其他应用领域，主要用于 AI 服务器及 HPC、高速网路交换机及路由器、通用服务器、汽车智能及电动化系统、汽车安全系统及工业设备。公司主要业务以及生产、采购、销售等主要经营模式近年来未发生重大变化，一直专注于各类 PCB 的生产、销售及相关售后服务。产业链跟踪重点为：企业通讯与高端服务器PCB核心供应商。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, since its establishment in 1992, the company has always focused on implementing the established operating strategy of "focusing on the main PCB business and striving for excellence." After years of development and long-term accumulation, the company has formed relative competitive advantages in terms of technology, quality, cost, brand, scale, etc., leading the industry, and is one of the important brands in the PCB industry. The company has been selected into the top 100 PCB companies released by China Printed Circuit Industry Association (CPCA), industry research institutions Prismark, N.T. Information and other industry associations and research institutions for many years in a row. The company's main business is PCB manufacturing in the electronic components industry. The company's PCB products take data communications and smart cars as the core application fields, supplemented by industrial control and other application fields. They are mainly used in AI servers and HPC, high-speed network switches and routers, general servers, automotive intelligence and electrification systems, automotive safety systems and industrial equipment. The company's main business and main business models such as production, procurement and sales have not undergone major changes in recent years. It has always focused on the production, sales and related after-sales services of various PCBs. The focus of industry chain tracking is: core suppliers of enterprise communications and high-end server PCBs.

mappings.sourceDetail: 企业通讯与高端服务器PCB核心供应商。
mappings.detailEn: Core supplier of enterprise communications and high-end server PCBs.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司“数据中心 + 新能源”双主业深度协同、高效运营，深度服务全球 AIDC 智算中心、新型数据中心及数字能源基础设施建设，为企业实现长期可持续的高质量发展筑牢坚实根基。公司主要业务情况具体如下： （一）主要产品及服务 1、数据中心关键基础设施产品公司作为最早进入数据中心产品领域的国内企业之一，凭借深厚的技术积累和持续的创新能力，已发展成为业内数据中心基础设施产品品类最齐全的公司之一。公司数据中心产品及一体化解决方案，能够充分满足用户在高效节能、快速部署、提升运维效率等方面的核心需求。公司现有光伏、储能产品包括：集中式光伏逆变器、组串式光伏逆变器、智能汇流箱、监控及家用逆变器、模块化储能变流器、集中式储能变流器、工商业储能系统、户用储能系统、逆变升压一体化集成系统、第二代储能系统能量管理及监控平台、调峰调频系统、大型集装箱式储能集成系统、光储充系统等；户用储能一体机方案集合了公司在电力电子、储能领域的优势，调试安装简单，降低系统成本，提供系统可靠性，解决海外安装服务成本高的痛点，并支持虚拟电站（VPP）模式，已取得美国、英国、德国、意大利、法国、荷兰、比利时、西班牙、澳大利亚、波兰、瑞典、奥地利、南非等目标市场国家的认证，更多目标区域国家产品认证将随需求完善。产业链跟踪重点为：UPS和数据中心基础设施供应商，具备电源与温控产品。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's dual main businesses of "data center + new energy" are deeply coordinated and operated efficiently, deeply serving the construction of global AIDC intelligent computing centers, new data centers and digital energy infrastructure, laying a solid foundation for the company to achieve long-term, sustainable and high-quality development. The company's main business details are as follows: (1) Main products and services 1. Data center critical infrastructure products. As one of the first domestic companies to enter the field of data center products, the company has developed into one of the companies with the most complete categories of data center infrastructure products in the industry by virtue of its profound technological accumulation and continuous innovation capabilities. The company's data center products and integrated solutions can fully meet users' core needs in terms of energy efficiency, rapid deployment, and improved operation and maintenance efficiency. The company's existing photovoltaic and energy storage products include: centralized photovoltaic inverters, string photovoltaic inverters, smart combiner boxes, monitoring and household inverters, modular energy storage converters, centralized energy storage converters, industrial and commercial energy storage systems, household energy storage systems, inverter and boost integrated integrated systems, second-generation energy storage system energy management and monitoring platforms, peak regulation and frequency modulation systems, large containerized energy storage integrated systems, optical storage and charging systems, etc.; household energy storage integrated machine solutions Combining the company's advantages in the fields of power electronics and energy storage, it is easy to debug and install, reduces system costs, provides system reliability, solves the pain point of high overseas installation service costs, and supports the virtual power plant (VPP) model. It has obtained certifications from target market countries such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, Italy, France, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Australia, Poland, Sweden, Austria, and South Africa. Product certifications in more target regions will be improved according to demand. The focus of industry chain tracking is: UPS and data center infrastructure suppliers, with power supply and temperature control products.

mappings.detailEn: Provider of UPS and data center infrastructure with power supply and temperature control products.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司从事的主要业务和产品公司专注于印制电路板的设计、研发、生产和销售，可满足各层级客户不同产品的交付需求。公司主要产品类型包括高多层板、HDI 板、高频高速板、厚铜板、背板、软硬结合板、埋容板、立体板、铝基板、FPC、IC 载板等，产品广泛应用于通信、服务器、手机、电脑、汽车、工业控制、医疗仪器、安防和航空航天等领域。公司的经营模式 1、销售模式为了对客户和订单进行有效管理，公司将销售部按照行业组进行管理：通讯组、工控/医疗/光电/安防/航空航天组、 汽车组、EMS 组、服务器组、手机组、贸易组、电脑组。公司以每个行业的战略客户为重心，将供应链、技术、制造、 品质等管理职能有效整合，以便快速高效响应客户需求。公司的主要原材料包括：覆铜板、半固化片、铜箔、氰化金钾、铜球、油墨等，原材料多根据订单的品种和数量进行采购。产业链跟踪重点为：PCB和封装基板厂商，服务器板、存储板和交换机板构成相关业务。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main businesses and products focus on the design, research and development, production and sales of printed circuit boards, which can meet the delivery needs of different products for customers at all levels. The company's main product types include high-multilayer boards, HDI boards, high-frequency high-speed boards, thick copper boards, backplanes, rigid-flex boards, embedded capacitive boards, three-dimensional boards, aluminum substrates, FPCs, IC carrier boards, etc. The products are widely used in communications, servers, mobile phones, computers, automobiles, industrial control, medical instruments, security and aerospace and other fields. The company's business model 1. Sales model In order to effectively manage customers and orders, the company manages the sales department according to industry groups: communications group, industrial control/medical/photoelectric/security/aerospace group, automotive group, EMS group, server group, mobile phone group, trade group, and computer group. The company focuses on strategic customers in each industry and effectively integrates management functions such as supply chain, technology, manufacturing, and quality to respond to customer needs quickly and efficiently. The company's main raw materials include: copper-clad laminates, prepregs, copper foil, potassium gold cyanide, copper balls, inks, etc. Raw materials are mostly purchased according to the variety and quantity of the order. The focus of industry chain tracking is: PCB and packaging substrate manufacturers, server boards, storage boards and switch boards constitute related businesses.

mappings.sourceDetail: PCB和封装基板厂商，服务器板、存储板和交换机板构成相关业务。
mappings.detailEn: PCB and packaging substrate manufacturers, server boards, storage boards and switch boards constitute related businesses.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，英维克是业内领先的精密温控节能解决方案和产品提供商，致力于为数据中心 /智算中心、算力设备 、电化学储能系统、通信网络、电力电网、电动汽车充电桩、工业自动化、电源转换等领域提供设备散热解决方案及精密环境控制解决方案，为地铁、多种电动商用车等领域提供相关车用的空调、冷机等产品及服务，并为人居健康空气环境推出系列的空气环境机等产品。公司的产品直接或通过系统集成商提供给数据中心业主、IDC 运营商、大型互联网公司、通信运营商，历年来公司已为字节跳动、腾讯、阿里巴巴、秦淮数据、万国数据、数据港、中国移动、中国电信等用户的大型数据中心提供了大量高效节能的制冷产品及系统。公司的该等产品主要为下游客户提供设备散热功能，根据采用的散热技术和设备散热需求的差异，可选用的产品包括：交流供电压缩机空调、直流供电压缩机空调、压缩机空调与热管一体机、热管换热器、水冷机组、激光器直冷系统、FlatCool 无人机机场空调等。产业链跟踪重点为：数据中心温控与液冷龙头，具备机房和机柜级整体方案。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, Invic is the industry's leading provider of precision temperature control energy-saving solutions and products. It is committed to providing equipment cooling solutions and precision environmental control solutions for data centers/intelligent computing centers, computing equipment, electrochemical energy storage systems, communication networks, power grids, electric vehicle charging piles, industrial automation, power conversion and other fields. It provides related vehicle air conditioners, chillers and other products and services for subways, various electric commercial vehicles and other fields, and launches a series of air environment machines and other products for healthy air environments for human settlements. The company's products are provided directly or through system integrators to data center owners, IDC operators, large Internet companies, and communication operators. Over the years, the company has provided a large number of high-efficiency and energy-saving refrigeration products and systems for large data centers such as ByteDance, Tencent, Alibaba, Chindata, GDS, Dataport, China Mobile, and China Telecom. The company's products mainly provide equipment cooling functions for downstream customers. Depending on the adopted cooling technology and equipment cooling requirements, available products include: AC powered compressor air conditioners, DC powered compressor air conditioners, compressor air conditioners and heat pipe integrated machines, heat pipe heat exchangers, water cooling units, laser direct cooling systems, FlatCool drone airport air conditioners, etc. The focus of industry chain tracking is: data center temperature control and liquid cooling faucets, with overall solutions at the computer room and cabinet level.

mappings.sourceDetail: 数据中心温控与液冷龙头，具备机房和机柜级整体方案。
mappings.detailEn: Data center temperature control and liquid cooling faucets provide machine room and cabinet-level overall solutions.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要业务和产品情况麦格米特是以电力电子及相关控制技术为基础的电气自动化公司，专注于电能的变换、自动化控制和应用。公司致力于成为全球一流的电气化产品与解决方案提供商，目前已成为电源产品、新能源及轨道交通部件、智能家电电控产品、工业自动化、智能装备、精密连接领域的国内知名供应商，产品广泛应用于通信、数据中心、医疗、可再生能源应用、新能源汽车、轨道交通、家用及商业显示、变频家电、智能卫浴、工业自动化、智能生产装备、精密连接组件等消费和工业的众多行业，并不断在电气自动化领域延伸，外延技术范围，布局产品品类，持续在新领域进行渗透和拓展。报告期内，公司从事的主要业务、主要产品及其用途未发生重大变化。公司电源产品已逐步覆盖工业、商业、消费等多领域众多一线龙头客户，或将成为公司未来销售收入规模增长主力。产业链跟踪重点为：电力电子平台厂商，布局高功率服务器电源。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business and products are Megmeet, an electrical automation company based on power electronics and related control technology, focusing on the conversion, automation control and application of electrical energy. The company is committed to becoming a world-class provider of electrification products and solutions. Currently, it has become a well-known domestic supplier in the fields of power products, new energy and rail transit components, smart home appliances and electronic control products, industrial automation, smart equipment, and precision connections. Its products are widely used in communications, data centers, medical care, and renewable energy. Applications, new energy vehicles, rail transit, household and commercial displays, frequency conversion home appliances, smart bathrooms, industrial automation, intelligent production equipment, precision connection components and many other consumer and industrial industries, and continue to extend in the field of electrical automation, extend the scope of technology, layout product categories, continue to penetrate and expand in new areas. During the reporting period, there were no significant changes in the company's main business, main products and their uses. The company's power products have gradually covered many first-line leading customers in industrial, commercial, consumer and other fields, and may become the main force for the company's future sales revenue growth. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: power electronics platform manufacturers, laying out high-power server power supplies.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司业务覆盖 1 级到 3 级封装产业链环节，具备提供“样品→中小批量→大批量”的综合制造能力 ，通过开展方案设计 、制造、电子装联、微组装和测试等全价值链服务，能够为客户提供专业高效的“产品+服务”一站式综合解决方案。公司生产的封装基板产品覆盖种类广泛多样，包括模组类封装基板、存储类封装基板、应用处理器芯片封装基板等，主要应用于移动智能终端、服务器/存储等领域。公司目前已形成具有自主知识产权的封装基板生产技术和工艺，建立了适应集成电路领域的运营体系，具备了包括 WB、FC 封装形式全覆盖的封装基板技术能力，覆盖了包括半导体垂直整合制造商、半导体设计商以及封测厂商等主要客户群，并与多家全球领先厂商建立了长期稳定的合作关系，在部分细分市场上拥有领先的竞争优势。目前公司已具备为客户提供包括产品设计、开发、生产、装配 、系统技术支持等全方位服务的能力。产业链跟踪重点为：PCB、封装基板和电子装联一体化龙头。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's business covers the level 1 to level 3 packaging industry chain, and has the comprehensive manufacturing capability to provide "samples → small and medium batches → large batches". By carrying out full value chain services such as solution design, manufacturing, electronic assembly, micro assembly and testing, it can provide customers with professional and efficient "product + service" one-stop comprehensive solutions. The company's packaging substrate products cover a wide range of categories, including module packaging substrates, storage packaging substrates, application processor chip packaging substrates, etc., which are mainly used in mobile smart terminals, servers/storage and other fields. The company has now formed packaging substrate production technology and processes with independent intellectual property rights, established an operating system adapted to the integrated circuit field, and has packaging substrate technology capabilities that include full coverage of WB and FC packaging forms. It covers major customer groups including semiconductor vertically integrated manufacturers, semiconductor designers, and packaging and testing manufacturers. It has established long-term and stable cooperative relationships with a number of global leading manufacturers, and has leading competitive advantages in some market segments. At present, the company has the ability to provide customers with a full range of services including product design, development, production, assembly, and system technical support. The focus of industry chain tracking is: PCB, packaging substrate and electronic assembly integrated leader.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，主要产品及其用途公司是全球化的电力设备及解决方案供应商，专注于新能源、数据中心、配电、工业控制及照明等领域，主要提供变压设备产品及相关集成解决方案。公司的数字化工厂确保变压器产品的高度一致性，并为技术迭代及性能优化提供坚实基础。公司数据中心供电系统能够提升整体运行效率、降低能源损耗，并有效减少配电过程中的切换干扰，为数据中心提供稳定、高效的 800V 直流供电解决方案。三相变压器单相变压器工业控制产品工业控制变压器主要包括环形变压器、方形变压器、开关电源等产品，主要应用于节能环保型设备，以及医疗、安防等应用场景。通讯电源产品专为通信网络基础设施设计，不仅提供稳定的电能转换与可靠的保护功能，更致力于保障电信设备在复杂多变的运行环境中不间断稳定工作。产业链跟踪重点为：磁性器件和电源厂商，数据中心配套包括移相、干式及油浸式变压器。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main products and uses are global power equipment and solutions suppliers, focusing on new energy, data centers, power distribution, industrial control and lighting and other fields. It mainly provides transformer equipment products and related integrated solutions. The company's digital factory ensures a high degree of consistency in transformer products and provides a solid foundation for technology iteration and performance optimization. The company's data center power supply system can improve overall operating efficiency, reduce energy loss, and effectively reduce switching interference during power distribution, providing a stable and efficient 800V DC power supply solution for the data center. Three-phase transformers, single-phase transformers, industrial control products, industrial control transformers mainly include toroidal transformers, square transformers, switching power supplies and other products, which are mainly used in energy-saving and environmentally friendly equipment, as well as in medical, security and other application scenarios. Communication power supply products are specially designed for communication network infrastructure. They not only provide stable power conversion and reliable protection functions, but are also committed to ensuring the uninterrupted and stable operation of telecommunications equipment in complex and changeable operating environments. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: magnetic device and power supply manufacturers, and data center supporting equipment including phase-shifting, dry-type and oil-immersed transformers.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，润建股份智能算力中心是智能时代面向社会全域多主体的新型公共基础设施，定位于“立足广西，面向全国，辐射东盟”，建成后主要提供 AI 大模型训练、推理算力、图形渲染算力服务，服务于人工智能大模型、行业模型等，赋能千行百业。公司可为客户提供一体化的 AI 模型及数据服务，包括数据治理、训练、调优、算法工具箱等，助力行业模型应用落地。3、平台服务 “曲尺”平台提供多模态行业模型开发服务，赋能行业模型落地。4.3 能源网络业务润建股份依托电力行业的技术底蕴和积累，顺应能源变革的大潮流，将传统自动化技术及 5G、AI、物联网、大数据、云计算等现代新技术融合，全面布局能源网络，打造“发电-输电-配电-储能-用电-云服务”全流程、全专业的技术服务能力，为客户提供能源设计、能源基建、能源运维、能源安全与能效提升、能源增值服务一体化能源网络管维解决方案，助力新型电力系统的构建与“双碳”目标的实现。产业链跟踪重点为：运营五象云谷等算力资源，提供智算云及算力网络服务。

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要业务、产品及其用途介绍公司是主要从事各类印制电路板的研发、设计、制造、销售与服务为一体的专业大型厂商，专注于为行业领先客户提供全方位PCB产品及服务，根据下游不同终端产品对于PCB的定制化要求，为客户提供涵盖PCB产品研发、设计、制造与销售服务各个环节的整体解决方案。公司生产的印制电路板广泛应用于通讯电子产业的多类终端产品上，并以智能手机领域为主，满足了移动通信技术发展过程中对高传输速率、高可靠性、低延时性的持续要求。公司生产的通讯用板包括柔性印制电路板、刚性印制电路板、高密度连接板、类载板（SLP）等多类产品，服务的客户包括了国内外领先电子品牌客户。公司产品地位与竞争优势公司为全球范围内少数同时具备各类PCB产品研发、设计、制造、销售与服务的专业大型厂商，拥有优质多样的PCB产品线，主要产品范围涵盖FPC、SMA、SLP、HDI、RPCB、Rigid Flex等多类产品，并广泛应用于通讯电子产品、消费电子及计算机类产品以及汽车和AI服务器、光模块、高速计算机等产品，具备为不同客户提供全方位PCB电子互联产品及服务的强大实力，打造了全方位的PCB产品一站式服务平台。产业链跟踪重点为：国内PCB市场份额约12.4%，为行业份额领先企业。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business, products and uses are introduced. The company is a large-scale professional manufacturer mainly engaged in the research and development, design, manufacturing, sales and service of various types of printed circuit boards. It focuses on providing a full range of PCB products and services to industry-leading customers. According to the customized requirements for PCBs of different downstream end products, it provides customers with overall solutions covering all aspects of PCB product research and development, design, manufacturing and sales services. The printed circuit boards produced by the company are widely used in various types of terminal products in the communication electronics industry, mainly in the field of smartphones, meeting the continuous requirements for high transmission rate, high reliability and low latency in the development of mobile communication technology. The communication boards produced by the company include flexible printed circuit boards, rigid printed circuit boards, high-density connection boards, carrier-like boards (SLP) and other products. The customers it serves include leading domestic and foreign electronics brand customers. Company product status and competitive advantages The company is one of the few large-scale professional manufacturers in the world that is capable of R&D, design, manufacturing, sales and service of all types of PCB products. It has high-quality and diverse PCB product lines, with its main product range covering FPC, SMA, SLP, HDI, RPCB, Rigid Flex and other products are widely used in communication electronics, consumer electronics and computer products, as well as automotive and AI servers, optical modules, high-speed computers and other products. It has the strong strength to provide a full range of PCB electronic interconnection products and services to different customers, creating a comprehensive one-stop service platform for PCB products. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: the domestic PCB market share is approximately 12.4%, making it the leading enterprise in the industry share.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司从事的主要业务网宿科技成立于 2000 年 1 月，致力于成为全球领先的边缘智能及安全服务提供商。公司的主要产品 （1）内容分发（CDN） 依靠公司部署在全球范围的边缘节点，通过负载均衡、内容缓存、访问调度等功能模块，避开网络拥塞，使互联网用户就近获取所需内容，提高访问命中率和响应速度。公司建有成熟的全球化运营平台，7*24 小时服务保障，成功为 G20 峰会、金砖会议、上合峰会、奥运会、春晚、世界杯、电商购物节等多项重大活动保驾护航。算力云：公司子公司爱捷云依托规模化的智能算力资源、自研领先的全局算力调度平台和丰富的平台运营等核心能力，面向 AI、游戏、测绘、基因测序、渲染及工业仿真等场景，提供一站式、海量、稳定、灵活的算力及存力服务，助力客户业务及应用创新。产业链跟踪重点为：以分布式网络节点提供CDN和边缘计算服务，补充云边协同基础设施。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business, Wangsu Technology, was established in January 2000 and is committed to becoming the world's leading edge intelligence and security service provider. The company's main products (1) Content distribution (CDN) relies on the company's global edge nodes deployed to avoid network congestion through load balancing, content caching, access scheduling and other functional modules, allowing Internet users to obtain the required content nearby, improving access hit rate and response speed. The company has established a mature global operation platform with 7*24-hour service guarantee, and has successfully escorted many major events such as the G20 Summit, BRICS Meeting, SCO Summit, Olympic Games, Spring Festival Gala, World Cup, and E-commerce Shopping Festival. Computing Power Cloud: The company's subsidiary Aijie Cloud relies on core capabilities such as large-scale intelligent computing resources, a self-developed leading global computing power scheduling platform and rich platform operations to provide one-stop, massive, stable and flexible computing power and storage services for scenarios such as AI, games, surveying and mapping, gene sequencing, rendering and industrial simulation to help customers innovate their business and applications. The focus of industry chain tracking is: providing CDN and edge computing services with distributed network nodes to supplement cloud-edge collaboration infrastructure.

mappings.sourceDetail: 除CDN与边缘云外，公司年报仍披露IDC托管及相关互联网数据中心服务。
mappings.detailEn: In addition to CDN and edge cloud, the company's annual report still discloses IDC hosting and related Internet data center services.

mappings.sourceDetail: 以分布式网络节点提供CDN和边缘计算服务，补充云边协同基础设施。

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司致力于为下游晶圆制造企业提供一站式 CMP 核心材料与整体解决方案，持续强化 CMP 环节的系统化产品供给能力、专业技术服务能力与综合方案解决能力，已成为国内首家、亦是唯一一家覆盖集成电路 CMP 全品类材料的综合解决方案供应商。公司自2022年5月布局高端晶圆光刻胶业务，截至报告期，已实现从产品研发、小中试线建设、订单获取，到建成国内首条“有机合成-高分子合成-精制纯化-光刻胶混配”全流程的高端晶圆光刻胶量产线，并完成产品稳定批量供应，成为国内该领域推进速度最快、技术水平对标国际一流、ArF和KrF光刻胶产品在国内实现“全制程”与“全尺寸”覆盖的高端晶圆光刻胶企业。公司子公司旗捷科技是一家集研发、生产与销售为一体的具有专业集成电路设计与应用能力的企业，深耕打印复印耗材芯片细分领域 18 年，拥有自主独立知识产权产品，国内领先的公司自有芯片分析实验室，是国家高新技术企业，纳入国家发改委重点布局软件企业，是国家级专精特新小巨人企业。产业链跟踪重点为：2025年国内CMP抛光垫国产供应份额38.5%，CMP材料整体份额16.8%。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is committed to providing one-stop CMP core materials and overall solutions for downstream wafer manufacturing companies, and continues to strengthen the systematic product supply capabilities, professional technical service capabilities and comprehensive solution capabilities in the CMP link. It has become the first and only comprehensive solution provider in China covering all categories of integrated circuit CMP materials. The company has laid out the high-end wafer photoresist business in May 2022. As of the reporting period, it has completed the entire process from product research and development, small and medium-sized test line construction, order acquisition, to the completion of the country's first high-end wafer photoresist business with "organic synthesis-polymer synthesis-refining and purification-photoresist mixing". It has established a circular photoresist mass production line and completed stable batch supply of products. It has become a high-end wafer photoresist enterprise with the fastest advancement in this field in China, its technical level is in line with the world's first-class, and its ArF and KrF photoresist products have achieved "full process" and "full size" coverage in the country. The company's subsidiary Qijie Technology is an enterprise with professional integrated circuit design and application capabilities integrating R&D, production and sales. It has been deeply involved in the chip segment of printing and copying consumables for 18 years. It has independent intellectual property products and is the leading domestic company-owned chip analysis laboratory. It is a national high-tech enterprise, included in the National Development and Reform Commission's key layout software enterprises, and is a national-level specialized special new small giant enterprise. The focus of industry chain tracking is: in 2025, the domestic supply share of domestic CMP polishing pads will be 38.5%, and the overall share of CMP materials will be 16.8%.

mappings.sourceDetail: 2025年国内CMP抛光垫国产供应份额38.5%，CMP材料整体份额16.8%。
mappings.detailEn: In 2025, the domestic supply share of domestic CMP polishing pads will be 38.5%, and the overall share of CMP materials will be 16.8%.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要产品线为存储芯片、计算芯片和模拟与互联芯片，其中存储芯片主要面向汽车、工业等领域，随着 2025 年汽车、工业等行业市场逐渐复苏，销售收入同比实现了增长，其中在存储大周期的推动下，公司 2025 年第四季度存储芯片开始呈现出更强的需求趋势。公司存储芯片和模拟与互联芯片主要面向汽车电子、工业制造、医疗设备、通信设备等行业市场，从技术和产品性能的要求上，车规级和工业级芯片对产品的可靠性、一致性、外部环境兼容性等方面的要求均比消费级芯片更为严格。公司在产品温度适应性、 品质控制等方面形成了一套严格的研发和测试流程，能够充分满足上述市场的要求。公司计算芯片主要面向智能安防、泛视觉和智能物联网等市场，在这些市场中，AI 已得到越来越多的普及，从应用上，云端的部分算法和应用逐渐向端侧迁移，终端产品算力需求不断提高；同时，信息处理需求的增加也要求芯片运算能力不断提高。产业链跟踪重点为：车规存储与计算芯片平台，拥有完整存储产品组合。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main product lines are memory chips, computing chips, and simulation and interconnection chips. Among them, memory chips are mainly targeted at automotive, industrial and other fields. As the automotive, industrial and other industry markets gradually recover in 2025, sales revenue has increased year-on-year. Driven by the storage cycle, the company's memory chips began to show a stronger demand trend in the fourth quarter of 2025. The company's memory chips and analog and interconnect chips are mainly targeted at automotive electronics, industrial manufacturing, medical equipment, communication equipment and other industry markets. In terms of technical and product performance requirements, automotive grade and industrial grade chips have stricter requirements for product reliability, consistency, external environment compatibility and other aspects than consumer grade chips. The company has formed a set of strict R&D and testing processes in terms of product temperature adaptability and quality control, which can fully meet the requirements of the above-mentioned markets. The company's computing chips are mainly targeted at markets such as smart security, pan-vision, and smart Internet of Things. In these markets, AI has become more and more popular. In terms of applications, some algorithms and applications in the cloud have gradually migrated to the end side, and the demand for computing power of terminal products continues to increase. At the same time, the increase in information processing needs also requires continuous improvement in chip computing capabilities. The focus of industry chain tracking is: automotive-grade storage and computing chip platforms, with a complete storage product portfolio.

mappings.sourceDetail: 除存储芯片外，公司销售微处理器及智能视频处理芯片；T33等产品面向端侧智能视觉，具备计算处理业务。
mappings.detailEn: In addition to memory chips, the company sells microprocessors and intelligent video processing chips; T33 and other products are oriented to end-side intelligent vision and have computing processing business.

mappings.sourceDetail: 车规存储与计算芯片平台，拥有完整存储产品组合。
mappings.detailEn: Automotive-grade storage and computing chip platform with a complete storage product portfolio.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司业务及产品公司始终坚持自主研发，持续进行技术创新，经过二十多年发展，主要形成两大类业务，一类为集成电路制造及先进封装用关键工艺材料及配套设备的研发、生产、销售和服务，并为客户提供整体化解决方案。主要产品包括： （1）晶圆制造及先进封装用电镀液及添加剂系列产品晶圆制造及先进封装用电镀液和添加剂系列产品为公司面向芯片制造领域开发的第二代电子电镀产品。（7）配套设备产品配套设备产品包括半导体封装引线脚表面处理配套电镀、清洗设备和先进封装制程用电镀、清洗设备。产业链跟踪重点为：提供晶圆制造及先进封装用电镀、清洗等电子化学材料。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's business and products have always adhered to independent research and development and continued technological innovation. After more than 20 years of development, it has mainly formed two major categories of business. One is the research and development, production, sales and service of key process materials and supporting equipment for integrated circuit manufacturing and advanced packaging, and provides customers with integrated solutions. The main products include: (1) Electroplating solutions and additive series products for wafer manufacturing and advanced packaging. Electroplating solutions and additive products for wafer manufacturing and advanced packaging are the second generation electronic plating products developed by the company for the chip manufacturing field. profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，目前已经实现晶圆制造所需的硅前驱体/金属前驱体、高 K 前驱体/低 K 前驱体等主要品类的全覆盖，成功导入国内领先的芯片制造企业量产制程，成为国内主要的核心前驱体材料供应商之一。公司于 2013 年承担国家 02 专项“高纯特种电子气体研发与产业化项目”，仅用 3 年时间就成功实现了高纯砷烷、磷烷的产业化，为我国极大规模集成电路制造提供了核心电子原材料。公司积极布局新产品，新一代安全源、同位素产品、磷烷混气等广泛应用于芯片制造和新能源应用领域，为业绩持续增厚奠定基础。公司氟类气体产品主要包括三氟化氮、六氟化硫等，其中三氟化氮广泛用于大规模集成电路、平板显示、 太阳能薄膜的生产制造，六氟化硫广泛应用于输配电及控制设备行业，高纯六氟化硫可用于半导体材料的干法刻蚀清洗。产业链跟踪重点为：电子特气、光刻胶与前驱体材料供应商。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, it has now achieved full coverage of major categories such as silicon precursors/metal precursors, high-K precursors/low-K precursors required for wafer manufacturing, and has successfully introduced the mass production process of leading domestic chip manufacturing companies, becoming one of the major domestic suppliers of core precursor materials. In 2013, the company undertook the national 02 special "High-purity Special Electronic Gas R&D and Industrialization Project" and successfully realized the industrialization of high-purity arsane and phosphine in just 3 years, providing core electronic raw materials for my country's extremely large-scale integrated circuit manufacturing. The company is actively deploying new products. New generation safety sources, isotope products, phosphane gas mixtures, etc. are widely used in chip manufacturing and new energy applications, laying the foundation for continued growth in performance. The company's fluorine gas products mainly include nitrogen trifluoride, sulfur hexafluoride, etc. Among them, nitrogen trifluoride is widely used in the production and manufacturing of large-scale integrated circuits, flat panel displays, and solar thin films. Sulfur hexafluoride is widely used in the power transmission and distribution and control equipment industries. High-purity sulfur hexafluoride can be used for dry etching and cleaning of semiconductor materials. The focus of industry chain tracking is: electronic specialty gas, photoresist and precursor material suppliers.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，报告期内，公司继续稳步发展互联网数据中心业务（ IDC 及其增值服务）和云计算业务，主营业务未发生重大变化。报告期内，公司持续完善全国数据中心布局，推进高等级绿色数据中心建设与绿色节能和智能运维技术应用，以优质数据中心资源及领先运维服务，为用户提供优质、稳定、高效的数据中心全周期定制化服务。公司凭借成熟的金融数据中心运维管理体系和丰富的运维服务经验，规划将科信盛彩云计算中心打造成为金融智算第二基地，与中金云网数据中心联手服务北京高端金融市场，利用科信云计算中心与中金云网云计算中心的区位优势，打造北京亦庄地区金融数据中心集群，为具有高等级数据中心服务需求的企业提供金融级数字基础设施综合解决方案。公司通过自主研发的“爱智维”数据中心运营平台，推动数据中心的运营自动化、改进资源管理以及提高能源使用效率，提供洞察、改善工作负载管理和容量规划等运营决策，为客户提供平台化、数字化、智能化的高标准高质量整体数据中心运维管理服务和代维服务。产业链跟踪重点为：第三方IDC与云计算服务商，拥有京津冀等地资源。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, during the reporting period, the company continued to steadily develop its Internet data center business (IDC and its value-added services) and cloud computing business, and there were no major changes in its main business. During the reporting period, the company continued to improve the nationwide data center layout, promote the construction of high-level green data centers and the application of green energy-saving and intelligent operation and maintenance technologies, and provide users with high-quality, stable and efficient full-cycle data center customized services with high-quality data center resources and leading operation and maintenance services. Relying on its mature financial data center operation and maintenance management system and rich operation and maintenance service experience, the company plans to build the Kexin Shengcai Cloud Computing Center into the second base for financial intelligent computing. Through the independently developed "Aizhiwei" data center operation platform, the company promotes data center operation automation, improves resource management and energy efficiency, provides insights, improves operational decisions such as workload management and capacity planning, and provides customers with platform-based, digital and intelligent high-standard and high-quality overall data center operation and maintenance management services and agency maintenance services. The focus of industry chain tracking is: third-party IDC and cloud computing service providers, which have resources in Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei and other places.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司以研发创新为驱动，依托高复用的技术平台与深度的产业链垂直整合能力，提供从无源器件、有源器件到集成共研的一站式光互连解决方案。主要产品及应用公司立足光互连领域，为下游客户提供垂直整合一站式解决方案，包括多通道高速光引擎封装集成解决方案、高密度光互连集成解决方案、精密微光学组件解决方案等，同时得益于公司技术平台的高复用性，公司拓展了激光雷达、生物光子等新兴应用场景。公司积极推进国际化战略，形成双总部、双生产基地、多地研发中心的产业布局：在苏州和新加坡分别设立海内外总部；在苏州、深圳、日本设立研发中心；在江西和泰国建立量产基地，为客户提供多元化选择和本地化技术支持与服务。公司基于光互连产业持续多年打造形成的多材料、多工艺、多技术路线能力平台，在光互连产业外，持续探索与光器件核心能力高度相关的跨领域协同发展，发掘公司新业务增长点，抓住科技快速迭代升级过程中形成的市场机遇，促进公司长期均衡可持续发展。产业链跟踪重点为：光器件平台型公司，为高速光模块提供关键精密器件。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is driven by R&D innovation and relies on its highly reusable technology platform and deep industry chain vertical integration capabilities to provide one-stop optical interconnect solutions from passive devices, active devices to integrated research. Main Products and Applications The company is based in the field of optical interconnection and provides vertically integrated one-stop solutions for downstream customers, including multi-channel high-speed optical engine packaging integration solutions, high-density optical interconnection integration solutions, precision micro-optical component solutions, etc. At the same time, thanks to the high reusability of the company's technology platform, the company has expanded emerging application scenarios such as lidar and biophotons. The company actively promotes its internationalization strategy and has formed an industrial layout with dual headquarters, dual production bases, and multiple R&D centers: it has established domestic and overseas headquarters in Suzhou and Singapore; R&D centers in Suzhou, Shenzhen, and Japan; and mass production bases in Jiangxi and Thailand to provide customers with diversified choices and localized technical support and services. Based on the multi-material, multi-process, and multi-technological route capability platform that the company has built over the years in the optical interconnection industry, in addition to the optical interconnection industry, the company continues to explore cross-field collaborative development that is highly related to the core capabilities of optical devices, explores the company's new business growth points, seizes market opportunities formed in the process of rapid iterative and upgrading of technology, and promotes the company's long-term balanced and sustainable development. The focus of industry chain tracking is: optical device platform companies, which provide key precision components for high-speed optical modules.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司成立十七年来始终以“构筑中国信息化产业长城，夯实中国数字经济发展基石底座”为愿景，以“稳定、安全、可靠、绿色”为运营发展目标，坚持在人工智能基础设施、智能算力、数字经济等领域持续性、大规模迭代投入，专注于园区级、高等级、高效高性能、绿色的综合算力中心产业链的投资、建设、持有和运营，逐步在业内树立了良好的声誉和品牌影响力，是中国领先的人工智能基础设施服务商。主要产品及用途报告期内，公司主营业务包括 IDC 业务和 AIDC 业务。目前公司运维服务聚焦于算力中心环境侧运维和 IT 设备侧运维两大核心方向，环境侧运维覆盖楼层规划与验收、关键设施环境监控、专业环境精保洁等多个方面；IT 设备侧运维则聚焦服务器预防性维护、故障支撑以及全生命周期液冷运维、算力设备清洁维护、智算集群运行维护等业务。产业链跟踪重点为：大型数据中心集群运营商，积极扩展AIDC和智能算力。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, since its establishment 17 years ago, the company has always adhered to the vision of "building the Great Wall of China's information industry and consolidating the cornerstone of China's digital economic development", with "stable, safe, reliable, and green" as its operational development goals, and persisted in the development of artificial intelligence infrastructure, intelligent computing power, and digital technology. Continuous and large-scale iterative investment in economic and other fields focuses on the investment, construction, holding and operation of park-level, high-grade, efficient and high-performance, green comprehensive computing center industry chains. It has gradually established a good reputation and brand influence in the industry and is China's leading artificial intelligence infrastructure service provider. profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，报告期内，公司围绕安全运营、互联网业务访问等场景，通过云化、服务化方式构建、承载和交付威胁检测、事件处置闭环、访问流量管控等核心能力；采用网关、终端或服务器安全组件，适配办公网、 数据中心、公有云等各类客户场景，通过云端和本地交付的安全服务降低安全方案在客户侧落地和运营门槛，提升整体安全效果。核心产品及服务包括下一代防火墙、 VPN、全网行为管理、终端安全管理系统、零信任访问控制系统、态势感知管理平台、 XDR 检测和响应平台、数据安全产品、SD-W AN、安全 SaaS（云安全访问服务 SASE、SaaS-XDR 等） 、安全GPT 系列产品，安全服务主要包括安全托管类（安全托管、勒索预防与响应等） 、安全评估（安全风险评估、渗透测试等） 、安全运维（敏感数据泄露监控、 应急响应等） 、安全培训四大类服务，以及由前述产品和服务所组成的针对不同行业、不同应用场景的网络安全整体解决方案，如 AI 安全运营方案、全资产安全托管方案、数据安全方案、零信任方案、移动和分支安全一体化方案、全球组网方案等。产业链跟踪重点为：旗下信服云提供超融合、分布式存储、私有云、托管云及算力平台。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, during the reporting period, the company focused on scenarios such as security operations and Internet business access, and built, carried and delivered core capabilities such as threat detection, closed-loop event handling, and access traffic control through cloud-based and service-based methods. It used gateway, terminal or server security components to adapt to various customer scenarios such as office networks, data centers, and public clouds. Through cloud and locally delivered security services, it reduced the implementation and operation threshold of security solutions on the customer side, and improved the overall security effect. Core products and services include next-generation firewall, VPN, network-wide behavior management, terminal security management system, zero-trust access control system, situational awareness management platform, XDR detection and response platform, data security products, SD-W AN, security SaaS (cloud security access service SASE, SaaS-XDR, etc.), security GPT series products. Security services mainly include security hosting (security hosting, ransomware prevention and response, etc.), security assessment (security risk assessment, penetration testing, etc.) , security operation and maintenance (sensitive data leakage monitoring, emergency response, etc.), security training, four major categories of services, as well as comprehensive network security solutions for different industries and different application scenarios composed of the aforementioned products and services, such as AI security operation solutions, full-asset security custody solutions, data security solutions, zero trust solutions, mobile and branch security integrated solutions, global networking solutions, etc. The focus of industry chain tracking is: its subsidiary Xinfu Cloud provides hyper-convergence, distributed storage, private cloud, managed cloud and computing power platforms.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，主要产品为智能应用处理器 SoC、高性能模拟器件和无线互联芯片。公司产品满足工业、车载、消费领域的应用需求，产品广泛适用于智能硬件、智能机器人、智能家电、智能物联网、智能汽车电子、平板电脑、网络机顶盒以及电源模拟器件、无线通信模组等多个产品市场。报告期内经营情况公司坚持在新技术、新芯片、新应用上持续高强度的投入，不断在智能汽车电子、工业控制、消费电子等领域积极拓展新市场、新客户、新应用，公司新产品及新方案顺利量产，推动公司业绩增长。报告期内，公司通过深度优化总线架构、智能调度算法及底层操作系统，成功实现了涵盖 CPU、GPU、NPU、DSP 及 RISC-V 协处理器的复杂异构芯片规模化量产，标志着公司已具备提供灵活算力组合策略的能力，能够精准匹配不同应用场景的差异化需求。产业链跟踪重点为：提供集成CPU、GPU及NPU的应用处理器，覆盖工业和端侧AI推理。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the main products are intelligent application processor SoC, high-performance analog devices and wireless interconnection chips. The company's products meet the application needs in the industrial, automotive and consumer fields. The products are widely used in multiple product markets such as intelligent hardware, intelligent robots, intelligent home appliances, intelligent Internet of Things, intelligent automotive electronics, tablet computers, network set-top boxes, power simulation devices, wireless communication modules, etc. Operations during the reporting period The company insisted on continuous high-intensity investment in new technologies, new chips, and new applications, and continued to actively expand new markets, new customers, and new applications in the fields of smart automotive electronics, industrial control, and consumer electronics. The company's new products and new solutions were successfully mass-produced, promoting the company's performance growth. During the reporting period, the company successfully achieved large-scale mass production of complex heterogeneous chips covering CPU, GPU, NPU, DSP and RISC-V co-processors through in-depth optimization of bus architecture, intelligent scheduling algorithms and underlying operating systems, indicating that the company has the ability to provide flexible computing power combination strategies and can accurately match the differentiated needs of different application scenarios. The focus of industry chain tracking is: providing application processors integrating CPU, GPU and NPU, covering industrial and end-side AI inference.
