profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司 JM11 系列图形处理芯片可满足云桌面、云游戏、云渲染、云计算等云端应用场景及地理信息系统、多媒体处理、CAD 辅助设计等高性能渲染应用场景，支持 Windows、Linux 及国产主流操作系统，可广泛应用于服务器、图形工作站、台式机、笔记本等设备。目前，公司坚定看好高性能 GPU 与边端侧 AI SoC 未来广阔的发展前景，凭借深厚的技术积淀与研发优势，加强研发投入，优化研发资源配置，推动“高性能 GPU+边端侧 AI SoC 芯片”双轮驱动战略，全力推进由“专用”到“专用+ 通用”的发展方向的转型，不断丰富产品类型，加强外部技术合作，完善产业布局，加固公司技术护城河，推动产业化规模，联合行业上下游共同推进国产应用生态建设，增强公司核心竞争力。公司经营模式 1、盈利模式公司在专用市场主要从事装备整机和分系统软硬件的研发和生产，公司通过为客户提供性能先进、稳定可靠、完全满足应用要求的产品，从而获得经营收入和利润。产业链跟踪重点为：国产图形处理芯片厂商，产品向通用计算与图形处理延伸。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's JM11 series graphics processing chips can meet cloud application scenarios such as cloud desktops, cloud games, cloud rendering, and cloud computing, as well as high-performance rendering application scenarios such as geographic information systems, multimedia processing, and CAD-aided design. They support Windows, Linux, and domestic mainstream operating systems, and can be widely used in servers, graphics workstations, desktops, notebooks, and other devices. At present, the company is firmly optimistic about the broad future development prospects of high-performance GPU and edge-side AI SoC. Relying on its profound technological accumulation and R&D advantages, the company has strengthened R&D investment, optimized the allocation of R&D resources, promoted the two-wheel drive strategy of "high-performance GPU + edge-side AI SoC chip", and fully promoted the transformation from "dedicated" to "dedicated + Transforming the development direction of "General", we will continue to enrich product types, strengthen external technical cooperation, improve industrial layout, strengthen the company's technology moat, promote the scale of industrialization, and unite the upstream and downstream industries to jointly promote the construction of domestic application ecology and enhance the company's core competitiveness. Company business model 1. Profit model The company is mainly engaged in the research, development and production of complete equipment and sub-system software and hardware in the dedicated market. The company obtains operating income and profits by providing customers with products with advanced performance, stability and reliability that fully meet application requirements. The focus of industry chain tracking is: domestic graphics processing chip manufacturers, whose products extend to general computing and graphics processing.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国产图形处理芯片厂商，产品向通用计算与图形处理延伸。
mappings.detailEn: A domestic graphics processing chip manufacturer, its products extend to general computing and graphics processing.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要产品覆盖刚性电路板 （多层板和 HDI 为核心）、柔性电路板（单双面板、多层板、刚挠结合板）全系列，广泛应用于人工智能、汽车电子（新能源）、新一代通信技术、大数据中心、工业互联、医疗仪器、计算机、航空航天等领域。b. 顺应区域化、近岸化、本土化的全球供应趋势，公司积极开展全球布局，在美国、 新加坡、日本、中国台湾、欧洲、马来西亚、韩国、泰国、越南等地设立分公司、子公司和办事处，并组建专业技术服务团队，为客户提供全球化销售服务和技术支持。公司行业地位公司专注深耕 PCB 行业二十余年，具备丰富的行业经验和深厚的技术积累，系中国印制电路行业协会（CPCA）的副理事长单位，系行业标准的制定单位之一；公司连续多年入围全球著名 PCB 市场调研机构 N.T.Information Ltd 发布的全球印制电路板制造百强企业排名榜，是国家高新技术企业、国家知识产权优势企业、广东省知识产权示范企业、广东省创新型企业，拥有省、市、区三级工程技术研发中心，省、市级企业技术中心，科研实力雄厚。产业链跟踪重点为：高多层PCB厂商，积极扩展AI服务器与高端显卡客户。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main products cover a full range of rigid circuit boards (multilayer boards and HDI as the core) and flexible circuit boards (single and double panels, multilayer boards, rigid-flex boards), which are widely used in artificial intelligence, automotive electronics (new energy), new generation communication technology, big data centers, industrial interconnection, medical instruments, computers, aerospace and other fields. b. In compliance with the global supply trends of regionalization, near-shoring and localization, the company actively develops global layout and establishes branches, subsidiaries and offices in the United States, Singapore, Japan, Taiwan, Europe, Malaysia, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam and other places, and establishes a professional technical service team to provide customers with global sales services and technical support. Company Industry Status The company has focused on the PCB industry for more than 20 years and has rich industry experience and profound technology accumulation. It is the vice-chairman unit of the China Printed Circuit Industry Association (CPCA) and one of the industry standard-setting units; the company has been shortlisted for the world's leading PCB market research organization N.T.Information Ltd for many years. The released ranking of the top 100 global printed circuit board manufacturing companies is a national high-tech enterprise, a national intellectual property advantageous enterprise, a Guangdong Province intellectual property demonstration enterprise, and an innovative enterprise in Guangdong Province. It has provincial, municipal, and district-level engineering technology R&D centers, provincial and municipal enterprise technology centers, and has strong scientific research strength. The focus of industry chain tracking is: high-end multi-layer PCB manufacturers, actively expanding customers for AI servers and high-end graphics cards.

mappings.sourceDetail: 高多层PCB厂商，积极扩展AI服务器与高端显卡客户。
mappings.detailEn: High-end multi-layer PCB manufacturer actively expands AI server and high-end graphics card customers.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司的主要业务、主要产品及其用途 1.公司从事的主要业务公司自成立以来一直致力于工业热管理系统的研发、设计、生产和销售，为工业热管理整体解决方案提供商，为客户的大型电力及算力设备提供全生命周期液冷解决方案及专业化技术服务。主要产品及其用途公司开发和销售的产品主要分为大功率电力电子热管理产品、高功率密度装置热管理产品及工程运维服务。主要产品情况如下： 业务板块主要产品主要应用领域及用途产品图片大功率电力电子热管理直流输电：直流输电换流阀液冷系统 1）主要应用于高压、超高压、特高压直流输电工程，背靠背高压直流联网工程，柔性直流输电工程等。公司上述产品中的核心部件由公司自主研发生产，主要包括空气冷却器、冷却塔、冷水机组、屏蔽泵、配水管路、Manifold 及快速接头等，为相关热管理产品提供重要配套支撑。产业链跟踪重点为：液冷技术平台厂商，覆盖数据中心和电力电子热管理。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business, main products and uses 1. The company's main business The company has been committed to the research and development, design, production and sales of industrial thermal management systems since its establishment. It is an overall solution provider for industrial thermal management, providing full life cycle liquid cooling solutions and professional technical services for customers' large power and computing equipment. Main products and their uses The products developed and sold by the company are mainly divided into high-power power electronic thermal management products, high-power density device thermal management products and engineering operation and maintenance services. The main products are as follows: Main products in the business segment Main application fields and uses Product pictures High-power power electronics thermal management DC transmission: DC transmission converter valve liquid cooling system 1) Mainly used in high-voltage, ultra-high voltage, ultra-high voltage DC transmission projects, back-to-back high-voltage DC networking projects, flexible DC transmission projects, etc. The core components of the company's above-mentioned products are independently developed and produced by the company, mainly including air coolers, cooling towers, chillers, canned pumps, water distribution pipelines, Manifolds and quick connectors, etc., providing important supporting support for related thermal management products. The focus of industry chain tracking is: liquid cooling technology platform manufacturers, covering data centers and power electronics thermal management.

mappings.sourceDetail: 液冷技术平台厂商，覆盖数据中心和电力电子热管理。
mappings.detailEn: Liquid cooling technology platform manufacturer, covering data centers and power electronics thermal management.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司自成立以来一直专注技术创新，持续推动光互联产品向更高速率、更高密度、更低功耗的方向发展。主要产品及功能运用如下： 产品系列产品照片产品简介主要应用场景 1.6T OSFP 符合 OSFP MSA 的最新标准； 固件支持 CMIS 5.0 及更高标准； 支持 DR8、DR8-2、2xFR4 和 DR4 传输接口，结构外形支持 IHS 和 RHS。公司对境内客户的销售主要为向通信设备制造商、互联网厂商直接销售；公司对境外客户的销售包括向通信设备制造商、互联网厂商直接销售和经销商销售，其中向经销商的销售全部采用买断式销售。公司在产业链位置及市场地位 1、光互联行业产业链光互联行业产业链的上游为原材料供应商，主要提供光芯片、电芯片、PCB 及结构件等。产业链跟踪重点为：高速光模块核心供应商，数据中心产品占比较高。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company has been focusing on technological innovation since its establishment and continues to promote the development of optical interconnection products towards higher speeds, higher density, and lower power consumption. The main products and functions are as follows: Product series product photos product introduction main application scenarios 1.6T OSFP complies with the latest standards of OSFP MSA; firmware supports CMIS 5.0 and higher standards; supports DR8, DR8-2, 2xFR4 and DR4 transmission interfaces, and the structural appearance supports IHS and RHS. The company's sales to domestic customers are mainly direct sales to communication equipment manufacturers and Internet manufacturers; the company's sales to overseas customers include direct sales to communication equipment manufacturers, Internet manufacturers and dealers, of which all sales to dealers are buyout sales. The company's position in the industrial chain and market position 1. Optical interconnection industry industry chain The upstream of the optical interconnection industry industry chain is raw material suppliers, mainly providing optical chips, electrical chips, PCBs and structural parts. The focus of industry chain tracking is: core suppliers of high-speed optical modules, with a high proportion of data center products.

mappings.sourceDetail: 高速光模块核心供应商，数据中心产品占比较高。
mappings.detailEn: It is a core supplier of high-speed optical modules and has a high proportion of data center products.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要产品公司主要产品面向电信，数据通信、消费及工业互联领域。公司采取“以销定产”的方式，按订单组织采购和生产。公司对于所有原材料均具备自主采购的能力，通过“比质”、“比价”、“比服务”的方式来选择境内外的供应商，把通过公司认证的供应商纳入公司“合格供应商名录”系统，并进行季度和年度的评估和考核。公司的产品以自行生产为主，在少数环节采用外协加工的方式。公司主要按照客户订单需求安排生产，同时根据产品的预测市场需求情况安排少量库存备货。产业链跟踪重点为：原简称博创科技，提供数通光模块、有源光缆及数据中心互联产品。除光器件与光模块外，公司产品组合包括DAC、ACC、AEC等高速铜缆互连产品。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main products are oriented to the fields of telecommunications, data communications, consumption and industrial interconnection. The company adopts the method of "determining production based on sales" and organizes procurement and production according to orders. The company has the ability to independently purchase all raw materials. It selects domestic and foreign suppliers through "comparison of quality", "comparison of price" and "comparison of services". The company's certified suppliers are included in the company's "Qualified Supplier Directory" system and conduct quarterly and annual evaluations and assessments. The company's products are mainly produced in-house, and a few links are outsourced for processing. The company mainly arranges production according to customer order needs, and at the same time arranges a small amount of inventory based on the predicted market demand for the product. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: formerly known as Bochuang Technology, it provides data communication optical modules, active optical cables and data center interconnection products. In addition to optical components and optical modules, the company's product portfolio includes high-speed copper interconnect products such as DAC, ACC, and AEC.

mappings.sourceDetail: 原简称博创科技，提供数通光模块、有源光缆及数据中心互联产品。
mappings.detailEn: Formerly referred to as Bochuang Technology, it provides data communication optical modules, active optical cables and data center interconnection products.

mappings.sourceDetail: 除光器件与光模块外，公司产品组合包括DAC、ACC、AEC等高速铜缆互连产品。
mappings.detailEn: In addition to optical devices and optical modules, the company's product portfolio includes high-speed copper interconnect products such as DAC, ACC, and AEC.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，报告期内公司从事的主要业务、主要产品及用途公司是专业从事高频射频同轴电缆的研发、生产和销售的高新技术企业，致力于打造成国内一流、国际知名的射频同轴电缆行业的领先企业。公司的产品已经广泛应用于通信基站、通信终端、航空航天航海、汽车通信、高端医疗器械、高速数据通信等领域。公司一般通过市场调查选择行业内知名的下游客户作为合作对象并寻求市场销售机会，下游客户在下订单前会依据与公司的商讨结论下发产品规格书，公司则根据产品规格书的技术指标进行具体的产品研发，研发产品检测合格后，下游客户向公司采购小批量产品进行评审，评审合格后下游客户与公司签订合同并开始要求批量供货。公司依托深厚的客户合作沉淀与稳定的产品交付能力，有效保障公司产品的持续稳定出货，稳步推进业务拓展，板块经营保持良好发展态势。产业链跟踪重点为：通信线缆厂商，DAC及高速数据线用于服务器数据传输和存储互联。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business, main products and uses during the reporting period. The company is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the research and development, production and sales of high-frequency radio frequency coaxial cables. It is committed to building a domestic first-class and internationally renowned leading enterprise in the radio frequency coaxial cable industry. The company's products have been widely used in communication base stations, communication terminals, aerospace and navigation, automotive communications, high-end medical equipment, high-speed data communications and other fields. The company generally selects well-known downstream customers in the industry as cooperation partners and seeks market sales opportunities through market research. The downstream customers will issue product specifications based on the conclusions of discussions with the company before placing orders. The company will conduct specific product research and development based on the technical indicators of the product specifications. After the R&D product passes the test, the downstream customer purchases small batches of products from the company for review. After the review is passed, the downstream customer signs a contract with the company and begins to require bulk supply. The company relies on its deep customer cooperation and stable product delivery capabilities to effectively ensure the continued and stable shipment of the company's products, steadily promote business expansion, and maintain a good development trend in segment operations. The focus of industry chain tracking is: communication cable manufacturers, DAC and high-speed data lines are used for server data transmission and storage interconnection.

mappings.sourceDetail: 通信线缆厂商，DAC及高速数据线用于服务器数据传输和存储互联。
mappings.detailEn: Communication cable manufacturers, DAC and high-speed data cables are used for server data transmission and storage interconnection.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主营业务聚焦半导体、显示和新能源三类检测系统的研发、生产与销售。半导体产品覆盖前道量检测、后道电测、先进封装量检测及核心器件，包括膜厚量测、光学关键尺寸量测、电子束缺陷检测、明场光学缺陷检测和自动测试设备，用于晶圆制造、封装测试及良率控制。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business focuses on the research and development, production and sales of three types of detection systems: semiconductor, display and new energy. Semiconductor products cover front-end testing, back-end electrical testing, advanced packaging testing and core devices, including film thickness measurement, optical critical dimension measurement, electron beam defect detection, bright field optical defect detection and automatic test equipment for wafer manufacturing, packaging testing and yield control.

mappings.sourceDetail: 检测设备厂商，半导体业务覆盖晶圆制造量检测与测试环节。
mappings.detailEn: Inspection equipment manufacturer, semiconductor business covers wafer manufacturing volume inspection and testing.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，报告期内，公司主营业务保持稳定，未出现重大变动。主要产品及应用 1、光器件产品公司光器件产品按照功能的不同可划分为光无源产品及光有源产品，广泛应用于全球范围内的电信网络、算力与云计算数据中心、政企专网等领域建设，主要产品及其功能如下： 产品类别主要产品功能产品图片光无源产品光互联元件陶瓷插芯、MT 插芯及各类非标插芯保证光纤定位 PLC 晶圆及芯片、AWG 晶圆及芯片实现光功率或光波长的分配光互联器件常规及高密度光纤连接器实现光互联光模块配套产品实现光模块内部连接光分路器件 PLC 分路器实现光功率的分配波分复用器实现光波长的管理光通信集成功能模块光纤路由柔性板、光纤配线机箱、光缆熔接箱等光纤布线管理单元光有源产品光模块、有源光缆 （AOC）等实现光电信号转换 2、光传感产品公司光传感产品包括光传感器、光解调仪及光传感解决方案，可监测应变、温度、位移、压力等物理量。产业链跟踪重点为：提供MPO/MTP等高密度光纤连接器和光通信器件，参与数据中心光互联。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, during the reporting period, the company's main business remained stable and there were no major changes. Main products and applications 1. Optical device products The company's optical device products can be divided into optical passive products and optical active products according to different functions. They are widely used in the construction of telecommunications networks, computing power and cloud computing data centers, government and enterprise private networks and other fields around the world. The main products and their functions are as follows: Product categories Main product functions Product pictures Optical passive products Optical interconnect components Ceramic ferrules, MT ferrules and various non-standard ferrules to ensure fiber positioning PLC wafers and chips, AWG Wafers and chips realize the distribution of optical power or optical wavelength. Optical interconnection devices. Conventional and high-density optical fiber connectors realize optical interconnection. Optical module supporting products realize the internal connection of optical modules. Optical splitter devices realize the distribution of optical power. PLC splitters realize the distribution of optical power. Wavelength division multiplexers realize the management of optical wavelength. Optical communication integrated functional modules. Optical fiber routing flexible boards, optical fiber distribution chassis, optical cable splicing boxes and other optical fiber cabling management units. Optical active products. Optical modules, active optical cables (AOC), etc. realize the conversion of optical and electrical signals. 2. Optical sensing products The company's optical sensing products include optical sensors, optical demodulators and optical sensing solutions, which can monitor physical quantities such as strain, temperature, displacement, and pressure. The focus of industry chain tracking is: providing high-density optical fiber connectors and optical communication devices such as MPO/MTP, and participating in data center optical interconnection.

mappings.sourceDetail: 提供MPO/MTP等高密度光纤连接器和光通信器件，参与数据中心光互联。
mappings.detailEn: Provide MPO/MTP and other high-density optical fiber connectors and optical communication devices to participate in data center optical interconnection.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，报告期内公司主要业务涵盖算力服务与其他通信业务产品，公司部署的高性能算力服务器集群，可为 AI 大模型训练及前沿人工智能应用提供算力支撑。公司提供涵盖算力资源配置、 网络服务、集群调试与性能优化以及专职技术团队驻场运维等全流程服务，通过持续的技术保障确保算力高效、稳定输出。公司其他通信业务产品主要包括通信设备业务和运营商权益类业务。报告期内公司经营模式 （1）研发模式公司以业务发展需要为依托，结合行业新技术的发展趋势，不断研发新的产品。公司通过参加国内通信运营商集团公司的招投标、其下属分公司及子公司的招投标（包括公开比选、公开询价等方式），公司投标入围取得供应商资格，并获取客户和订单。产业链跟踪重点为：从通信设备拓展算力综合服务，采用按月或季度收费的算力输出模式。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business during the reporting period covered computing services and other communication business products. The high-performance computing server cluster deployed by the company can provide computing power support for AI large model training and cutting-edge artificial intelligence applications. The company provides full-process services covering computing resource configuration, network services, cluster debugging and performance optimization, and on-site operation and maintenance of a dedicated technical team. It ensures efficient and stable output of computing power through continuous technical support. The company's other communication business products mainly include communication equipment business and operator equity business. The company's business model during the reporting period (1) R&D model The company continues to develop new products based on business development needs and combined with the development trends of new technologies in the industry. The company participates in the bidding of domestic communication operator group companies and the bidding of its branches and subsidiaries (including public competitions, public inquiries, etc.). The company is shortlisted for bids, obtains supplier qualifications, and obtains customers and orders. The focus of industry chain tracking is: expanding comprehensive computing power services from communication equipment, and adopting a computing power output model with monthly or quarterly charges.

mappings.sourceDetail: 子公司天昕电子的国产服务器产品已形成生产和销售，属于实际整机业务。

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司研发、设计、生产电磁屏蔽材料与器件、热管理材料与器件、基站天线、防护功能器件、轻量化材料及功能组件，并提供整体解决方案。热管理产品包括导热界面材料、石墨散热材料、散热模组、风扇、均温板、热管、液冷板和冷却液分配单元，面向服务器、数据中心、通信设备、新能源汽车及储能等场景。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company develops, designs, and produces electromagnetic shielding materials and devices, thermal management materials and devices, base station antennas, protective functional devices, lightweight materials and functional components, and provides overall solutions. Thermal management products include thermal interface materials, graphite heat dissipation materials, heat dissipation modules, fans, vapor chambers, heat pipes, liquid cooling plates and coolant distribution units, targeting servers, data centers, communication equipment, new energy vehicles, energy storage and other scenarios.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，报告期内，公司始终秉持“自主研发、技术创新”的发展理念，持续加大技术研发投入，在将现有产品领域做专、做强，保持产品市场领先地位的基础上，重点开拓了覆盖 Soc、逻辑等多种高端应用场景的数字测试设备、三温探针台、三温分选机等产品，不断拓宽产品线，并积极开拓中高端市场。主要产品公司主要为集成电路封装测试企业、晶圆制造企业、芯片设计企业等提供测试设备，目前公司主要销售产品为测试机、分选机、自动化设备及 AOI 光学检测设备等。公司主要业务模式 1、采购模式为保证公司产品的质量和性能，产生新的物料需求后，公司会执行严格的供应商遴选流程。公司下属子公司 STI 的新产品研发工作主要由产品部及视觉软件部共同完成，其中产品部门主要负责与客户进行技术交流及硬件部分的研发并生成图纸，视觉软件部主要负责软件的编程以及算法的设计以在图纸的基础上加载功能项目，最终运营部门根据图纸进行原材料的采购及组装制作。产业链跟踪重点为：集成电路测试设备厂商，产品覆盖SoC测试、分选及系统级测试配套。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, during the reporting period, the company has always adhered to the development concept of "independent research and development, technological innovation" and continued to increase investment in technology research and development. On the basis of specializing and strengthening existing product areas and maintaining its leading position in the product market, it focused on developing digital test equipment, three-temperature probe stations, three-temperature sorters and other products covering various high-end application scenarios such as Soc and logic, continuously broadening its product lines, and actively exploring the mid-to-high-end market. Main products: The company mainly provides testing equipment for integrated circuit packaging and testing companies, wafer manufacturing companies, chip design companies, etc. At present, the company's main products sold are testing machines, sorting machines, automation equipment, and AOI optical inspection equipment. The company's main business model 1. Procurement model In order to ensure the quality and performance of the company's products, the company will implement a strict supplier selection process after new material requirements are generated. The new product research and development work of STI, a subsidiary of the company, is mainly completed by the product department and the visual software department. The product department is mainly responsible for technical exchanges with customers and the research and development of the hardware part and generating drawings. The visual software department is mainly responsible for software programming and algorithm design to load functional projects based on the drawings. The final operations department purchases raw materials and assembles production according to the drawings. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: integrated circuit test equipment manufacturers, whose products cover SoC testing, sorting and system-level testing equipment.

mappings.sourceDetail: 集成电路测试设备厂商，产品覆盖SoC测试、分选及系统级测试配套。
mappings.detailEn: Integrated circuit testing equipment manufacturer, its products cover SoC testing, sorting and system-level testing equipment.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要产品为光纤激光器件、光通讯器件和激光雷达光源模块及器件，所在行业属于国家鼓励和扶持的光电子器件及其他电子器件制造业。公司的主营业务和主要产品包括： 1、光纤激光器件的设计、研发、生产、销售及服务主要产品包括隔离器、合束器、光纤光栅、激光输出头等，主要应用于光纤激光器等领域。在光通讯领域，公司积极响应客户的新需求，重点开发了海底光网络光纤馈通器（密封节）、OCS 设备中相关 MXN 高精度多维光纤阵列等系列产品，这些产品满足了客户对高速、大容量、长距离通信的需求。在数据通讯领域，公司开发了应用于 CPO 产品的系列微光学连接器，为数据中心的高速、高密度互联提供了可靠的解决方案，加大了光通讯有源器件的生产和销售开发力度，满足了日益增长的市场需求。公司高度重视研发投入，根据客户需求不断推出新产品，加大市场开拓，带来了销售收入的上升。产业链跟踪重点为：光通信器件与调制器芯片供应商，产品用于高速光模块和光互联。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main products are fiber laser devices, optical communication devices and lidar light source modules and devices. The industry it belongs to is the optoelectronic device and other electronic device manufacturing industry encouraged and supported by the state. The company's main business and main products include: 1. Design, R&D, production, sales and service of fiber laser devices. The main products include isolators, combiners, fiber gratings, laser output heads, etc., which are mainly used in fiber lasers and other fields. In the field of optical communications, the company actively responds to customers' new needs and focuses on developing a series of products such as fiber feedthroughs (sealed sections) for submarine optical networks and related MXN high-precision multi-dimensional fiber arrays in OCS equipment. These products meet customers' needs for high-speed, large-capacity, and long-distance communications. In the field of data communications, the company has developed a series of micro-optical connectors for CPO products, providing reliable solutions for high-speed and high-density interconnection in data centers, increasing the production, sales and development of optical communications active devices to meet the growing market demand. The company attaches great importance to R&D investment, continuously launches new products based on customer needs, and increases market development, resulting in an increase in sales revenue. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: suppliers of optical communication devices and modulator chips, whose products are used in high-speed optical modules and optical interconnections.

mappings.sourceDetail: 光通信器件与调制器芯片供应商，产品用于高速光模块和光互联。
mappings.detailEn: Supplier of optical communication devices and modulator chips, its products are used in high-speed optical modules and optical interconnections.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司业务覆盖高纯化学品、光刻胶、锂电池材料和工业化学品。半导体材料侧重点包括电子级双氧水、氨水、硝酸等超纯湿电子化学品，以及I-line等光刻胶及配套清洗材料，用于晶圆制造中的光刻、清洗和蚀刻工艺；同时经营锂电池粘结材料和工业硫酸等产品。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's business covers high-purity chemicals, photoresists, lithium battery materials and industrial chemicals. The focus of semiconductor materials includes ultra-pure wet electronic chemicals such as electronic-grade hydrogen peroxide, ammonia, and nitric acid, as well as photoresists and supporting cleaning materials such as I-line, which are used in photolithography, cleaning and etching processes in wafer manufacturing. It also operates products such as lithium battery bonding materials and industrial sulfuric acid.

mappings.sourceDetail: 提供高纯湿电子化学品和光刻胶，参与半导体光刻、清洗和蚀刻配套。
mappings.detailEn: Provide high-purity wet electronic chemicals and photoresists, and participate in semiconductor photolithography, cleaning and etching packages.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，主营业务公司主要专注于超高纯金属溅射靶材和半导体精密零部件的研发、生产和销售。主要产品 1、超高纯金属溅射靶材公司主要生产超高纯金属溅射靶材，包括超高纯铝靶材、超高纯钛靶材及环件、超高纯钽靶材及环件、超高纯铜靶材及铜合金靶、钨钛靶、镍靶和钨靶等。目前，公司生产的零部件产品包括设备制造零部件和工艺消耗零部件，主要用于超大规模集成电路芯片制造领域。报告期内，公司的主营业务一直专注于超高纯金属溅射靶材、半导体精密零部件的研发、生产和销售，预计未来公司的经营模式不会发生重大变化。公司零部件产品已经在物理气相沉积（PVD）、化学气相沉积（CVD）、刻蚀（Etch）、离子注入、光刻、氧化扩散等半导体核心工艺环节得到广泛应用，可量产气体分配盘（ Shower head ）、Si 电极等 4 万多种零部件，形成了全品类零部件覆盖。产业链跟踪重点为：高纯溅射靶材国产龙头，服务先进制程客户。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the main business company mainly focuses on the research and development, production and sales of ultra-high purity metal sputtering targets and semiconductor precision components. Main products 1. Ultra-high purity metal sputtering targets The company mainly produces ultra-high purity metal sputtering targets, including ultra-high purity aluminum targets, ultra-high purity titanium targets and rings, ultra-high purity tantalum targets and rings, ultra-high purity copper targets and copper alloy targets, tungsten-titanium targets, nickel targets and tungsten targets, etc. At present, the company's parts products include equipment manufacturing parts and process consumable parts, which are mainly used in the field of ultra-large-scale integrated circuit chip manufacturing. During the reporting period, the company's main business has been focusing on the research and development, production and sales of ultra-high purity metal sputtering targets and semiconductor precision components. It is expected that the company's business model will not undergo major changes in the future. The company's component products have been widely used in core semiconductor processes such as physical vapor deposition (PVD), chemical vapor deposition (CVD), etching (Etch), ion implantation, photolithography, and oxidation diffusion. It can mass-produce more than 40,000 components such as gas distribution plates (shower heads) and Si electrodes, forming a full range of component coverage. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: leading the domestic production of high-purity sputtering targets, serving customers with advanced processes.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司除高纯靶材外，已经营用于PVD、CVD、刻蚀等半导体设备的精密零部件业务。
mappings.detailEn: In addition to high-purity target materials, the company is already engaged in the business of precision components for semiconductor equipment such as PVD, CVD, and etching.

mappings.sourceDetail: 高纯溅射靶材国产龙头，服务先进制程客户。
mappings.detailEn: The leading domestic manufacturer of high-purity sputtering targets, serving customers with advanced processes.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司的主要业务奥飞数据是国内领先的互联网云计算与大数据基础服务综合解决方案提供商，致力构建多云多网多端数字产业生态平台，建设适应新一代网络通信技术 5G 的云计算大数据高速传输处理平台及全球互联互通网络，面向人工智能、智能制造、智慧医疗、AR/VR 数字创意、电子商务、动漫游戏、互联网金融、电子竞技等新兴数字科技产业提供高速、安全、 稳定的高品质互联网基础设施及云计算大数据技术综合服务，形成了以云计算数据中心为基础，全球云网一体化数据传输网络为纽带，多元产业技术应用场景为创新引擎的数字产业创新协同生态系统。公司是华南地区较有影响力的专业 IDC 服务商，主要为客户提供 IDC 服务及其他互联网综合服务。公司在广州、深圳、北京、廊坊、天津、成都、南宁、南昌、保定等城市拥有自建高品质互联网数据中心，与中国电信、中国联通、中国移动均达成重要的合作关系，为客户提供机柜租用、带宽租用等 IDC 基础服务及内容分发网络（CDN） 、数据同步、网络安全等增值服务。产业链跟踪重点为：互联网数据中心运营商，推进多地自建数据中心。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business, Aofei Data, is the leading comprehensive solution provider of Internet cloud computing and big data basic services in China. It is committed to building a multi-cloud, multi-network, multi-terminal digital industry ecological platform, building a cloud computing big data high-speed transmission and processing platform and global interconnection network adapted to the new generation of network communication technology 5G, and providing high-speed, safe, and reliable services to emerging digital technology industries such as artificial intelligence, intelligent manufacturing, smart medical care, AR/VR digital creativity, e-commerce, animation games, Internet finance, and e-sports. Stable high-quality Internet infrastructure and cloud computing big data technology comprehensive services have formed a digital industry innovation collaborative ecosystem based on cloud computing data centers, with global cloud network integrated data transmission networks as links, and diverse industrial technology application scenarios as innovation engines. The company is an influential professional IDC service provider in South China, mainly providing customers with IDC services and other comprehensive Internet services. The company has self-built high-quality Internet data centers in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Beijing, Langfang, Tianjin, Chengdu, Nanning, Nanchang, Baoding and other cities. It has reached important cooperative relationships with China Telecom, China Unicom, and China Mobile to provide customers with basic IDC services such as cabinet rental and bandwidth rental, as well as value-added services such as content distribution network (CDN), data synchronization, and network security. The focus of industry chain tracking is: Internet data center operators, promoting self-built data centers in multiple places.

mappings.sourceDetail: 互联网数据中心运营商，推进多地自建数据中心。
mappings.detailEn: Internet data center operators promote self-built data centers in multiple locations.

mappings.sourceDetail: 年度报告明确公司继续推进算力租赁及相关设备销售业务，已超出单纯机柜托管。
mappings.detailEn: The annual report makes it clear that the company continues to promote computing power leasing and related equipment sales business, which has gone beyond simple cabinet hosting.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司作为一家覆盖全球的云网融合一体化服务商，主营业务是为千行百业提供包括通用计算和智算在内的云服务、通信网络服务、IDC 服务以及综合解决方案，致力于为大模型及 AIGC 应用、政务、金融、教育、传媒、互联网等行业客户构建稳定、高效的云网一体化服务，满足不同行业在数字化转型过程中对算力和网络的服务需求。公司主要产品及服务公司作为国内领先的中立第三方云计算服务商，所处行业技术密集、竞争充分，技术创新始终是公司核心战略的重要支撑。公司持续加大在智算云、计算云等核心产品领域的研发投入，围绕“云、智、 网”一体化融合进行整体布局，集中资源聚焦关键方向。公司自主研发并提供计算、网络、存储等 IaaS 服务，数据库、容器等 PaaS 产品，以及 MaaS 平台、AI Infra 平台、工作流平台等人工智能相关产品，通过持续完善产品体系，不断构筑核心技术壁垒。产业链跟踪重点为：全球云网服务商，提供GPU算力云和低时延推理节点。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is a cloud-network integration integrated service provider with global coverage. Its main business is to provide cloud services, including general computing and intelligent computing, communication network services, IDC services and comprehensive solutions to thousands of industries. It is committed to building stable and efficient cloud-network integration services for customers in large models and AIGC applications, government affairs, finance, education, media, the Internet and other industries to meet the computing power and network service needs of different industries in the process of digital transformation. The company's main products and services As a leading neutral third-party cloud computing service provider in China, the company operates in an industry that is technology-intensive and highly competitive, and technological innovation has always been an important support for the company's core strategy. The company continues to increase investment in research and development in core product areas such as intelligent computing cloud and computing cloud, and makes an overall layout around the integration of "cloud, intelligence, and network", concentrating resources and focusing on key directions. The company independently develops and provides IaaS services such as computing, network, and storage, PaaS products such as databases and containers, and artificial intelligence-related products such as MaaS platform, AI Infra platform, and workflow platform. By continuously improving the product system, the company continues to build core technical barriers. The focus of industry chain tracking is: global cloud network service providers, providing GPU computing cloud and low-latency inference nodes.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，主营业务情况公司专注于电源领域，主要从事开关电源产品的研发、生产与销售。公司作为快速发展的开关电源企业，致力于为客户提供可靠、高效、智能的开关电源产品。目前公司主要产品包括电源适配器、数据中心电源和其他电源等，公司产品广泛应用于办公电子、 网络通信、安防监控、智能家居、新型消费电子设备、数据中心、动力电池设备、纯电交通工具、化成分容设备等众多领域。公司采购的原材料主要包括半导体、电阻电容、磁性材料、线材、 外壳等，公司结合现有订单、市场部预期及库存物料等因素综合预测未来一段时期的采购需求，进行集中采购，并制定了《合同管理规定》、《供应商付款管理制度》、《采购控制程序》、《原材料、外协供应商管理控制程序》、《进料试验和检验控制程序》等管理制度。公司直接销售是指向终端品牌商直接销售和向电子制造服务企业直接销售； 贸易商销售是指公司与贸易商签订销售合同，贸易商客户在有采购需求时直接向公司下达采购订单，采取买断方式与公司交易。产业链跟踪重点为：服务器电源核心厂商，受益于AI服务器功率升级。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the main business situation of the company is focused on the power supply field and mainly engaged in the research and development, production and sales of switching power supply products. As a rapidly developing switching power supply enterprise, the company is committed to providing customers with reliable, efficient and intelligent switching power supply products. At present, the company's main products include power adapters, data center power supplies and other power supplies. The company's products are widely used in many fields such as office electronics, network communications, security monitoring, smart homes, new consumer electronics equipment, data centers, power battery equipment, pure electric vehicles, chemical composition equipment, etc. The raw materials purchased by the company mainly include semiconductors, resistors and capacitors, magnetic materials, wires, casings, etc. The company comprehensively predicts the procurement demand in the future period based on factors such as existing orders, marketing department expectations and inventory materials, conducts centralized procurement, and formulates management systems such as "Contract Management Regulations", "Supplier Payment Management System", "Purchasing Control Procedures", "Raw Materials and Outsourcing Supplier Management Control Procedures", "Incoming Material Testing and Inspection Control Procedures". The company's direct sales refer to direct sales to terminal brands and direct sales to electronic manufacturing service companies; trader sales refer to the company signing sales contracts with traders, and trader customers directly place purchase orders with the company when they have purchasing needs, and adopt a buyout method to trade with the company. The focus of industry chain tracking is: core server power supply manufacturers, benefiting from AI server power upgrades.

mappings.sourceDetail: 服务器电源核心厂商，受益于AI服务器功率升级。
mappings.detailEn: The core manufacturer of server power supplies benefits from AI server power upgrades.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司经营的主要业务公司是一家集互联网数据中心服务、云服务、互联网接入服务、互联网数据中心及云平台信息系统集成服务、应用软件开发服务为一体的互联网综合服务提供商，在互联网数据中心及相关增值服务、互联网数据中心及云平台信息系统集成等方面具有竞争优势。公司致力于成为国内领先的云服务和互联网综合服务提供商，满足客户多样化的信息系统服务需求。主要产品与服务公司 IDC 及增值服务主要指为客户提供互联网数据中心服务、互联网接入服务和云服务。公司 IDC 及云平台信息系统集成服务主要是根据客户多样化的信息系统需求，为客户提供从信息系统设计、设备采购、集成配置、安装测试、数据中心部署、接入互联网到日常运行维护的一站式信息系统解决方案服务。公司拥有先进的集成配置中心和专业的技术服务团队，改变了传统较复杂的现场信息系统集成配置实施过程，诠释了先进的 IT 交付概念，为客户提供模块化、即插即用的集成配置服务，降低了客户信息系统实施总体成本。产业链跟踪重点为：依托自建数据中心和云平台，提供IDC托管、云资源及运维服务。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business is an Internet comprehensive service provider integrating Internet data center services, cloud services, Internet access services, Internet data center and cloud platform information system integration services, and application software development services. It has competitive advantages in Internet data centers and related value-added services, Internet data center and cloud platform information system integration, etc. The company is committed to becoming a leading cloud service and Internet comprehensive service provider in China to meet customers' diverse information system service needs. The main products and services of the company IDC and value-added services mainly refer to providing Internet data center services, Internet access services and cloud services to customers. The company's IDC and cloud platform information system integration services are mainly based on customers' diverse information system needs, providing customers with one-stop information system solution services from information system design, equipment procurement, integrated configuration, installation and testing, data center deployment, Internet access to daily operation and maintenance. The company has an advanced integrated configuration center and a professional technical service team, which has changed the traditional more complex integrated configuration implementation process of on-site information systems, interpreted the advanced IT delivery concept, provided customers with modular, plug-and-play integrated configuration services, and reduced the overall cost of customer information system implementation. The focus of industry chain tracking is: relying on self-built data centers and cloud platforms to provide IDC hosting, cloud resources and operation and maintenance services.

mappings.sourceDetail: 依托自建数据中心和云平台，提供IDC托管、云资源及运维服务。
mappings.detailEn: Relying on self-built data centers and cloud platforms, we provide IDC hosting, cloud resources and operation and maintenance services.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司除IDC外经营云平台及云服务，提供专属云、驻地专属云和云平台集成服务。
mappings.detailEn: In addition to IDC, the company operates cloud platforms and cloud services, providing dedicated cloud, resident dedicated cloud and cloud platform integration services.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司的主要业务公司主营业务为数据电缆、专用电缆和连接产品设计、制造与销售，致力于为数据中心、AI 算力中心、通信网络、 智能建筑、工业互联、汽车以太网、智能家居、特种应用（医疗、风能、船用、轨交、光伏、机器人、核电、航空航天）等各个领域客户提供高速、稳定、可靠的产品与系统化解决方案。主要产品及其用途 1、数据电缆公司主要提供 5e 类、6 类、6A 类、7 类、7A 类、8 类的数据电缆，广泛应用于综合布线、数据中心、安防监控等场景。公司已成功为数据中心、金融、政府机构、教育、交通设施、医院、商业、智能工厂、家居等众多行业项目提供产品和服务，助力各行业客户在数字化浪潮中实现高效、稳定的网络通信与数据传输。公司进一步推出高密度小型化布线系统、速率更快的八类布线系统、最长布线可达 1000 米的单对以太网布线系统，以及适用于 250 米超长传输的铜缆系统等，面向智能楼宇、工业制造等多元化场景，提供从高速数据传输到长距低耗连接的全场景专业解决方案，满足不同领域客户的差异化需求。产业链跟踪重点为：高速数据电缆与连接组件供应商，受益于数据中心铜互联。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business is the design, manufacturing and sales of data cables, special cables and connection products. It is committed to providing high-speed, stable and reliable products and systematic solutions to customers in various fields such as data centers, AI computing centers, communication networks, smart buildings, industrial interconnection, automotive Ethernet, smart homes, special applications (medical, wind energy, marine, rail transit, photovoltaic, robots, nuclear power, aerospace) and other fields. Main products and their uses 1. The data cable company mainly provides Category 5e, Category 6, Category 6A, Category 7, Category 7A, and Category 8 data cables, which are widely used in integrated wiring, data centers, security monitoring and other scenarios. The company has successfully provided products and services for many industry projects such as data centers, finance, government agencies, education, transportation facilities, hospitals, commerce, smart factories, and homes, helping customers in various industries achieve efficient and stable network communications and data transmission in the wave of digitalization. The company has further launched high-density miniaturized cabling systems, faster Category 8 cabling systems, single-pair Ethernet cabling systems with a maximum cabling length of up to 1,000 meters, and copper cable systems suitable for 250-meter ultra-long transmission. For diversified scenarios such as smart buildings and industrial manufacturing, it provides full-scenario professional solutions from high-speed data transmission to long-distance low-consumption connections to meet the differentiated needs of customers in different fields. The focus of industry chain tracking is: suppliers of high-speed data cables and connection components, benefiting from data center copper interconnection.

mappings.sourceDetail: 高速数据电缆与连接组件供应商，受益于数据中心铜互联。
mappings.detailEn: Supplier of high-speed data cables and connectivity components benefiting from data center copper interconnects.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司是一家专业从事工业温控设备研发、生产和销售的高新技术企业，凭借深厚的技术沉淀和精耕细作的自主研发能力，成为工业温控领域整体解决方案综合服务商。目前，公司主要产品可分为液体恒温设备、电气箱恒温装置、纯水冷却单元和特种换热器四大类，下游应用场景主要为数控装备（包括数控机床、激光设备等）、电力电子（包括输变电、 电气传动等）、储能、半导体、数据中心、氢能、新能源汽车（充换电）、医疗器械、工业洗涤等领域。主要产品及其用途 1 、液体恒温设备在数控装备领域，主要应用于数控机床主轴、电机、液压站、减速箱等关键功能部件的温度控制；还广泛应用于激光设备的激光发生器（包括光纤激光器、二氧化碳激光器、半导体激光器等）、切割头以及光学部件的温度控制。公司通过向客户提供定制化的专业产品、综合解决方案和服务，不断满足客户需求，提升客户价值，积累了优质的客户群体，形成良好的品牌口碑，以此获取盈利。产业链跟踪重点为：工业温控厂商，持续拓展储能与数据中心液冷。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the research, development, production and sales of industrial temperature control equipment. With its profound technological accumulation and intensive independent research and development capabilities, it has become a comprehensive service provider of overall solutions in the field of industrial temperature control. At present, the company's main products can be divided into four categories: liquid constant temperature equipment, electrical box constant temperature devices, pure water cooling units and special heat exchangers. The downstream application scenarios are mainly CNC equipment (including CNC machine tools, laser equipment, etc.), power electronics (including power transmission and transformation, electric transmission, etc.), energy storage, semiconductors, data centers, hydrogen energy, new energy vehicles (charging and swapping), medical equipment, industrial washing and other fields. Main products and their uses 1. In the field of CNC equipment, liquid thermostatic equipment is mainly used for temperature control of key functional components such as CNC machine tool spindles, motors, hydraulic stations, and reduction gearboxes; it is also widely used for temperature control of laser generators (including fiber lasers, carbon dioxide lasers, semiconductor lasers, etc.), cutting heads, and optical components of laser equipment. By providing customers with customized professional products, comprehensive solutions and services, the company continuously meets customer needs, enhances customer value, accumulates a high-quality customer base, and forms a good brand reputation, thereby earning profits. The focus of industry chain tracking is: industrial temperature control manufacturers continue to expand energy storage and data center liquid cooling.

mappings.sourceDetail: 工业温控厂商，持续拓展储能与数据中心液冷。
mappings.detailEn: The industrial temperature control manufacturer continues to expand energy storage and data center liquid cooling.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司自 2011 年开始研究数据中心液冷散热技术，参与了中国移动南方基地的“数据中心液/气双通道精准高效致冷系统关键技术及应用”科研项目，在南方基地的主导下，与浪潮信息、新创意、华南理工等合作完成了定制液冷服务器及液冷散热系统的开发，搭建了国内较早的商用液冷微模块数据中心，并实现了长期稳定运行。主要产品包括屋顶式空调、单元式空调、恒温恒湿空调、洁净式空调、除湿机、低露点除湿机、冷热水机组、蒸发冷却冷水机组、组合式空调机组、储能用液冷温控产品等。公司正进一步聚焦行业应用和高效节能，加强重点工业领域相关的产品开发和业务拓展。主要产品包括核电专用空调、地铁专用空调、飞机地面空调、国防工程类特种空调、洞库专用空调及除湿机、抗冲击及防爆类空调、VOCs 冷凝回收系统等。主要产品包括商用冷水机组、商用组合式空调、商用末端机组、商用单元式空调等。产业链跟踪重点为：数据中心专用空调与液冷系统供应商。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company began to research data center liquid cooling technology in 2011, and participated in the "Key Technologies and Applications of Data Center Liquid/Gas Dual-Channel Precision and Efficient Refrigeration System" scientific research project of China Mobile's Southern Base. Under the leadership of the Southern Base, it cooperated with Inspur Information, New Creativity, South China University of Technology, etc. to complete the development of customized liquid-cooled servers and liquid-cooled heat dissipation systems, built the earliest commercial liquid-cooled micro-module data center in China, and achieved long-term stable operation. The main products include rooftop air conditioners, unit air conditioners, constant temperature and humidity air conditioners, clean air conditioners, dehumidifiers, low dew point dehumidifiers, hot and cold water units, evaporative cooling chillers, combined air conditioners, liquid cooling temperature control products for energy storage, etc. The company is further focusing on industry applications and high efficiency and energy conservation, and strengthening product development and business expansion related to key industrial fields. The main products include special air conditioners for nuclear power, special air conditioners for subways, aircraft ground air conditioners, special air conditioners for national defense engineering, special air conditioners and dehumidifiers for caverns, impact-resistant and explosion-proof air conditioners, VOCs condensation recovery systems, etc. The main products include commercial chillers, commercial combined air conditioners, commercial terminal units, commercial unit air conditioners, etc. The focus of industry chain tracking is: data center dedicated air conditioning and liquid cooling system suppliers.

mappings.sourceDetail: 数据中心专用空调与液冷系统供应商。
mappings.detailEn: Supplier of dedicated air conditioning and liquid cooling systems for data centers.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司业务概述：核心能力引领，工具与产品并进公司始终致力于为客户提供定制化的、质量优良、性能稳定的自动化设备，以及配套的治具、零部件等产品，其中以治具和零部件产品为主。公司大多数重要客户都是全球知名的企业，其业务范畴广泛，综合实力强劲，市场影响力大，该等客户基础为公司拓展业务范围提供了良好的条件。报告期内经营业绩情况：厚积薄发，增长提速报告期内，公司主要从事治具、设备、散热器、电机及零部件等产品的研发、生产和销售，公司产品主要应用于移动智能终端、智能汽车、AI 服务器及网络通讯、半导体设备、 机器人等领域。报告期内，公司应用于移动智能终端领域的产品贡献收入约 8.36 亿元，同比增长约 23%，其中从苹果产业链获取的营业收入约为 5.78 亿元。主要产品介绍 1、治具类产品产品名称图片应用场景/说明镭焊治具用于苹果手机部件焊接工序。产业链跟踪重点为：提供液冷服务器检测设备及散热器，覆盖液冷制造和验证配套。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's business overview: core capabilities lead, tools and products go hand in hand. The company has always been committed to providing customers with customized, high-quality, stable-performance automation equipment, as well as supporting jigs, parts and other products, mainly jigs and parts products. Most of the company's important customers are world-renowned enterprises with a wide range of business scope, strong comprehensive strength and great market influence. These customer bases provide good conditions for the company to expand its business scope. Operating performance during the reporting period: Accumulated accumulation and accelerated growth. During the reporting period, the company was mainly engaged in the research and development, production and sales of fixtures, equipment, radiators, motors and components. The company's products are mainly used in mobile smart terminals, smart cars, AI servers and network communications, semiconductor equipment, robots and other fields. During the reporting period, the company's products used in the field of mobile smart terminals contributed revenue of approximately 836 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of approximately 23%, of which operating income from the Apple industry chain was approximately 578 million yuan. Main product introduction 1. Jig products Product name Picture Application scenario/description Radium welding jig is used in the welding process of Apple mobile phone parts. The focus of industry chain tracking is: providing liquid cooling server testing equipment and radiators, covering liquid cooling manufacturing and verification supporting equipment.

mappings.sourceDetail: 提供液冷服务器检测设备及散热器，覆盖液冷制造和验证配套。
mappings.detailEn: Provides liquid cooling server testing equipment and radiators, covering liquid cooling manufacturing and verification packages.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司的产品遍及网络建设中的各主要层级，广泛应用于局域网、城域网、广域网等各类型计算机网络中，承担网络通信及保障网络安全的重要作用，并融合云计算、虚拟化等技术为各领域用户提供灵活、高效、安全的云桌面解决方案。公司的主要产品包括网络设备（交换机、路由器、无线产品等）、网络安全产品（安全网关、下一代防火墙、安全态势感知等）、云桌面整体解决方案（云桌面软件、云主机、云终端）以及 IT 运维等其他产品及解决方案。产业链跟踪重点为：企业级交换机与数据中心网络设备重要供应商。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's products cover all major levels of network construction and are widely used in various types of computer networks such as local area networks, metropolitan area networks, and wide area networks. They play an important role in network communications and ensuring network security, and integrate cloud computing, virtualization and other technologies to provide flexible, efficient, and secure cloud desktop solutions for users in various fields. The company's main products include network equipment (switches, routers, wireless products, etc.), network security products (security gateways, next-generation firewalls, security situation awareness, etc.), overall cloud desktop solutions (cloud desktop software, cloud hosts, cloud terminals) and other products and solutions such as IT operation and maintenance. The focus of industry chain tracking is: important suppliers of enterprise-level switches and data center network equipment.

mappings.sourceDetail: 企业级交换机与数据中心网络设备重要供应商。
mappings.detailEn: An important supplier of enterprise-class switches and data center network equipment.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司管理层团队始终紧跟行业发展趋势和技术升级迭代的需求，围绕主营业务，结合自身优势和长处，在当前竞争激烈的市场环境下，努力寻求新的业务增长点，积极主动突破困局，寻找新的发展机会，不断完善和丰富自身业务产品线，开拓和进入了高端 PCBA 板卡、服务器、算力卡如 DPU 及 GPU 板卡类、光通信传输系统设备之接入网设备等新业务、 新产品布局和相关产品的制造服务。报告期内，公司布局的新业务产能和效益还未得以较快释放，公司主要收入中来源于国内园区级和企业级交换机销售占比较高，国内市场竞争异常激烈，报告期内受公司新项目投入增加，研发费用投入增加较快等因素影响，公司经营发展和业绩承压，但公司布局的其他新业务、新产品以及海外市场的拓展与效能正在逐步改善和提升中。公司深耕网络通信领域多年，在此细分领域已构建起较为领先的智能制造优势。产业链跟踪重点为：网络设备ODM厂商，产品覆盖交换机、路由器和无线设备。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's management team has always kept up with industry development trends and the needs for technological upgrades and iterations. Focusing on its main business, combined with its own advantages and strengths, in the current fiercely competitive market environment, it strives to seek new business growth points, proactively break through difficulties, find new development opportunities, constantly improve and enrich its business product lines, and develop and enter new businesses such as high-end PCBA boards, servers, computing power cards such as DPU and GPU boards, optical communication transmission system equipment and access network equipment. New product layout and manufacturing services for related products. During the reporting period, the company's new business capacity and benefits have not been released quickly. The company's main revenue comes from the sales of domestic park-level and enterprise-level switches. The domestic market competition is extremely fierce. During the reporting period, due to factors such as the company's increased investment in new projects and the rapid increase in R&D expenses, the company's operating development and performance are under pressure. However, the company's other new businesses, new products, and the expansion and efficiency of overseas markets are gradually improving and improving. The company has been deeply involved in the field of network communications for many years, and has established leading intelligent manufacturing advantages in this segment. The focus of industry chain tracking is: network equipment ODM manufacturers, whose products cover switches, routers and wireless equipment.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司产品的功能及主要应用芯片产品主要产品功能介绍主要应用主控芯片高性能主控芯片负责存储器内部 NAND 闪存颗粒的数据管理，并与 CPU 进行数据通信端侧 AI 存储器、 高端存储器 SPU 芯片除 NAND 闪存颗粒的数据管理基础功能外，还具备存内数据压缩和温冷数据智能调度能力，可大幅提升大模型在端侧 AI 的部署能力端侧 AI 存储器存储芯片 SLC NAND 与 NOR 等特定型态存储芯片作为存储器的高性能存储介质载体，提供高可靠性支撑高可靠性存储器存储器产品主要产品主要应用芯片级存储器嵌入式存储 AI 手机、智能穿戴、智能汽车等模组级存储器固态硬盘 AI 服务器、AI PC、数据中心等移动存储个人消费类存储、具身智能、智能汽车等内存条 AI 服务器、AI PC、数据中心等公司拥有行业类存储品牌 FORESEE、海外行业类存储品牌 Zilia 和国际高端消费类存储品牌 Lexar（雷克沙） 。公司产品广泛应用于端侧 AI 设备、AI 服务器、数据中心、汽车电子、物联网、安防监控、工业控制等领域，以及个人消费类存储市场。产业链跟踪重点为：存储产品与解决方案供应商，覆盖企业级SSD、内存模组及嵌入式存储。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's product functions and main application chip products are introduced. Main product function introduction Main application main control chip The high-performance main control chip is responsible for the data management of NAND flash memory particles inside the memory and performs data communication with the CPU. End-side AI memory and high-end memory SPU chips, in addition to the basic data management functions of NAND flash memory particles, also have in-memory data compression and intelligent scheduling capabilities for warm and cold data, which can greatly improve the deployment capabilities of large models in end-side AI. End-side AI memory storage chips Specific types of memory chips such as SLC NAND and NOR serve as high-performance storage media carriers for memory, providing high-reliability support. The main products of high-reliability memory memory products are mainly used in chip-level memory, embedded storage, module-level memory such as AI mobile phones, smart wearables, and smart cars, solid-state drives, AI servers, AI PCs, data centers, and other mobile storage, personal consumer storage, embodied intelligence, smart cars, and other memory sticks. AI servers, AI PCs, data centers, and other companies own industry storage brands FORESEE and overseas industry storage brands Zilia. and international high-end consumer storage brand Lexar. The company's products are widely used in end-side AI equipment, AI servers, data centers, automotive electronics, Internet of Things, security monitoring, industrial control and other fields, as well as in the personal consumer storage market. The focus of industry chain tracking is: storage product and solution suppliers, covering enterprise-level SSD, memory modules and embedded storage.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司通过深化算力赋能行业应用，构建一体化算力服务体系，推动算力在更多生产生活场景的应用落地，进而不断推动智慧城市的高质量发展。公司依托完善、高性价比的算力供应链、丰富的智算资源池及大型客户服务经验，可为客户提供 GPU 硬件采购、集算力组网一体化解决方案，为客户提供全方位、多元化、高效、低成本的 AI 解决方案，以推动大模型应用持续创新与发展，致力成为中国领先智算解决方案服务商。公司面向智慧城市客户，依托良好的软件开发、产业链上下游整合、整体解决方案提供和运行维护等能力，广泛应用大数据、物联网、人工智能、云计算、智算等技术，秉持数据智能化、应用场景丰富化、自组织协调能力、开放创新生态和可持续发展等理念，将客户的系统和服务打通、集成，为客户提供畅通的数据共享与网络化管理，实现资源整合及业务协同，破除各领域中的数据孤岛，提高管理效率，降低管理成本，推进客户的数字化转型，实现客户内部管理和服务的智慧互联。产业链跟踪重点为：算力服务已成为主要收入来源，持续扩充服务器资产。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company will continue to promote the high-quality development of smart cities by deepening computing power to empower industry applications, building an integrated computing power service system, and promoting the application of computing power in more production and life scenarios. Relying on a complete and cost-effective computing power supply chain, a rich intelligent computing resource pool and large-scale customer service experience, the company can provide customers with integrated solutions for GPU hardware procurement and centralized computing power networking, and provide customers with comprehensive, diversified, efficient and low-cost AI solutions to promote the continuous innovation and development of large model applications and strive to become China's leading intelligent computing solution service provider. Facing smart city customers, the company relies on its excellent software development, upstream and downstream integration of the industrial chain, overall solution provision and operation and maintenance capabilities, and widely applies technologies such as big data, Internet of Things, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and intelligent computing. It upholds data intelligence, enriched application scenarios, self-organization and coordination capabilities, open innovation ecology, and sustainability. With the concept of continuous development, we will open up and integrate customers' systems and services, provide customers with smooth data sharing and network management, realize resource integration and business collaboration, break down data islands in various fields, improve management efficiency, reduce management costs, promote customers' digital transformation, and realize intelligent interconnection of customers' internal management and services. The focus of industry chain tracking is: computing power services have become the main source of income, and server assets continue to be expanded.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司目标持续巩固并提升在智能安防主战场的领先地位，实现产品竞争力及品牌客户覆盖率全面领先。目前主要应用于家庭服务机器人，正在持续拓品类及中高端化，已陆续切入大型户外机器人（如割草/ 除雪/泳池清洁等）、陪伴机器人、工业协作机器人、具身智能机器人等多个细分领域。公司用于AI 眼镜的视觉AI SoC 集成了高性能AI处理器、高性能ISP、专用视觉硬件及低功耗显示引擎等关键技术，可满足市场对 AI 眼镜等穿戴设备在轻量化设计、视觉采集、低功耗续航等方面的核心需求，适配多场景消费级穿戴设备产品的开发与应用落地。公司高度集成的SoC 设计将视频解码、显示控制、音频处理和AI 计算整合至单一解决方案中，使客户能够开发功能丰富的产品，并降低系统复杂性、功耗及加快产品上市。公司核心策略一方面是深耕海内外客户，目前相关产品已在 30+家海内外客户导入量产或即将量产，其中海外重点突破日本市场，2026 年及未来将有更多项目落地；另一方面聚焦高确定性的优势赛道，争取友商未覆盖或投入不足的市场，避免业内同质化竞争。产业链跟踪重点为：端边侧视觉AI SoC设计厂商，拥有自研AI处理器和配套工具链。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company aims to continue to consolidate and enhance its leading position in the main battlefield of intelligent security and achieve overall leadership in product competitiveness and brand customer coverage. Currently, it is mainly used in home service robots. It is continuing to expand its categories and become mid-to-high-end. It has gradually entered many subdivisions such as large outdoor robots (such as lawn mowing/snow removal/swimming pool cleaning, etc.), companion robots, industrial collaborative robots, and embodied intelligent robots. The company's visual AI SoC for AI glasses integrates key technologies such as high-performance AI processor, high-performance ISP, dedicated visual hardware and low-power display engine. It can meet the market's core needs for wearable devices such as AI glasses in terms of lightweight design, visual acquisition, low-power endurance, etc., and is suitable for the development and application of multi-scenario consumer-grade wearable device products. The company's highly integrated SoC designs integrate video decoding, display control, audio processing and AI computing into a single solution, enabling customers to develop feature-rich products while reducing system complexity, power consumption and speeding up product launches. On the one hand, the company's core strategy is to deeply cultivate customers at home and abroad. Currently, relevant products have been introduced into mass production or are about to be mass-produced by more than 30 domestic and overseas customers. Among them, the overseas focus is on breaking through the Japanese market, and more projects will be launched in 2026 and in the future. On the other hand, it focuses on high-definition advantageous tracks, strives for markets that are not covered by friends or have insufficient investment, and avoids homogeneous competition in the industry. The focus of industry chain tracking is: end-side vision AI SoC design manufacturers, which have self-developed AI processors and supporting tool chains.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，覆铜板，生产过程中主要由铜箔、树脂、玻纤布三大原材料组成。覆铜板是印刷电路板的主要材料，可广泛应用于消费电子、网络通讯设备、智能家居电子设备、 汽车电子系统、工业控制、服务器、基站乃至航空航天等领域。产业链跟踪重点为：电子级环氧树脂与覆铜板供应商，产品覆盖PCB上游关键材料，并布局高频高速、高Tg等覆铜板产品。

The focus of the industry chain tracking is: electronic-grade epoxy resin and copper-clad laminate suppliers, whose products cover key upstream PCB materials, and layout of high-frequency, high-speed, high-Tg and other copper-clad laminate products.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司产品、技术及解决方案广泛应用于石油、电力、气象、动漫渲染等典型高性能计算领域，智算中心、大模型、工业智算等智能计算领域，以及城市云、行业云等云计算领域，可精准匹配不同细分市场的差异化应用需求。目前，公司超节点、超集群产品尚未在市场上实现大规模部署与应用，后续，公司将着力推进产品商业化落地，逐步扩大产品市场覆盖面，助力 AI 算力普惠化发展。公司安全产品覆盖从网络安全、主机安全、运维安全到数据安全的一体化安全产品，并基于此构建多层次、多维度的安全解决方案，面向数据中心防护、等保、企业安全、网络审计等多场景。公司为客户提供数据中心全方位服务，业务覆盖数据中心基础设施全系列硬件产品、定制化解决方案，及前期规划、性能评测、升级改造等全周期服务。公司子公司曙光数创自 2011 年起就开始液冷技术研究，2015 年推出国内首款量产冷板式液冷解决方案，2019 年实现全球首个全浸式液体相变冷却技术商业化落地，截止目前主要产品涵盖浸没液冷数据中心基础设施产品（C8000 系列，含液冷机柜、换热模块等）、冷板液冷数据中心基础设施产品（C7000 系列，含冷板套件、封闭通道等）、模块化数据中心产品，以及围绕上述产品提供系统集成和技术服务。产业链跟踪重点为：高性能计算与服务器平台厂商，具备算力基础设施全栈能力。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's products, technologies and solutions are widely used in typical high-performance computing fields such as petroleum, electric power, meteorology, and animation rendering, intelligent computing fields such as intelligent computing centers, large models, and industrial intelligent computing, as well as cloud computing fields such as city cloud and industry cloud, and can accurately match the differentiated application needs of different market segments. At present, the company's super-node and super-cluster products have not yet achieved large-scale deployment and application in the market. In the future, the company will focus on promoting the commercialization of products, gradually expanding product market coverage, and assisting the inclusive development of AI computing power. The company's security products cover integrated security products from network security, host security, operation and maintenance security to data security, and based on this, we build multi-level and multi-dimensional security solutions for multiple scenarios such as data center protection, Class A protection, enterprise security, and network auditing. The company provides customers with a full range of data center services, covering a full range of data center infrastructure hardware products, customized solutions, and full-cycle services such as early planning, performance evaluation, and upgrades. The company's subsidiary Sugon Digital has been researching liquid cooling technology since 2011. In 2015, it launched the country's first mass-produced cold plate liquid cooling solution. In 2019, it realized the commercialization of the world's first fully immersed liquid phase change cooling technology. So far, its main products include immersed liquid cooling data center infrastructure products (C8000 series, including liquid cooling cabinets, heat exchange modules, etc.), cold plate liquid cooling data center infrastructure products (C7000 series, including cold plate kits, enclosed aisles, etc.), modular data center products, and the provision of system integration and technical services around the above products. The focus of industry chain tracking is: high-performance computing and server platform manufacturers with full-stack computing infrastructure capabilities.
