profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，报告期内，公司主营业务聚焦 5G 新基建、智算、智慧城市及其他创新业务三大板块，实现 5G 新基建与算力、人工智能、新能源协同发展。公司 5G 新基建业务覆盖国内大部分省份，是中国移动、中国电信、中国联通和中国铁塔的重要服务商；同时，公司在国际“一带一路”沿线国家开展 EPC 总承包业务，业务区域涵盖中东、东南亚、非洲等地区，是多家海外运营商的重要合作伙伴。公司组建的覆盖服务器、存储、网络、安全、软件开发等领域的专业技术团队，掌握智算集群网络规划、优化及一体化运维核心技术，已初步完成智算业务全国布局，相继建成武当、上海松江、上海临港、三江源、宁夏中卫、甘肃庆阳、青海海东等多个智算集群项目。公司主要从事动力电池及储能系统的生产及销售，为商用车（轻卡、重卡）提供动力电池系统，为工商业用户提供储能系统。产业链跟踪重点为：从通信服务延伸至智算集群建设与算力租赁运营。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, during the reporting period, the company's main business focused on the three major sectors of 5G new infrastructure, intelligent computing, smart cities and other innovative businesses, achieving the coordinated development of 5G new infrastructure, computing power, artificial intelligence, and new energy. The company's 5G new infrastructure business covers most provinces in China and is an important service provider for China Mobile, China Telecom, China Unicom and China Tower; at the same time, the company carries out EPC general contracting business in countries along the international "Belt and Road", with business areas covering the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Africa and other regions, and is an important partner of many overseas operators. The company has established a professional technical team covering servers, storage, network, security, software development and other fields. It has mastered the core technologies of intelligent computing cluster network planning, optimization and integrated operation and maintenance. It has initially completed the national layout of intelligent computing business and successively completed multiple intelligent computing cluster projects in Wudang, Shanghai Songjiang, Shanghai Lingang, Sanjiangyuan, Ningxia Zhongwei, Gansu Qingyang, Qinghai Haidong and other intelligent computing cluster projects. The company is mainly engaged in the production and sales of power batteries and energy storage systems, providing power battery systems for commercial vehicles (light trucks, heavy trucks), and energy storage systems for industrial and commercial users. The focus of industry chain tracking is: extending from communication services to intelligent computing cluster construction and computing power leasing operations.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司智算业务提供基于云主机的计算、存储及相关云服务解决方案。
mappings.detailEn: The company's intelligent computing business provides computing, storage and related cloud service solutions based on cloud hosts.

mappings.sourceDetail: 从通信服务延伸至智算集群建设与算力租赁运营。
mappings.detailEn: Extending from communication services to intelligent computing cluster construction and computing power leasing operations.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司专业从事印制电路板研发、生产和销售，产品矩阵包括多层板、HDI、高多层板、柔性线路板、金属基线路板及刚挠结合板。通信与数据基础设施产品面向AI加速卡、通用及AI服务器、高速交换机、400G/800G/1.6T光模块和存储设备，并提供高层数、厚铜电源板及高阶HDI等方案。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company specializes in the research and development, production and sales of printed circuit boards. The product matrix includes multilayer boards, HDI, high multilayer boards, flexible circuit boards, metal-based circuit boards and rigid-flex boards. Communication and data infrastructure products are targeted at AI accelerator cards, general and AI servers, high-speed switches, 400G/800G/1.6T optical modules and storage devices, and provide high-level data, thick copper power boards and high-end HDI solutions.

mappings.sourceDetail: PCB供应商，高阶HDI及高速线路板应用于AI服务器、数据中心和光模块。
mappings.detailEn: PCB supplier, high-end HDI and high-speed circuit boards are used in AI servers, data centers and optical modules.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司产品线全面覆盖移动终端、笔电、数据中心、AIOT、汽车电子、机器人等多元化业务，各业务协同发展，稳步巩固行业竞争优势。公司服务于全球头部终端品牌厂商，不断挖掘客户需求，在智能手机、平板电脑及智能穿戴产品等多品类产品上深度协同，筑牢长期客户粘性与独特客户优势。在智能手机领域，公司已积累深厚的研发、制造、供应链管理、质量管控能力，同时具备显著的成本优势与规模效应。在平板电脑领域，公司充分发挥与智能手机业务在客户资源、生产工艺、供应链体系等方面的高效协同优势，发货数量持续提升，继续夯实在海内外一线品牌核心供应商地位，稳居平板电脑 ODM 领域全球份额第一。公司具备从研发、设计到生产制造、规模交付一体化的全流程端到端解决方案能力，通过与客户在产品定义阶段深度协同，以及高质量生产制造交付，获得客户高度认可。产业链跟踪重点为：智能硬件ODM龙头，服务器与数据中心业务快速扩张。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's product line fully covers diversified businesses such as mobile terminals, laptops, data centers, AIOT, automotive electronics, and robots. Each business develops collaboratively and steadily consolidates the industry's competitive advantages. The company serves global head terminal brand manufacturers, constantly explores customer needs, and deeply collaborates on multiple categories of products such as smartphones, tablets, and smart wearable products to build long-term customer stickiness and unique customer advantages. In the field of smartphones, the company has accumulated profound R&D, manufacturing, supply chain management, and quality control capabilities, and also has significant cost advantages and economies of scale. In the field of tablet PCs, the company has fully leveraged its efficient synergy with its smartphone business in terms of customer resources, production processes, and supply chain systems. The number of shipments has continued to increase. It continues to consolidate its position as a core supplier of first-tier brands at home and abroad, and firmly ranks first in the global share of tablet PC ODM. The company has full-process end-to-end solution capabilities from R&D, design to manufacturing and large-scale delivery. Through in-depth collaboration with customers in the product definition stage and high-quality manufacturing and delivery, the company has been highly recognized by customers. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: the leader in intelligent hardware ODM, and the rapid expansion of server and data center business.

mappings.sourceDetail: 智能硬件ODM龙头，服务器与数据中心业务快速扩张。
mappings.detailEn: As a leader in intelligent hardware ODM, its server and data center business is rapidly expanding.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司数据中心产品除服务器外，包含交换机产品研发制造及交付。
mappings.detailEn: In addition to servers, the company's data center products include the R&D, manufacturing and delivery of switch products.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司所从事的网络可视化业务，主要指为网络可视化及智算可视化系统提供基础设备、核心组件及应用解决方案，包括一系列不同形态的设备、模块、以及相关软件和应用系统等产品，如下图所示： 图 1：网络可视化/智算可视化应用系统公司的网络可视化产品，主要部署在运营商宽带骨干网、移动网、IDC出口、以及企业和行业内部网络等不同场景，在其主要网络节点通过多种物理链路信号采集技术，进行全流量数据采集，对获取的大规模流量数据进行多维度、多方式的处理分析和信息挖掘，为各类网络可视化应用，包括网络优化与运维、信息安全、大数据运营等，提供精炼的、用户可定义的、满足应用和业务需求、并且易于使用和处理的数据和信息，以及相应的网络管理、优化和控制手段，同时也为这些网络可视化应用提供软件和系统整体解决方案。公司的智算可视化产品，主要部署在各类智算中心，通过参与智算中心的组网、运维和算力调优等内容，不仅提供算力上架时的部署和调优，还对算力集群在运行期间进行全方位可视化运维服务，提升算网架构对模型训练、推理等应用的效率。产业链跟踪重点为：提供网络交换硬件和智能系统平台，布局智算交换机及集群交付。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the network visualization business engaged in by the company mainly refers to the provision of basic equipment, core components and application solutions for network visualization and intelligent computing visualization systems, including a series of different forms of equipment, modules, and related software and application systems and other products, as shown in the figure below: Figure 1: Network visualization/intelligent computing visualization application system company's network visualization products are mainly deployed in different scenarios such as operator broadband backbone networks, mobile networks, IDC exports, and enterprise and industry internal networks. It uses a variety of physical link signal acquisition technologies at its main network nodes to collect full traffic data and process the large-scale traffic data obtained in multiple dimensions and in multiple ways. Analysis and information mining provide refined, user-definable data and information that meet application and business needs and are easy to use and process for various network visualization applications, including network optimization and operation and maintenance, information security, big data operations, etc., as well as corresponding network management, optimization and control methods. It also provides software and system overall solutions for these network visualization applications. The company's intelligent computing visualization products are mainly deployed in various intelligent computing centers. By participating in the networking, operation and maintenance, and computing power optimization of the intelligent computing center, it not only provides deployment and optimization of computing power when it is put on the shelves, but also provides comprehensive visual operation and maintenance services for the computing power cluster during operation, improving the efficiency of the computing network architecture for model training, inference and other applications. The focus of industry chain tracking is: providing network switching hardware and intelligent system platforms, deploying intelligent computing switches and cluster delivery.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司智能系统平台已覆盖国产服务器并形成业务收入，同时调整低附加值算力一体机业务。
mappings.detailEn: The company's intelligent system platform has covered domestic servers and generated business revenue, while also adjusting the low value-added computing power all-in-one business.

mappings.sourceDetail: 提供网络交换硬件和智能系统平台，布局智算交换机及集群交付。
mappings.detailEn: Provide network switching hardware and intelligent system platforms, deploy intelligent computing switches and cluster delivery.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司智算业务提供规划、集成交付、运维以及算力验证调优等服务。
mappings.detailEn: The company's intelligent computing business provides services such as planning, integrated delivery, operation and maintenance, and computing power verification and optimization.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司 AI 算力业务主要围绕为客户提供算力租赁服务展开，已完全实现以云交付方式为客户提供 AI 算力产品。公司已组建一支涵盖 AI 算力硬件、云平台软件、解决方案交付与营销支持的综合型专业团队，成员大都拥有 GPU 芯片厂商、超算中心、云服务平台及 AI 应用开发公司的从业经历，具备丰富的算力项目跨平台系统设计、部署实施及与客户对接服务的经验，可自主研发算力业务所需技术，完全具备境内外 AI 算力资源提供相关的技术服务能力。目前，公司的技服维保业务已成为独立业务品种面向市场提供专业服务。主要产品为：液晶电视精密金属冲压结构件、底座、模具及电子元器件等。作为液晶电视精密金属结构件的规模化生产企业，公司主要和 TCL、海信、三星、小米、创维、索尼、康佳、长虹、海尔等电视品牌厂商及鸿海精密、京东方、兆驰、惠科、冠捷等电视代工厂商进行合作，提供液晶电视金属结构件产品的从设计（包括整机设计）到开模、精密冲压制造、表面处理、组装、物流配送的全流程服务，新产品开发、试制、快速量产能力较强；公司电子元器件产品主要提供给海信、英飞特、新华三、欧司朗和联影医疗等客户，用于电视机、LED 照明、传感器、医疗器械及国防科工等产品中。产业链跟踪重点为：通过自有与长协算力开展GPU云和算力租赁业务。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's AI computing power business mainly focuses on providing customers with computing power rental services, and has fully realized the provision of AI computing power products to customers through cloud delivery. The company has established a comprehensive professional team covering AI computing hardware, cloud platform software, solution delivery and marketing support. Most of the members have working experience in GPU chip manufacturers, supercomputing centers, cloud service platforms and AI application development companies. They have extensive experience in cross-platform system design, deployment and implementation of computing power projects and customer docking services. They can independently develop the technology required for computing power business and are fully equipped with the relevant technical service capabilities to provide domestic and overseas AI computing power resources. At present, the company's technical service and maintenance business has become an independent business offering professional services to the market. The main products are: LCD TV precision metal stamping structural parts, bases, molds and electronic components, etc. As a large-scale manufacturer of precision metal structural parts for LCD TVs, the company mainly TV brand manufacturers such as TCL, Hisense, Samsung, Xiaomi, Skyworth, Sony, Konka, Changhong, and Haier cooperate with TV OEMs such as Hon Hai Precision, BOE, Zhaochi, Huike, and TPV to provide LCD TV metal structural parts products from design (including complete machine design) to development It provides full-process services of molds, precision stamping manufacturing, surface treatment, assembly, and logistics distribution, and has strong capabilities in new product development, trial production, and rapid mass production. The company's electronic component products are mainly provided to customers such as Hisense, Inventronics, H3C, Osram, and United Imaging Healthcare, and are used in TVs, LEDs, etc. In products such as lighting, sensors, medical equipment, and national defense science and industry. The focus of industry chain tracking is: developing GPU cloud and computing power leasing business through its own and long-term cooperative computing power.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司已形成AI算力云业务，国内通过服务器及软件资源搭建服务系统向客户提供算力云服务。
mappings.detailEn: The company has formed an AI computing power cloud business, and provides computing power cloud services to customers in China by building a service system with server and software resources.

mappings.sourceDetail: 通过自有与长协算力开展GPU云和算力租赁业务。
mappings.detailEn: Carry out GPU cloud and computing power leasing business through its own and long-term cooperative computing power.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司目前重点发展电子化学品业务，主要涵盖半导体材料与显示面板材料两大领域：半导体材料包括半导体光刻胶、CMP 抛光垫、高纯溶剂 EBR 等产品；显示面板材料包括显示面板光刻胶、有机绝缘膜及发光材料等产品。公司从事的主要业务及市场地位 1、电子化学品业务 （1）光刻胶光刻胶是光刻中使用的必需材料，而光刻是半导体和显示面板制造过程中的主要工序之一。作为光刻工艺的核心耗材，光刻胶不仅是半导体制造中精度要求最高的关键材料之一，其性能更是直接决定了线宽尺寸与光刻质量，在整个工艺链条中具有不可替代的作用。公司生产的酚醛树脂属于特种橡胶助剂，主要应用于汽车及轮胎领域。公司的经营模式报告期内公司经营模式未发生变化，具体请参阅产品与生产-主要经营模式。产业链跟踪重点为：旗下北京科华为国内半导体光刻胶核心供应商，G线光刻胶公开份额达到60%。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is currently focusing on the development of electronic chemicals business, which mainly covers the two fields of semiconductor materials and display panel materials: semiconductor materials include semiconductor photoresist, CMP polishing pad, high-purity solvent EBR and other products; display panel materials include display panel photoresist, organic insulating film and luminescent materials. The company's main business and market position 1. Electronic chemicals business (1) Photoresist Photoresist is a necessary material used in photolithography, and photolithography is one of the main processes in the manufacturing process of semiconductors and display panels. As the core consumable of the photolithography process, photoresist is not only one of the key materials with the highest precision requirements in semiconductor manufacturing, but its performance directly determines the line width and photolithography quality, playing an irreplaceable role in the entire process chain. The phenolic resin produced by the company is a special rubber additive and is mainly used in the automotive and tire fields. The company's business model The company's business model has not changed during the reporting period. For details, please refer to Products and Production - Main Business Model. The focus of industry chain tracking is: Beijing Kehua, its subsidiary, is the core supplier of domestic semiconductor photoresist, with a public share of G-line photoresist reaching 60%.

mappings.sourceDetail: 旗下北京科华为国内半导体光刻胶核心供应商，G线光刻胶公开份额达到60%。
mappings.detailEn: Its subsidiary Beijing Kehua is the core supplier of domestic semiconductor photoresist, with a public share of G-line photoresist reaching 60%.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司据此构建了“建设期设备导入+运营期服务深化” 的双轮驱动业务模式，使公司能够在半导体产业不同周期阶段保持相对平稳的营收贡献。报告期内，由公司投资设计并建设运营的国内首座完全国产化、满足 12 英寸晶圆 28 纳米制程要求的半导体级大宗气体供应工厂持续稳定运行，实现了该制程节点国内自主大宗气站零的突破。公司第二座大宗气站已于 2024 年上半年投入运营，客户产能逐步爬坡。在光伏领域，公司湿法制绒设备可覆盖 TOPCon 及 HJT 等主流电池技术路线，为下游客户提供高性能、低成本的湿法工艺解决方案。公司在光传感领域持续为国家电网、中石油、城市管网等领域提供立体监测。产业链跟踪重点为：国内主要半导体湿法清洗设备供应商，按公开收入与市场规模口径份额超过5%。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company has thus built a two-wheel drive business model of "equipment introduction during construction + service deepening during operation", enabling the company to maintain relatively stable revenue contribution in different cycle stages of the semiconductor industry. During the reporting period, the company’s investment, design, construction and operation of China’s first fully domestically produced semiconductor-grade bulk gas supply plant that meets the requirements of the 12-inch wafer 28nm process continued to operate stably, achieving a breakthrough in domestic independent bulk gas stations at this process node. The company's second bulk gas station has been put into operation in the first half of 2024, and customer production capacity has gradually increased. In the field of photovoltaics, the company's wet texturing equipment can cover mainstream battery technology routes such as TOPCon and HJT, providing downstream customers with high-performance, low-cost wet process solutions. In the field of optical sensing, the company continues to provide three-dimensional monitoring for the State Grid, PetroChina, urban pipe networks and other fields. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: the major domestic semiconductor wet cleaning equipment suppliers, with a share of more than 5% based on public revenue and market size.

mappings.sourceDetail: 并表子公司波汇经营光通信、光传感及光电子器件，已有营业收入。
mappings.detailEn: Bohui, a consolidated subsidiary, operates optical communications, optical sensing and optoelectronic devices and has generated operating income.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国内主要半导体湿法清洗设备供应商，按公开收入与市场规模口径份额超过5%。
mappings.detailEn: A major domestic supplier of semiconductor wet cleaning equipment, its share exceeds 5% based on public revenue and market size.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要业务包括 IDC 业务、IDC 解决方案业务、 云服务销售业务、智算业务四大类。公司凭借高效的执行能力、杰出的技术水平、丰富的运营经验，以及对数据中心规划设计、投资建设、运营管理的全生命周期的管理优势，成为国内少数获得多家世界级互联网公司认可的专业数据中心服务商，获得了大批量的数据中心项目长期服务合同，短期内实现了业务规模的高速增长。报告期内，公司通过对主营业务进行延伸，针对公司在数据中心领域有较强的建设交付能力及运维托管能力，充分发挥公司技术、运营及供应链管理方面的优势，从而进行业务模式创新；并将公司在规划设计、系统集成、 建设运维和提供增值服务等专业的核心技术能力进行模块化，以此根据不同客户需求提供不同产品组合业务，如设计规划咨询、项目管理、数据中心整体解决方案业务、数据中心改造业务、第三方托管服务等；从而扩展客户群体，拓宽公司业务范围。产业链跟踪重点为：批发型数据中心运营商，服务头部互联网与云客户。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main businesses include four major categories: IDC business, IDC solution business, cloud service sales business, and intelligent computing business. Relying on its efficient execution capabilities, outstanding technical level, rich operational experience, and management advantages in the entire life cycle of data center planning and design, investment and construction, and operation management, the company has become one of the few domestic professional data center service providers recognized by many world-class Internet companies. It has obtained a large number of long-term service contracts for data center projects and achieved rapid growth in business scale in the short term. During the reporting period, the company extended its main business and made full use of its advantages in technology, operations and supply chain management to innovate its business model in view of its strong construction, delivery and operation and maintenance capabilities in the field of data centers; The professional core technical capabilities such as construction, operation and maintenance and the provision of value-added services are modularized to provide different product portfolio services according to different customer needs, such as design and planning consulting, project management, data center overall solution business, data center transformation business, third-party hosting services, etc.; thereby expanding the customer base and broadening the company's business scope. The focus of industry chain tracking is: wholesale data center operators, serving leading Internet and cloud customers.

mappings.sourceDetail: 批发型数据中心运营商，服务头部互联网与云客户。
mappings.detailEn: Wholesale data center operator, serving leading Internet and cloud customers.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，报告期内公司所从事的主要业务公司已完成从“传统基建”向“新基建”的战略转型，主营已全面转向 IDC/AIDC 相关业务。作为一家 IDC 全产业链服务商，将充分发挥 IDC 全产业链、全生命周期业务优势及特点，坚持稳健经营原则，保障在手订单高质量交付，报告期内，公司经营业绩实现大幅减亏，整体经营状况持续改善。公司产品市场地位公司是 IDC 全产业链头部服务商，聚焦“产、建、投、维”四位一体优势，依托镇江制造总部 20 万平米研发生产基地及国家级绿色工厂，通过产品与服务创新，增强各业务间的协同能力，进行降本增效，已与更多优质客户建立长期合作关系，为其提供差异化的价值。报告期内，公司所从事的主要业务、主要产品及其用途、经营模式以及市场地位等未发生重大变化。产业链跟踪重点为：通过香江科技等业务提供IDC建设、系统集成和数据中心服务。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business during the reporting period has completed the strategic transformation from "traditional infrastructure" to "new infrastructure", and its main business has fully shifted to IDC/AIDC related businesses. As an IDC full industry chain service provider, we will give full play to the advantages and characteristics of IDC's full industry chain and full life cycle business, adhere to the principles of sound operations, and ensure high-quality delivery of orders on hand. During the reporting period, the company's operating performance achieved a significant reduction in losses, and the overall operating conditions continued to improve. The company's product market position The company is the leading service provider in the IDC industry chain, focusing on the four-in-one advantage of "production, construction, investment and maintenance". Relying on the 200,000-square-meter R&D and production base of the Zhenjiang manufacturing headquarters and the national green factory, through product and service innovation, it enhances the synergy between various businesses, reduces costs and increases efficiency, and has established long-term cooperative relationships with more high-quality customers to provide them with differentiated value. During the reporting period, there were no major changes in the company's main business, main products and their uses, business model and market position. The focus of industry chain tracking is: providing IDC construction, system integration and data center services through Xiangjiang Technology and other businesses.

mappings.sourceDetail: 通过香江科技等业务提供IDC建设、系统集成和数据中心服务。
mappings.detailEn: Providing IDC construction, system integration and data center services through Xiangjiang Technology and other businesses.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司数据中心配套业务包含低压成套配电设备、配电柜和母线等产品。
mappings.detailEn: The company's data center supporting business includes low-voltage complete sets of power distribution equipment, power distribution cabinets, busbars and other products.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司的主要产品及其用途公司主要产品包括智能应用处理器芯片、数模混合芯片及其他芯片，其中 2025 年智能应用处理器芯片收入 39.27 亿元，占比 89.21%。公司构建了多元化的智能应用处理器芯片平台，并通过开放易用的工具链、深度合作的算法生态以及可快速复用的行业参考设计，建立 “芯片+算法+行业方案”的全栈能力，产品广泛应用于汽车电子、机器视觉、机器人、工业应用、教育办公、商业金融、智能家居、消费电子以及运营商等下游众多领域，是目前国内 AIoT 产品线布局最丰富、客户覆盖范围最广的厂商之一。公司的智能应用处理器芯片通用性强、产品梯队丰富，部分产品还推出工业规格及车用规格等专用版本，具有可靠性高、抗干扰性强等优势。公司自 2018 年以来持续迭代自研 NPU，目前大部分智能应用处理器芯片已内置 NPU 模块。产业链跟踪重点为：端侧AI与SoC平台厂商，受益于AIoT和边缘推理。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main products and their uses. The company's main products include intelligent application processor chips, digital-analog hybrid chips and other chips. In 2025, intelligent application processor chip revenue was 3.927 billion yuan, accounting for 89.21%. The company has built a diversified intelligent application processor chip platform, and established a full-stack capability of "chips + algorithms + industry solutions" through an open and easy-to-use tool chain, an in-depth cooperation algorithm ecosystem, and quickly reusable industry reference designs. The products are widely used in many downstream fields such as automotive electronics, machine vision, robots, industrial applications, education and office, commercial finance, smart homes, consumer electronics, and operators. It is currently one of the manufacturers with the richest AIoT product line layout and the widest customer coverage in China. The company's intelligent application processor chips have strong versatility and rich product lines. Some products also have special versions such as industrial specifications and automotive specifications, which have the advantages of high reliability and strong anti-interference. The company has continued to iteratively develop its own NPU since 2018. Currently, most smart application processor chips have built-in NPU modules. The focus of industry chain tracking is: device-side AI and SoC platform manufacturers, benefiting from AIoT and edge reasoning.

mappings.sourceDetail: 端侧AI与SoC平台厂商，受益于AIoT和边缘推理。
mappings.detailEn: Device-side AI and SoC platform manufacturers benefit from AIoT and edge reasoning.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司产品应用于数据中心机房、通信基站以及其他恒温恒湿等精密环境，公司客户涵盖政府部门以及通信、金融、互联网、医疗、轨道交通、 航空、能源等众多行业。公司产品服务于中国电信、中国联通、中国移动、华为等知名企业，丰富的优质客户资源为公司在业内树立了良好的品牌形象，为公司未来持续稳定发展奠定了坚实的基础。公司主要产品为精密空调设备、机房环境一体化产品，同时公司凭借多年的技术积累和在节能控制方面的领先技术，为客户提供技术服务业务，包括旨在解决老旧数据中心高能耗问题的节能改造服务以及数据中心的运行维护服务等。公司结合企业信用情况、合作时间长短，确定定金比例。产业链跟踪重点为：数据中心精密环境控制设备和解决方案供应商。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's products are used in data center computer rooms, communication base stations and other precision environments with constant temperature and humidity. The company's customers include government departments and many industries such as communications, finance, Internet, medical, rail transit, aviation, energy, etc. The company's products serve well-known enterprises such as China Telecom, China Unicom, China Mobile, and Huawei. The rich and high-quality customer resources have established a good brand image for the company in the industry and laid a solid foundation for the company's sustainable and stable development in the future. The company's main products are precision air-conditioning equipment and integrated computer room environment products. At the same time, the company relies on years of technology accumulation and leading technology in energy-saving control to provide customers with technical services, including energy-saving transformation services aimed at solving the high energy consumption problems of old data centers and data center operation and maintenance services. The company determines the deposit ratio based on the company's credit situation and the length of cooperation. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: data center precision environmental control equipment and solution suppliers.

mappings.sourceDetail: 数据中心精密环境控制设备和解决方案供应商。
mappings.detailEn: Provider of precision environmental control equipment and solutions for data centers.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司产品广泛应用于消费电子、汽车、工业应用、PC 及服务器、物联网、 网络通讯等领域，同时公司为客户提供包括相应算法、 软件在内的一整套系统及解决方案。主要产品及用途公司持续推动产品多元化，优化产品矩阵。公司专用型存储器产品包括闪存芯片（NOR Flash、SLC NAND Flash）和利基型动态随机存取存储器（DRAM）。公司 NOR Flash 产品广泛应用于工业、汽车、消费电子、PC 及服务器、网络通信、物联网及移动设备等各个领域。公司利基型 DRAM 产品包括 DDR3L/DDR4/LPDDR4 等，具备低功耗、体积小的特点，主要应用于机顶盒、电视、网络通讯、 智能家庭装置、智能穿戴、信息娱乐系统等多个领域。产业链跟踪重点为：国产NOR Flash与MCU龙头，覆盖存储和控制芯片。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's products are widely used in consumer electronics, automobiles, industrial applications, PCs and servers, the Internet of Things, network communications and other fields. At the same time, the company provides customers with a complete set of systems and solutions including corresponding algorithms and software. Main products and uses The company continues to promote product diversification and optimize the product matrix. The company's specialized memory products include flash memory chips (NOR Flash, SLC NAND Flash) and niche dynamic random access memory (DRAM). The company's NOR Flash products are widely used in various fields such as industry, automobiles, consumer electronics, PCs and servers, network communications, Internet of Things, and mobile devices. The company's niche DRAM products include DDR3L/DDR4/LPDDR4, etc., which feature low power consumption and small size. They are mainly used in set-top boxes, TVs, network communications, smart home devices, smart wearables, infotainment systems and other fields. The focus of industry chain tracking is: domestic NOR Flash and MCU leaders, covering storage and control chips.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国产NOR Flash与MCU龙头，覆盖存储和控制芯片。
mappings.detailEn: Domestic NOR Flash and MCU leader, covering storage and control chips.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要业务为集成电路芯片设计及销售，不属于国家规定的重污染行业，公司主要采购原材料为晶圆，公司及其子公司均不直接从事生产制造业务，生产经营活动不涉及环境污染情形。在 PCIe 互连技术领域，公司自研的 PCIe SerDes 技术已成功应用于 PCIe Retimer 芯片并实现产业化。公司采用 Fabless 的运营模式，专注于芯片的设计及研发环节，而芯片的生产制造、封装测试则通过委外方式完成。公司已制定完善的产品召回流程，主要包括问题识别与风险评估、召回决策与计划制定、内部沟通与客户通知、供应链溯源与产品回收/隔离、缺陷分析与纠正措施、召回验证与记录。公司定期审查并更新这些制度，为知识产权保护提供了明确、切实可行的执行框架。产业链跟踪重点为：内存接口芯片全球主要供应商，并布局PCIe/CXL互联。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business is the design and sales of integrated circuit chips, which does not belong to the heavily polluting industries specified by the state. The company's main procurement of raw materials is wafers. Neither the company nor its subsidiaries are directly engaged in manufacturing business, and production and operation activities do not involve environmental pollution. In the field of PCIe interconnection technology, the company's self-developed PCIe SerDes technology has been successfully applied to PCIe Retimer chips and achieved industrialization. The company adopts the Fabless operating model and focuses on the design and R&D of chips, while the manufacturing, packaging and testing of chips are completed through outsourcing. The company has developed a complete product recall process, which mainly includes problem identification and risk assessment, recall decision-making and plan formulation, internal communication and customer notification, supply chain traceability and product recovery/isolation, defect analysis and corrective measures, recall verification and recording. The company regularly reviews and updates these systems to provide a clear and practical implementation framework for intellectual property protection. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: the world's major suppliers of memory interface chips, and the layout of PCIe/CXL interconnection.

mappings.sourceDetail: 除DDR/CXL等互联芯片外，公司津逮产品线包含服务器CPU及可信计算相关芯片，形成独立计算产品业务。
mappings.detailEn: In addition to interconnect chips such as DDR/CXL, the company's Jintide product line includes server CPUs and trusted computing related chips, forming an independent computing product business.

mappings.sourceDetail: 内存接口芯片全球主要供应商，并布局PCIe/CXL互联。
mappings.detailEn: It is a major global supplier of memory interface chips and lays out PCIe/CXL interconnections.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，报告期内，公司主要从事高端半导体设备及泛半导体设备的研发、生产和销售。中微公司开发的 CCP 高能等离子体和 ICP 低能等离子体刻蚀两大类、包括二十几种细分刻蚀设备已可以覆盖大多数刻蚀的应用。中微公司的等离子体刻蚀设备已被广泛应用于国内和国际一线客户，从 65 纳米到 3 纳米及更先进工艺的众多刻蚀应用。中微公司开发的用于 LED 和功率器件外延片生产的 MOCVD 设备早已在客户生产线上投入量产，并在全球氮化镓基 LED MOCVD 设备市场占据领先地位。公司主要为集成电路、LED 外延片、功率器件、MEMS 等半导体产品的制造企业提供刻蚀设备、薄膜沉积设备、MOCVD 设备及其他设备，其中主要产品的具体情况如下： 报告期内，公司主营业务未发生变化。产业链跟踪重点为：刻蚀与薄膜沉积设备龙头，产品进入先进制程。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, during the reporting period, the company was mainly engaged in the research and development, production and sales of high-end semiconductor equipment and pan-semiconductor equipment. The two categories of CCP high-energy plasma and ICP low-energy plasma etching developed by China Microelectronics Corporation, including more than 20 subdivided etching equipment, can cover most etching applications. AMEC's ​​plasma etching equipment has been widely used by domestic and international first-line customers for numerous etching applications from 65nm to 3nm and more advanced processes. The MOCVD equipment developed by AMEC for the production of LED and power device epitaxial wafers has already been put into mass production on customer production lines, and has taken a leading position in the global gallium nitride-based LED MOCVD equipment market. The company mainly provides etching equipment, thin film deposition equipment, MOCVD equipment and other equipment for manufacturing companies of integrated circuits, LED epitaxial wafers, power devices, MEMS and other semiconductor products. The details of the main products are as follows: During the reporting period, the company's main business did not change. The focus of the industrial chain tracking is: leading etching and thin film deposition equipment, and products entering advanced processes.

mappings.sourceDetail: 刻蚀与薄膜沉积设备龙头，产品进入先进制程。
mappings.detailEn: A leader in etching and thin film deposition equipment, its products have entered advanced manufacturing processes.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主营业务为关键半导体材料的研发和产业化，目前产品包括不同系列的化学机械抛光液、 功能性湿电子化学品和电镀液及添加剂系列产品，主要应用于集成电路制造和先进封装领域。公司化学机械抛光液产品已涵盖铜及铜阻挡层抛光液、介电材料抛光液、钨抛光液、基于氧化铈磨料的抛光液、 金属栅极抛光液及衬底抛光液等多个产品平台。目前，公司功能性湿电子化学品主要包括刻蚀后清洗液、晶圆级封装用光刻胶剥离液、抛光后清洗液、刻蚀液等产品。目前，先进封装用电镀液及添加剂已有多款产品实现量产销售，应用于凸点、重布线层（RDL）、异质集成技术；集成电路制造领域的大马士革工艺铜电镀液及添加剂已进入量产阶段，实现销售，先进封装锡银电镀液及添加剂以及硅通孔电镀液及添加剂开发及验证按计划进行。公司产品已成功应用于逻辑芯片、存储芯片、模拟芯片、功率器件、传感器、第三代半导体及其他特色工艺芯片，并已进入众多半导体行业领先客户的主流供应商行列。产业链跟踪重点为：国产CMP抛光液与功能性湿电子化学品龙头。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business is the research and development and industrialization of key semiconductor materials. Its current products include different series of chemical mechanical polishing fluids, functional wet electronic chemicals and electroplating fluids and additive series products, which are mainly used in integrated circuit manufacturing and advanced packaging fields. The company's chemical mechanical polishing slurry products cover multiple product platforms such as copper and copper barrier polishing slurries, dielectric material polishing slurries, tungsten polishing slurries, cerium oxide abrasive-based polishing slurries, metal gate polishing slurries and substrate polishing slurries. At present, the company's functional wet electronic chemicals mainly include post-etching cleaning fluids, photoresist stripping fluids for wafer-level packaging, post-polishing cleaning fluids, etching fluids and other products. At present, a number of plating solutions and additives for advanced packaging have been mass-produced and sold, and are used in bumps, redistribution layers (RDL), and heterogeneous integration technologies. Damascus process copper plating solutions and additives in the field of integrated circuit manufacturing have entered the mass production stage and have been sold. The development and verification of advanced packaging tin-silver plating solutions and additives and through-silicon hole plating solutions and additives are proceeding as planned. The company's products have been successfully used in logic chips, memory chips, analog chips, power devices, sensors, third-generation semiconductors and other specialty process chips, and have entered the ranks of mainstream suppliers to many leading customers in the semiconductor industry. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: domestic CMP polishing fluid and functional wet electronic chemical leader.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国产CMP抛光液与功能性湿电子化学品龙头。
mappings.detailEn: Domestic leader in CMP polishing fluids and functional wet electronic chemicals.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司成立于 2002 年，主要从事半导体专用设备的研发、生产和销售，产品主要包括光刻工序涂胶显影设备、单片式湿法设备。公司单片湿法设备包括清洗机、 去胶机、刻蚀机等湿法类设备，可广泛应用于来料清洗、TSV 深孔清洗、Flux 清洗等清洗、去胶及 lift-off 剥离工艺及多种介质层湿法刻蚀工艺。产业链跟踪重点为：前道涂胶显影设备国内市场份额约10%，为国内量产型核心供应商。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company was founded in 2002 and is mainly engaged in the research and development, production and sales of semiconductor-specific equipment. Its products mainly include photolithography process glue coating and development equipment and monolithic wet-process equipment. The company's single-wafer wet equipment includes cleaning machines, degumming machines, etching machines and other wet equipment, which can be widely used in incoming material cleaning, TSV deep hole cleaning, flux cleaning and other cleaning, degumming and lift-off stripping processes, as well as various dielectric layer wet etching processes. The focus of industry chain tracking is: the domestic market share of front-end coating and development equipment is about 10%, and it is a core supplier of domestic mass production.

mappings.sourceDetail: 前道涂胶显影设备国内市场份额约10%，为国内量产型核心供应商。
mappings.detailEn: The domestic market share of front-end glue coating and development equipment is about 10%, and it is a core supplier of domestic mass production.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司的产品包括海光通用处理器（CPU）和海光协处理器（DCU）。报告期内，公司产品性能持续提升，研发项目进展顺利，研发团队在高端处理器设计、验证等关键技术领域不断实现突破。公司高端处理器产品以其在功能、性能、生态和安全方面的独特优势，树立了良好的口碑，进一步夯实了产品在国内的领先地位，扩大了市场竞争力和品牌影响力。主要产品情况高端处理器作为现代信息系统设备中的核心部件，在大规模数据处理、复杂任务调度和逻辑运算等方面发挥了不可替代的作用。产业链跟踪重点为：国产高端处理器与DCU核心厂商，形成CPU+算力芯片产品体系。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's products include Haiguang general-purpose processor (CPU) and Haiguang co-processor (DCU). During the reporting period, the company's product performance continued to improve, R&D projects progressed smoothly, and the R&D team continued to achieve breakthroughs in key technical areas such as high-end processor design and verification. The company's high-end processor products have established a good reputation with their unique advantages in function, performance, ecology and security, further consolidating the product's leading position in the country and expanding market competitiveness and brand influence. Main products: As the core component of modern information system equipment, high-end processors play an irreplaceable role in large-scale data processing, complex task scheduling and logical operations. The focus of industry chain tracking is: Domestic high-end processors and DCU core manufacturers form a CPU + computing power chip product system.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国产高端处理器与DCU核心厂商，形成CPU+算力芯片产品体系。
mappings.detailEn: Domestic high-end processor and DCU core manufacturers form a CPU+computing power chip product system.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主营处理器及配套芯片的研制、销售和技术服务，并提供基础软硬件解决方案。产品以龙芯自主指令系统为基础，覆盖面向服务器和个人计算机的处理器、面向工控和嵌入式设备的芯片，以及桥片和安全模块等配套芯片，应用于政企终端、服务器、工业控制、网络通信和信息化设备。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is mainly engaged in the development, sales and technical services of processors and supporting chips, and provides basic software and hardware solutions. The products are based on the Loongson independent command system, covering processors for servers and personal computers, chips for industrial control and embedded equipment, as well as supporting chips such as bridge chips and security modules, and are used in government and enterprise terminals, servers, industrial control, network communications and information equipment.

mappings.sourceDetail: 自主指令系统CPU厂商，覆盖桌面、服务器与工控场景。
mappings.detailEn: Independent command system CPU manufacturer, covering desktop, server and industrial control scenarios.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，报告期内，公司积极把握半导体芯片技术迭代升级与国产替代的发展机遇，依托深厚的技术储备及前瞻性的产业格局，积极拓展应用于集成电路先进制程领域的新产品、新工艺，目前已构建了较为完善的薄膜沉积设备、三维集成设备的产品矩阵。主要产品情况公司目前已形成 PECVD、ALD、SACVD、HDPCVD、Flowable CVD 等薄膜沉积设备产品，以及晶圆对晶圆混合键合、晶圆对晶圆熔融键合、芯片对晶圆混合键合等三维集成设备产品，已广泛应用于逻辑芯片、存储芯片、功率器件、Micro-OLED、硅光技术、图像传感器（CIS）等领域。公司 UV Cure 产品具体情况如下： 主要产品型号产品图片产品应用情况 PF-300T Upsilon 主要应用于集成电路芯片制造领域。公司 PE-ALD 产品具体情况如下： 主要产品型号产品图片产品应用情况 PF-300T Astra 主要应用于集成电路逻辑芯片、存储制造及先进封装领域，可以沉积高温、低温、 高质量的 SiO2、SiN、SiCO 等介质薄膜材料。产业链跟踪重点为：国产薄膜沉积设备核心厂商，覆盖PECVD、ALD等产品。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, during the reporting period, the company actively seized the development opportunities of iterative upgrades of semiconductor chip technology and domestic substitution, relied on its deep technical reserves and forward-looking industrial structure, and actively expanded new products and new processes applied in the field of advanced integrated circuit processes. Currently, it has built a relatively complete product matrix of thin film deposition equipment and three-dimensional integration equipment. Main product information The company has currently formed PECVD, ALD, SACVD, HDPCVD, Flowable CVD and other thin film deposition equipment products, as well as three-dimensional integrated equipment products such as wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding, wafer-to-wafer fusion bonding, chip-to-wafer hybrid bonding, etc., which have been widely used in logic chips, memory chips, power devices, Micro-OLED, silicon light technology, image sensors (CIS) and other fields. The details of the company's UV Cure products are as follows: Main product models Product pictures Product application PF-300T Upsilon is mainly used in the field of integrated circuit chip manufacturing. The details of the company's PE-ALD products are as follows: Main product models Product pictures Product application PF-300T Astra is mainly used in the fields of integrated circuit logic chips, storage manufacturing and advanced packaging. It can deposit high-temperature, low-temperature, high-quality dielectric film materials such as SiO2, SiN, and SiCO. The focus of industry chain tracking is: core manufacturers of domestic thin film deposition equipment, covering PECVD, ALD and other products.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国产薄膜沉积设备核心厂商，覆盖PECVD、ALD等产品。
mappings.detailEn: A core manufacturer of domestic thin film deposition equipment, covering PECVD, ALD and other products.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司经过多年持续的研发投入和技术积累，先后开发了前道半导体工艺设备，包括清洗设备、 半导体电镀设备、立式炉管系列设备、涂胶显影 Track 设备、等离子体增强化学气相沉积 PECVD 设备、无应力抛光设备；后道晶圆级先进封装工艺设备、面板级先进封装设备；以及硅材料衬底制造工艺设备等。公司自主研发的 SAPS 兆声波技术采用扇形兆声波发生器，通过精确匹配晶圆旋转速度、液膜厚度、兆声波发生器的位置、交变位移及能量等关键工艺参数，通过在工艺中控制兆声波发生器和晶圆之间的半波长范围的相对运动，使晶圆上每一点在工艺时间内接收到的兆声波能量都相同，从而很好的控制了兆声波能量在晶圆表面的均匀分布。公司 TEBO 清洗设备，在器件结构从 2D 转换为 3D 的技术转移中，可应用于更为精细的具有 3D 结构的 FinFET、DRAM 和新兴 3D NAND 等产品，以及未来新型纳米器件和量子器件等，在提高客户产品良率方面发挥越来越重要的作用。产业链跟踪重点为：半导体清洗设备龙头，产品线向电镀与炉管扩展。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, after years of continuous R&D investment and technology accumulation, the company has developed front-end semiconductor process equipment, including cleaning equipment, semiconductor electroplating equipment, vertical furnace tube series equipment, glue coating and development Track equipment, plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition PECVD equipment, stress-free polishing equipment; back-end wafer-level advanced packaging process equipment, panel-level advanced packaging equipment; and silicon material substrate manufacturing process equipment. The SAPS megasonic technology independently developed by the company uses a sector-shaped megasonic generator. By accurately matching key process parameters such as wafer rotation speed, liquid film thickness, position of the megasonic generator, alternating displacement and energy, and by controlling the relative motion in the half-wavelength range between the megasonic generator and the wafer during the process, every point on the wafer receives the same megasonic energy during the process time, thereby well controlling the uniform distribution of megasonic energy on the wafer surface. The company's TEBO cleaning equipment, in the technology transfer of converting device structures from 2D to 3D, can be applied to products such as FinFET, DRAM and emerging 3D NAND with more refined 3D structures, as well as new nano-devices and quantum devices in the future, playing an increasingly important role in improving customer product yields. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: the leader in semiconductor cleaning equipment, and the product line has expanded to electroplating and furnace tubes.

mappings.sourceDetail: 半导体清洗设备龙头，产品线向电镀与炉管扩展。
mappings.detailEn: A leader in semiconductor cleaning equipment, its product line has expanded to electroplating and furnace tubes.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要业务公司是全球布局的无晶圆半导体系统设计厂商，面向智慧家庭、智慧办公、智慧出行、 娱乐教育、工业生产场景，提供卓越而领先的智能终端控制与连接解决方案，包括智能多媒体与显示 SoC 主控芯片、AIoT SoC 主控芯片、通信与连接芯片、智能汽车 SoC 芯片等，致力于赋能全球智能终端从万物互联走向万物智联。公司自成立以来即聚焦于具备高系统复杂性和多维度叠加技术的系统级 SoC 芯片，已深耕 SoC 芯片设计 30 年，形成覆盖神经网络处理器 NPU、视频编解码器、音频解码器、显示控制器、内存系统、安全系统、广域网╱局域网网络接口、输入输出子系统等多功能模块高度全栈自研技术矩阵，可广泛适配多元智能终端场景需求。公司业务布局全球，在 To B 端，已与全球各主要经济区域近 270 家运营商建立合作关系，在 To C 端，已与多家全球知名消费电子客户深度合作，并不断推出新产品。产业链跟踪重点为：家庭智能终端SoC全球市场份额17.7%，芯片集成NPU并覆盖AIoT与边缘计算场景。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business is a fabless semiconductor system design manufacturer with a global presence. It provides excellent and leading intelligent terminal control and connection solutions for smart homes, smart offices, smart travel, entertainment education, and industrial production scenarios, including intelligent multimedia and display SoC main control chips, AIoT SoC main control chips, communication and connection chips, smart car SoC chips, etc., and is committed to empowering global smart terminals to move from the Internet of Everything to the Intelligent Internet of Everything. Since its establishment, the company has focused on system-level SoC chips with high system complexity and multi-dimensional overlay technology. It has been deeply involved in SoC chip design for 30 years, forming a highly full-stack self-developed technology matrix covering multi-functional modules such as neural network processors NPU, video codecs, audio decoders, display controllers, memory systems, security systems, WAN/LAN network interfaces, input and output subsystems, etc., which can be widely adapted to the needs of diverse intelligent terminal scenarios. The company's business is spread all over the world. On the To B side, it has established cooperative relationships with nearly 270 operators in major economic regions around the world. On the To C side, it has in-depth cooperation with many world-renowned consumer electronics customers and continues to launch new products. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: the global market share of home smart terminal SoC is 17.7%, the chip integrates NPU and covers AIoT and edge computing scenarios.

mappings.sourceDetail: 家庭智能终端SoC全球市场份额17.7%，芯片集成NPU并覆盖AIoT与边缘计算场景。
mappings.detailEn: The global market share of home smart terminal SoC is 17.7%. The chip integrates NPU and covers AIoT and edge computing scenarios.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司从事特种气体和大宗气体的研发、生产、销售与综合供气服务。半导体相关产品包括超纯氨、高纯氧化亚氮、电子级正硅酸乙酯、高纯二氧化碳和高纯氢等电子特气，以及氮、氧、氩、氦等电子大宗载气，可通过现场制气、管道供气和瓶装配送等方式服务晶圆制造及泛半导体客户。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is engaged in the research and development, production, sales and comprehensive gas supply services of special gases and bulk gases. Semiconductor-related products include ultrapure ammonia, high-purity nitrous oxide, electronic-grade ethyl orthosilicate, high-purity carbon dioxide and high-purity hydrogen and other electronic specialty gases, as well as electronic bulk carrier gases such as nitrogen, oxygen, argon and helium. They can serve wafer manufacturing and pan-semiconductor customers through on-site gas production, pipeline gas supply and bottled distribution.

mappings.sourceDetail: 气体供应商，电子特气及电子大宗载气业务服务半导体生产。
mappings.detailEn: Gas supplier, electronic specialty gas and electronic bulk carrier gas business services semiconductor production.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司致力于用独立自主的知识产权、稳定的供应链体系和高可靠性的产品为客户提供高品质的存储产品及服务。公司主要产品涵盖非易失性存储芯片 NAND Flash、 NOR Flash，易失性存储芯片 DRAM 及衍生产品 MCP。公司 NAND Flash 产品种类丰富，兼具低功耗与高可靠性优势，已通过联发科、瑞芯微、 中兴微、博通等主流平台厂商的验证认可，广泛应用于通讯设备（如 5G 模块、光猫）、企业级网关、智能监控、数字录像机、录音笔、词典笔、智能穿戴（手表、手环、AI 眼镜）、汽车电子及机器人等终端产品。公司聚焦平面型 SLC NAND Flash 的设计与研发，主要产品采用浮栅型工艺结构，制程工艺持续演进至 1xnm 先进水平。公司的 NAND MCP 产品集成了自主研发的低功耗 1.8V SLC NAND Flash 与低功耗 DRAM，凭借设计优势已在紫光展锐、高通、联发科等主流平台通过认证，广泛应用于功能手机、MIFI、 通讯模块等终端产品。产业链跟踪重点为：提供NAND Flash、NOR Flash、DRAM及MCP，覆盖网络通信与工业存储需求。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is committed to providing customers with high-quality storage products and services using independent intellectual property rights, a stable supply chain system and high-reliability products. The company's main products include non-volatile memory chips NAND Flash and NOR Flash, volatile memory chips DRAM and derivative products MCP. The company's NAND Flash products are rich in variety and have the advantages of low power consumption and high reliability. They have been verified and approved by mainstream platform manufacturers such as MediaTek, Rockchip, ZTE Micro, Broadcom, etc., and are widely used in communication equipment (such as 5G modules, optical modems), enterprise-level gateways, intelligent surveillance, digital video recorders, recording pens, dictionary pens, smart wearables (watches, bracelets, AI glasses), automotive electronics and robots and other terminal products. The company focuses on the design and development of planar SLC NAND Flash. Its main products adopt floating gate process structures, and the process technology continues to evolve to the 1xnm advanced level. The company's NAND MCP products integrate self-developed low-power 1.8V SLC NAND Flash and low-power DRAM. With its design advantages, it has been certified on mainstream platforms such as Unisoc, Qualcomm, and MediaTek, and is widely used in terminal products such as feature phones, MIFI, and communication modules. The focus of industry chain tracking is: providing NAND Flash, NOR Flash, DRAM and MCP, covering network communication and industrial storage needs.

mappings.sourceDetail: 提供NAND Flash、NOR Flash、DRAM及MCP，覆盖网络通信与工业存储需求。
mappings.detailEn: Provide NAND Flash, NOR Flash, DRAM and MCP, covering network communication and industrial storage needs.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要从事半导体专用装备的研发、生产、销售及技术服务，根据中国证监会颁布的《上市公司行业分类指引（2012 年修订）》，公司属于专用设备制造业（行业代码：C35）。公司是一家拥有核心自主知识产权的高端半导体装备供应商，主要产品包括 CMP 装备、减薄装备、离子注入装备、划切装备、边缘抛光装备、湿法装备、晶圆再生、关键耗材与维保服务等，已广泛应用于集成电路、先进封装、大硅片、第三代半导体、MEMS、MicroLED 等制造工艺，基本实现了“装备+服务”的平台化战略布局。公司 CMP 装备凭借自主知识产权打破国际垄断，构建了覆盖 12 英寸、8 英寸等全系列产品矩阵，是国内极少数实现 12 英寸 CMP 装备规模化量产的企业。作为公司平台化战略的核心增长极，公司通过收购芯嵛公司实现离子注入技术跨越式布局，依托技术自主研发与整合，持续完善产品体系。产业链跟踪重点为：国产CMP设备龙头，并拓展减薄和湿法设备。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is mainly engaged in the research and development, production, sales and technical services of semiconductor special equipment. According to the "Industry Classification Guidelines for Listed Companies (Revised in 2012)" promulgated by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the company belongs to the special equipment manufacturing industry (industry code: C35). The company is a high-end semiconductor equipment supplier with core independent intellectual property rights. Its main products include CMP equipment, thinning equipment, ion implantation equipment, dicing equipment, edge polishing equipment, wet equipment, wafer regeneration, key consumables and maintenance services, etc., which have been widely used in integrated circuits, advanced packaging, large silicon wafers, third-generation semiconductors, MEMS, MicroLED and other manufacturing processes, basically realizing the platform strategic layout of "equipment + services". The company's CMP equipment has broken the international monopoly by virtue of its independent intellectual property rights and has built a product matrix covering a full range of 12-inch and 8-inch products. It is one of the few domestic companies that has achieved large-scale mass production of 12-inch CMP equipment. As the core growth pole of the company's platform strategy, the company has achieved a leap-forward layout of ion implantation technology through the acquisition of Xinyuan Company, relying on independent technology research and development and integration to continue to improve the product system. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: leading domestic CMP equipment, and expanding thinning and wet processing equipment.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国产CMP设备龙头，并拓展减薄和湿法设备。
mappings.detailEn: The leader in domestically produced CMP equipment, and expands thinning and wet processing equipment.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司除CMP等设备外，经营晶圆再生业务，向制造环节提供再生晶圆及相关服务。
mappings.detailEn: In addition to CMP and other equipment, the company operates wafer regeneration business and provides regenerated wafers and related services to the manufacturing process.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司目前拥有存储类芯片、混合信号类芯片和 NFC 芯片三条主要产品线，产品广泛应用于存储模组、智能手机、汽车电子、工业控制、 物联网及可穿戴设备、白色家电、通信设备和医疗仪器等众多领域。主要产品情况 （1）存储类芯片 1）存储模组配套芯片公司是全球领先的存储模组配套芯片供应商，自 DDR2 世代起即研发并销售内存模组配套芯片，目前拥有配套 DDR2/3/4/5 内存模组的全系列 SPD 芯片（串行检测集线器）、TS 芯片（温度传感器）产品组合。公司的 EEPROM 产品线主要包括 I2C、SPI 和 Microwire 等标准接口的全系列 EEPROM 芯片，具有高可靠性、宽电压、高兼容性、低功耗等特点，常温条件下的耐擦写次数高达 400 万次，数据存储时间长达 200 年，产品性能代表了行业最高技术水平，并广泛应用于智能手机、液晶面板、蓝牙模块、AI 眼镜和白色家电等众多领域。产业链跟踪重点为：2024年全球EEPROM市场份额约14%，并在DDR5 SPD芯片市场占据重要地位。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company currently has three main product lines: storage chips, mixed-signal chips and NFC chips. The products are widely used in many fields such as storage modules, smartphones, automotive electronics, industrial control, Internet of Things and wearable devices, white goods, communication equipment and medical instruments. Main product information (1) Storage chips 1) Storage module supporting chips The company is the world's leading supplier of storage module supporting chips. It has developed and sold memory module supporting chips since the DDR2 generation. It currently has a full range of SPD chips (serial detection hubs) and TS chips (temperature sensors) supporting DDR2/3/4/5 memory modules. The company's EEPROM product line mainly includes a full range of EEPROM chips with standard interfaces such as I2C, SPI and Microwire. It has the characteristics of high reliability, wide voltage, high compatibility, low power consumption, etc., with an endurance of up to 4 million erasing and writing times under normal temperature conditions, and a data storage time of up to 200 years. The product performance represents the highest technical level in the industry, and is widely used in many fields such as smartphones, LCD panels, Bluetooth modules, AI glasses, and white appliances. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: the global EEPROM market share will be approximately 14% in 2024, and it will occupy an important position in the DDR5 SPD chip market.

mappings.sourceDetail: 2024年全球EEPROM市场份额约14%，并在DDR5 SPD芯片市场占据重要地位。
mappings.detailEn: In 2024, the global EEPROM market share will be approximately 14%, and it will occupy an important position in the DDR5 SPD chip market.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司作为国内规模最大、技术最全面、国际化程度最高的半导体硅片企业之一，多年来深耕半导体基础材料领域，主营业务聚焦于半导体硅片及其他高端半导体材料的研发、生产与销售，为下游芯片制造企业提供关键核心材料，是半导体产业链中不可或缺的基础性环节。公司始终将扩大生产规模、丰富产品结构、提高市场占有率作为核心发展战略，持续推进技术突破与产能扩张，助力国内半导体产业链自主可控。公司现已构建起全尺寸、全品类的半导体硅片产品矩阵，覆盖 300mm、200mm 及以下等尺寸，涵盖抛光片、外延片、SOI 硅片等品类，同时布局压电薄膜衬底材料等异质晶圆特色产品，广泛应用于存储、逻辑、硅光、图像处理、通用处理器、功率、射频、模拟、分立等芯片制造，全面满足下游不同领域的应用需求。公司构建了全球化、多元化的客户体系，覆盖国际一流与国内主流芯片制造企业。产业链跟踪重点为：国内大尺寸半导体硅片平台型企业。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company, as one of the largest, most technologically comprehensive and most international semiconductor silicon wafer companies in the country, has been deeply involved in the field of semiconductor basic materials for many years. Its main business focuses on the research and development, production and sales of semiconductor silicon wafers and other high-end semiconductor materials. It provides key core materials for downstream chip manufacturing companies and is an indispensable basic link in the semiconductor industry chain. The company has always regarded expanding production scale, enriching product structure, and increasing market share as its core development strategy, and continues to promote technological breakthroughs and production capacity expansion to help the domestic semiconductor industry chain to be independently controllable. The company has now built a full-size and full-category semiconductor silicon wafer product matrix, covering sizes of 300mm, 200mm and below, covering polished wafers, epitaxial wafers, SOI silicon wafers and other categories. At the same time, the company has deployed heterogeneous wafer specialty products such as piezoelectric film substrate materials, which are widely used in memory, logic, silicon light, image processing, general processor, power, radio frequency, simulation, discrete and other chip manufacturing, fully meeting the application needs of different downstream fields. The company has built a global and diversified customer system, covering world-class and domestic mainstream chip manufacturing companies. The focus of industry chain tracking is: domestic large-size semiconductor silicon wafer platform enterprises.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国内大尺寸半导体硅片平台型企业。
mappings.detailEn: A domestic large-size semiconductor wafer platform enterprise.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司生产的掩膜版产品根据基板材质的不同主要可分为石英掩膜版、苏打掩膜版。产品主要应用于平板显示、半导体芯片、触控、电路板等行业，是下游行业产品制程中的关键工具。公司掩膜版产品主要应用的下游行业和相关客户情况如下： 平板显示行业掩膜版包括薄膜晶体管液晶显示器（TFT-LCD）掩膜版含阵列（Array）掩膜版 （a-Si/LTPS 技术）及彩色滤光片（CF）掩膜版、有源矩阵有机发光二极管显示器（AMOLED） 掩膜版、超扭曲向列型液晶显示器（STN-LCD）掩膜版和 Fine Metal Mask（FMM）掩膜版、 MicroLED 显示掩膜版和 Micro OLED 显示掩膜版等。产业链跟踪重点为：掩膜版供应商，半导体产品用于芯片制造及封装相关光刻环节。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the mask products produced by the company can be mainly divided into quartz masks and soda masks according to different substrate materials. Products are mainly used in flat panel displays, semiconductor chips, touch, circuit boards and other industries, and are key tools in the product manufacturing process of downstream industries. The main downstream industries and related customers of the company's mask products are as follows: Flat panel display industry masks include thin film transistor liquid crystal display (TFT-LCD) masks including array (Array) masks (a-Si/LTPS technology) and color filter (CF) masks, active matrix organic light-emitting diode display (AMOLED) masks, super twisted nematic liquid crystal display (STN-LCD) masks and Fine Metal masks Mask (FMM) mask, MicroLED display mask, Micro OLED display mask, etc. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: mask suppliers, semiconductor products are used in chip manufacturing and packaging-related lithography links.

mappings.sourceDetail: 掩膜版供应商，半导体产品用于芯片制造及封装相关光刻环节。
mappings.detailEn: Mask supplier, semiconductor products are used in chip manufacturing and packaging-related photolithography processes.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要从事电子特种气体及三氟甲磺酸系列产品的研发、生产和销售，在此基础上，2025 年公司持续拓展高纯金属业务，持续推进前驱体产品的研发和产业化，完成大宗现场制气业务的并购整合，丰富公司的业务类型。主要产品具体如下： 1.电子特种气体电子特种气体广泛应用于集成电路、显示面板等行业中光刻、刻蚀、成膜、清洗、掺杂、沉积等工艺环节，对于纯度、稳定性、包装容器等具有较高的要求。公司高纯乙烯、乙炔产品纯度分别可达 5N、3N5,电子级乙烯主要应用于大规模集成电路沉积工艺，生成具有多孔结构的低介电常数薄膜，电子级乙炔主要应用于大规模集成电路光刻工艺中，用于制备碳掩膜。公司在邯郸、内蒙古设有空分工厂和液氦分装产线，拥 150 吨/年的液氦分装能力，可为客户提供液体及瓶装气产品，解决客户储存、气化、调压、纯化、过滤等整体供气解决方案。产业链跟踪重点为：电子特种气体供应商，参与晶圆制造所需工艺气体配套。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is mainly engaged in the research and development, production and sales of electronic specialty gases and trifluoromethanesulfonic acid series products. On this basis, the company will continue to expand its high-purity metal business in 2025, continue to promote the research and development and industrialization of precursor products, complete the merger and integration of bulk on-site gas production business, and enrich the company's business types. The main products are as follows: 1. Electronic specialty gases Electronic specialty gases are widely used in photolithography, etching, film formation, cleaning, doping, deposition and other process links in integrated circuits, display panels and other industries. They have high requirements for purity, stability, packaging containers, etc. The purity of the company's high-purity ethylene and acetylene products can reach 5N and 3N5 respectively. Electronic-grade ethylene is mainly used in the deposition process of large-scale integrated circuits to generate low dielectric constant films with porous structures. Electronic-grade acetylene is mainly used in the photolithography process of large-scale integrated circuits to prepare carbon masks. The company has air separation plants and liquid helium packaging production lines in Handan and Inner Mongolia, with a liquid helium packaging capacity of 150 tons/year. It can provide customers with liquid and bottled gas products and provide customers with overall gas supply solutions such as storage, vaporization, pressure regulation, purification, and filtration. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: electronic specialty gas suppliers, participating in the matching of process gases required for wafer manufacturing.

mappings.sourceDetail: 电子特种气体供应商，参与晶圆制造所需工艺气体配套。
mappings.detailEn: Electronic specialty gas supplier, involved in supporting process gases required for wafer manufacturing.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司形成了以原子层沉积（ALD）技术为核心，化学气相沉积（CVD）等多种真空薄膜技术梯次发展的产品体系，专注于先进微米级、纳米级薄膜设备的研发、生产与销售，向下游半导体、泛半导体客户提供尖端薄膜设备、配套产品及服务。在半导体领域内，公司是国内首家成功将量产型 High-k 原子层沉积设备（ALD）应用于集成电路制造前道生产线的国产设备厂商，是国内首批成功开发并进入产业链核心厂商量产线的硬掩模化学气相沉积设备（CVD）国产厂商，也是行业内率先为新型存储提供薄膜沉积技术支持的设备厂商之一。目前公司已与国内多家厂商建立了深度合作关系，产品已广泛应用于逻辑、存储、 先进封装、化合物半导体、新型显示（硅基 OLED 等）等诸多细分应用领域，多项设备关键指标达到国际先进水平，能够满足国内客户当前技术的需求以及未来技术更迭的需要。产业链跟踪重点为：以ALD为核心提供薄膜沉积设备，覆盖半导体及泛半导体制造。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company has formed a product system with atomic layer deposition (ALD) technology as the core and chemical vapor deposition (CVD) and other vacuum thin film technologies developed in stages. It focuses on the research and development, production and sales of advanced micron-level and nano-level thin film equipment, and provides cutting-edge thin film equipment, supporting products and services to downstream semiconductor and pan-semiconductor customers. In the semiconductor field, the company is the first domestic equipment manufacturer to successfully apply mass-produced high-k atomic layer deposition equipment (ALD) to the front-end production line of integrated circuit manufacturing. It is also the first domestic domestic manufacturer of hard-mask chemical vapor deposition equipment (CVD) to successfully develop and enter the mass production line of a core manufacturer in the industry chain. It is also one of the first equipment manufacturers in the industry to provide thin film deposition technology support for new storage. At present, the company has established in-depth cooperative relationships with many domestic manufacturers. Its products have been widely used in many subdivided application fields such as logic, storage, advanced packaging, compound semiconductors, new displays (silicon-based OLED, etc.). Many key indicators of equipment have reached the international advanced level and can meet the current technology needs of domestic customers as well as the needs of future technology changes. The focus of industry chain tracking is: providing thin film deposition equipment with ALD as the core, covering semiconductor and pan-semiconductor manufacturing.

mappings.sourceDetail: 以ALD为核心提供薄膜沉积设备，覆盖半导体及泛半导体制造。
mappings.detailEn: We provide thin film deposition equipment with ALD as the core, covering semiconductor and pan-semiconductor manufacturing.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，主要产品及服务自成立以来，公司恪守中立的原则，通过公有云、私有云、混合云三种模式为用户提供服务。公司深耕客户需求，深入了解互联网、传媒、金融、制造等不同行业在不同场景下的业务需求，不断推出适合各行业特性的综合性云计算解决方案。公司私有云核心产品包括计算、存储、网络、容器等。公司私有云业务的主要客户为金融机构、大型央国企、电信运营商、政府机构及医疗教育等传统企业。目前，AstraFlow 已形成覆盖智能问答、文本分析、长文本摘要等多类场景的产品矩阵，通过统一控制台与标准化对外 API，开发者可灵活调用多尺寸、多模态大语言模型，实现从原型验证到生产部署的敏捷闭环。产业链跟踪重点为：中立第三方云服务商，提供GPU云与智算服务。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, since the establishment of main products and services, the company has adhered to the principle of neutrality and provided services to users through three models: public cloud, private cloud, and hybrid cloud. The company deeply explores customer needs, has a deep understanding of the business needs of different industries such as the Internet, media, finance, and manufacturing in different scenarios, and continuously launches comprehensive cloud computing solutions that suit the characteristics of each industry. The company's core private cloud products include computing, storage, network, containers, etc. The main customers of the company's private cloud business are financial institutions, large state-owned enterprises, telecommunications operators, government agencies, medical education and other traditional enterprises. At present, AstraFlow has formed a product matrix covering multiple scenarios such as intelligent question answering, text analysis, and long text summarization. Through a unified console and standardized external API, developers can flexibly call multi-size and multi-modal large language models to achieve an agile closed-loop from prototype verification to production deployment. The focus of industry chain tracking is: neutral third-party cloud service providers, providing GPU cloud and intelligent computing services.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司经营乌兰察布等数据中心基础设施及交付服务；同时布局青浦自建项目，支持云及智算服务。
mappings.detailEn: The company operates data center infrastructure and delivery services such as Ulanqab; it also deploys self-built projects in Qingpu to support cloud and intelligent computing services.

mappings.sourceDetail: 中立第三方云服务商，提供GPU云与智算服务。
mappings.detailEn: A neutral third-party cloud service provider that provides GPU cloud and intelligent computing services.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司云产品覆盖GPU计算及推理等资源服务，面向客户提供可使用的计算资源。
mappings.detailEn: The company's cloud products cover resource services such as GPU computing and inference, providing customers with usable computing resources.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司自 1985 年成立以来始终专注于各类印制电路板的研发、生产与销售业务。公司印制电路板产品定位于中高端应用市场，具有高精度、高密度和高可靠性等特点，产品按照应用领域划分主要包括计算机/服务器板、通信网络设备板、汽车电子板、消费电子板、工控医疗板及其他板等。作为电子产品生产制造的关键环节，公司通过不断提升技术水平和扩大产能，使产品质量和技术能力不断满足下游客户电子产品的需求与变化。公司具体的经营模式如下： 1、盈利模式公司主要通过核心技术和不断提升的产能为客户提供定制化PCB产品来获取合理利润，即采购覆铜板、半固化片、金盐、铜球、铜箔、干膜和油墨等原材料和相关辅料，使用最优的生产流程及工艺设计，利用公司的核心技术、产能生产出符合客户要求的PCB产品，销售给境内外客户。产业链跟踪重点为：高多层PCB供应商，产品覆盖AI服务器、交换机及通信网络设备。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company has been focusing on the research and development, production and sales of various types of printed circuit boards since its establishment in 1985. The company's printed circuit board products are positioned in the mid-to-high-end application market and have the characteristics of high precision, high density and high reliability. The products are divided according to application fields and mainly include computer/server boards, communication network equipment boards, automotive electronic boards, consumer electronics boards, industrial control medical boards and other boards. As a key link in the production and manufacturing of electronic products, the company continuously improves its technical level and expands its production capacity to enable product quality and technical capabilities to continuously meet the needs and changes of downstream customers' electronic products. The company's specific business model is as follows: 1. Profit model The company mainly provides customers with customized PCB products through core technology and increasing production capacity to obtain reasonable profits, that is, purchasing raw materials and related auxiliary materials such as copper clad laminates, prepregs, gold salts, copper balls, copper foil, dry films and inks, using the optimal production process and process design, and utilizing the company's core technology and production capacity to produce PCB products that meet customer requirements and sell them to domestic and foreign customers. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: high-end multi-layer PCB suppliers, whose products cover AI servers, switches and communication network equipment.

mappings.sourceDetail: 高多层PCB供应商，产品覆盖AI服务器、交换机及通信网络设备。
mappings.detailEn: A high-end multi-layer PCB supplier whose products cover AI servers, switches and communication network equipment.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司所处的行业地位分析及其变化情况公司的主要业务处于光通信、光纤激光产业链上游，公司基于核心技术开发的精密光学元组件、光纤器件产品已在光通信以及光纤激光等领域得到了产业化应用，助力我国光电子元器件国产化的进程。在光通信领域，公司的精密光学元组件和光纤器件应用于光收发模块、动态可调模块（如 WSS 模块）、OCS 光交换机等各类光模块与子系统，最终应用于电信网络、数据中心、AI 智算中心等新型信息基础设施，助力光通信系统向更高传输速率和更大带宽容量发展，支撑 5G 通信、全光网络、云计算和 AI 算力技术的迭代升级。在光纤激光领域，公司生产的精密光学元组件以及镀膜光纤器件、准直器、声光器件等光纤器件产品，已应用于光纤激光器的量产。公司与下游行业的知名厂商均建立了合作关系，公司的数据中心高速光模块用 CWDM 滤光片、应用于 WSS 模块/OCS 光交换机的光学元组件、非球透镜、高功率镀膜光纤线等产品，在细分领域具有较高的市场影响力。产业链跟踪重点为：精密光学元组件供应商，产品及研发覆盖光通信、光引擎和光连接。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's industry position analysis and changes are as follows. The company's main business is in the upstream of the optical communications and fiber laser industry chain. The company's precision optical components and fiber optic device products developed based on core technologies have been industrialized in the fields of optical communications and fiber lasers, assisting the localization of my country's optoelectronic components. In the field of optical communications, the company's precision optical components and optical fiber devices are used in various optical modules and subsystems such as optical transceiver modules, dynamically adjustable modules (such as WSS modules), and OCS optical switches. They are ultimately used in new information infrastructure such as telecommunications networks, data centers, and AI intelligent computing centers, helping optical communication systems develop towards higher transmission rates and larger bandwidth capacities, and supporting the iterative upgrades of 5G communications, all-optical networks, cloud computing, and AI computing power technologies. In the field of fiber lasers, the company's precision optical components and fiber device products such as coated fiber devices, collimators, and acousto-optical devices have been used in the mass production of fiber lasers. The company has established cooperative relationships with well-known manufacturers in the downstream industry. The company's CWDM filters for high-speed optical modules in data centers, optical components used in WSS modules/OCS optical switches, aspheric lenses, high-power coated optical fiber lines and other products have high market influence in segmented fields. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: suppliers of precision optical components, whose products and R&D cover optical communications, optical engines and optical connections.

mappings.sourceDetail: 精密光学元组件供应商，产品及研发覆盖光通信、光引擎和光连接。
mappings.detailEn: A supplier of precision optical components, its products and R&D cover optical communications, optical engines and optical connections.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主营业务为半导体自动化测试系统的研发、生产和销售。产品主要用于模拟、数模混合、 分立器件和功率模块等集成电路的测试，销售区域覆盖中国大陆、中国台湾、美国、欧洲、日本、 韩国、东南亚和印度等全球半导体产业发达的国家和地区。目前，公司已成长为国内领先、全球知名的半导体测试系统本土供应商，也是为数不多向国内外知名芯片设计公司、晶圆厂、IDM 和封测厂商供应半导体测试设备的中国企业。产业链跟踪重点为：半导体自动化测试系统供应商，覆盖模拟、数模混合、功率与SoC芯片。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business is the research and development, production and sales of semiconductor automated test systems. The products are mainly used for testing integrated circuits such as analog, digital-analog hybrid, discrete devices and power modules. The sales area covers mainland China, Taiwan, the United States, Europe, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia and India and other countries and regions with developed global semiconductor industries. At present, the company has grown into a leading domestic and globally renowned local supplier of semiconductor testing systems. It is also one of the few Chinese companies that supplies semiconductor testing equipment to well-known chip design companies, wafer fabs, IDMs and packaging and testing manufacturers at home and abroad. The focus of industry chain tracking is: semiconductor automated test system suppliers, covering analog, digital-analog hybrid, power and SoC chips.

mappings.sourceDetail: 半导体自动化测试系统供应商，覆盖模拟、数模混合、功率与SoC芯片。
mappings.detailEn: Semiconductor automated test system supplier, covering analog, digital-analog hybrid, power and SoC chips.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司是一家植根中国本土市场的半导体材料和零部件公司，致力于中国集成电路制造核心工艺材料和零部件的国产化建设。公司的硅零部件产品，由大直径硅材料加工而成，其终端主要应用于存储芯片制造厂的等离子刻蚀工艺中，是需要定期更换的核心耗材。公司已在国产半导体供应链中占据了有利位置，受益于下游客户的国产化突破，硅零部件占公司总营收的比重已超过大直径硅材料，第二增长曲线进一步强化。报告期内，公司大直径硅材料产品生产情况稳定，产品结构继续优化升级，利润率较高的 16 英寸以上产品收入占比进一步提升，从 2024 年度的 51.61%提升至 2025 年度的 56.72%，毛利率为 76.09%，对该业务的整体毛利率水平提高有较大贡献。公司是具备“从晶体生长到硅零部件成品” 完整制造能力的一体化厂商，拥有全球领先的大直径硅材料晶体制造技术，是等离子刻蚀机设备厂家所需硅零部件产品的上游材料供应商。产业链跟踪重点为：集成电路刻蚀用单晶硅材料全球市场份额约13%至15%。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is a semiconductor materials and components company rooted in China's local market and is committed to the localization of core process materials and components for China's integrated circuit manufacturing. The company's silicon component products are processed from large-diameter silicon materials. Its terminals are mainly used in the plasma etching process of memory chip manufacturing plants and are core consumables that need to be replaced regularly. The company has occupied a favorable position in the domestic semiconductor supply chain. Thanks to the localization breakthroughs of downstream customers, the proportion of silicon components in the company's total revenue has exceeded that of large-diameter silicon materials, and the second growth curve has been further strengthened. During the reporting period, the company's production of large-diameter silicon material products was stable, the product structure continued to be optimized and upgraded, and the revenue share of products above 16 inches with higher profit margins further increased, from 51.61% in 2024 to 56.72% in 2025, with a gross profit margin of 76.09%, which contributed significantly to the improvement of the overall gross profit margin level of the business. The company is an integrated manufacturer with complete manufacturing capabilities "from crystal growth to finished silicon components". It has the world's leading large-diameter silicon material crystal manufacturing technology and is an upstream material supplier of silicon component products required by plasma etching machine equipment manufacturers. The focus of industry chain tracking is: the global market share of monocrystalline silicon materials for integrated circuit etching is approximately 13% to 15%.

mappings.sourceDetail: 公司硅零部件包括用于刻蚀等设备的硅电极和硅环，已形成产品供应。
mappings.detailEn: The company's silicon components include silicon electrodes and silicon rings used in etching and other equipment, and have formed a product supply.

mappings.sourceDetail: 集成电路刻蚀用单晶硅材料全球市场份额约13%至15%。
mappings.detailEn: The global market share of monocrystalline silicon materials for integrated circuit etching is approximately 13% to 15%.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司自成立以来一直专注于人工智能芯片产品的研发与技术创新，致力于打造人工智能领域的核心处理器芯片，让机器更好地理解和服务人类。公司的主营业务是应用于各类云服务器、边缘计算设备、终端设备中人工智能核心芯片的研发、设计和销售。目前，公司的主要产品线包括云端产品线、边缘产品线、IP 授权及软件。公司的智能整机是由公司自研云端智能芯片及板卡提供核心计算能力的服务器整机产品。产业链跟踪重点为：国产AI训练与推理芯片平台，覆盖云端与边缘端算力。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company has been focusing on the research and development and technological innovation of artificial intelligence chip products since its establishment, and is committed to building core processor chips in the field of artificial intelligence so that machines can better understand and serve humans. The company's main business is the R&D, design and sales of artificial intelligence core chips used in various cloud servers, edge computing equipment, and terminal equipment. Currently, the company's main product lines include cloud product lines, edge product lines, IP licensing and software. The company's smart machine is a complete server product that provides core computing capabilities with the company's self-developed cloud smart chips and boards. The focus of industry chain tracking is: domestic AI training and inference chip platforms, covering cloud and edge computing power.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国产AI训练与推理芯片平台，覆盖云端与边缘端算力。
mappings.detailEn: Domestic AI training and inference chip platform, covering cloud and edge computing power.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司提供的主要产品和服务情况如下： 类别主要产品简介主要产品应用场景特种气体公司的特种气体主要面向集成电路、新型显示面板、光伏新能源、光纤光缆等半导体行业、食品和医疗等行业。公司的电子特种气体产品在电子领域实现了包括高纯四氟化碳、高纯六氟乙烷、稀混光刻气、 高纯二氧化碳、高纯一氧化碳、高纯氨、 高纯一氧化氮、高纯三氟甲烷、高纯八氟丙烷、锗烷、高纯乙烯、高纯甲烷、 高纯全氟丁二烯、溴化氢、三氯化硼等众多产品的进口替代。公司持续专注于特种气体的研发，尤其是以半导体材料为核心的高端产品研发为主，主攻薄膜工艺相关产品，包括介电层和金属刻蚀、介电层沉积、 钛或钨等金属沉积、非硅材料沉积、热扩散和离子注入、反应室清洁，以及其他先进应用的产品。产业链跟踪重点为：多类电子特气国内份额超过10%，部分产品份额达到20%至60%。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the main products and services provided by the company are as follows: Category Main product introduction Main product application scenarios Special gases The company's special gases are mainly targeted at integrated circuits, new display panels, photovoltaic new energy, optical fiber cables and other semiconductor industries, food and medical industries. The company's electronic specialty gas products in the electronics field include high-purity tetrafluorocarbon, high-purity hexafluoroethane, dilute-mixed photolithography gas, high-purity carbon dioxide, high-purity carbon monoxide, high-purity ammonia, high-purity nitric oxide, high-purity trifluoromethane, high-purity octafluoropropane, germane, high-purity ethylene, high-purity methane, high-purity perfluorobutadiene, hydrogen bromide, boron trichloride and many other products. The company continues to focus on the research and development of special gases, especially the research and development of high-end products with semiconductor materials as the core. It focuses on thin film process-related products, including dielectric layer and metal etching, dielectric layer deposition, metal deposition such as titanium or tungsten, non-silicon material deposition, thermal diffusion and ion implantation, reaction chamber cleaning, and other advanced application products. The focus of industry chain tracking is: the domestic share of many types of electronic specialties exceeds 10%, and the share of some products reaches 20% to 60%.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主营产品包括：PLC、AWG、OSW、VOA 等无源芯片系列产品；AWG、MT-FA、FAU 等无源光组件系列产品；AWG、WDM、VMUX 等无源智能模块系列产品；FP、DFB、EML 等有源激光器芯片系列产品；1-3456 芯室内软光缆系列产品；MPO、MMC 等高速连接跳线系列产品；高分子线缆材料等系列产品。产业链跟踪重点为：国内光芯片厂商中的公开市场份额约9%，覆盖PLC、AWG及DFB激光器芯片。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main products include: PLC, AWG, OSW, VOA and other passive chip series products; AWG, MT-FA, FAU and other passive optical component series products; AWG, WDM, VMUX and other passive intelligent module series products; FP, DFB, EML and other active laser chip series products; 1-3456 core indoor soft optical cable series products; MPO, MMC and other high-speed connection jumper series products; polymer cable materials and other series products. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: the open market share of domestic optical chip manufacturers is about 9%, covering PLC, AWG and DFB laser chips.
