mappings.detailEn: The open market share among domestic optical chip manufacturers is about 9%, covering PLC, AWG and DFB laser chips.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要产品情况报告期内，公司专注于高端半导体质量控制领域，主要产品涵盖设备产品、智能软件产品和相关服务的全流程良率管理解决方案。在精密加工领域，量测设备主要功能是精密结构件的三维尺寸量测，具体情况如下： 产品名称图示产品性能三维形貌量测设备系列主要应用于晶圆上纳米级三维形貌测量、线宽测量和 TSV 孔测量，配合图形晶圆智能化特征识别和流程控制、晶圆传片和数据通讯等自动化平台。产业链跟踪重点为：提供晶圆缺陷检测及量测设备，服务前道制程和先进封装质量控制。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main products during the reporting period, the company focused on the field of high-end semiconductor quality control, and its main products cover full-process yield management solutions for equipment products, intelligent software products and related services. In the field of precision processing, the main function of measuring equipment is the three-dimensional dimension measurement of precision structural parts. The details are as follows: Product name Illustration Product performance The three-dimensional topography measurement equipment series is mainly used in nano-level three-dimensional topography measurement, line width measurement and TSV hole measurement on wafers, and cooperates with automated platforms such as intelligent feature recognition and process control of graphic wafers, wafer transfer and data communication. The focus of industry chain tracking is: providing wafer defect detection and measurement equipment, serving front-end processes and advanced packaging quality control.

mappings.sourceDetail: 提供晶圆缺陷检测及量测设备，服务前道制程和先进封装质量控制。
mappings.detailEn: Provides wafer defect detection and measurement equipment to serve front-end processes and advanced packaging quality control.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，作为半导体及显示行业制造领域的关键材料，公司掩膜版产品是下游客户光刻工艺图形转移的刚需母版，光刻机/曝光机通过对掩膜版曝光，将掩膜版上的图案转移到下游基板材料（硅片、 玻璃基板、有机基板等）上，掩膜版自身的品质状况直接影响终端产品的品质和良率。在显示领域，公司是国内唯一一家可以全面配套不同世代面板产线（G2.5-G11）的本土掩膜版企业，实现全显示技术覆盖（LCD、AMOLED、LTPS、LTPO、Mini-LED、Micro-LED、硅基 OLED、FMM 用掩膜版等）； 近年来，公司紧跟下游平板显示行业的技术前沿和发展动态，坚持研发攻关和技术创新，持续突破平板显示掩膜版关键技术，率先在国内突破高精度半色调掩膜版等尖端制造技术，并针对上游原材料“卡脖子”问题，攻克了光阻涂布等多项产业链上游核心技术。产业链跟踪重点为：掩膜版厂商，半导体产品覆盖成熟制程及封装器件光刻需求。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, as a key material in the manufacturing field of the semiconductor and display industry, the company's mask product is the indispensable master for downstream customers' photolithography process pattern transfer. The lithography machine/exposure machine transfers the pattern on the mask to downstream substrate materials (silicon wafers, glass substrates, organic substrates, etc.) by exposing the mask. The quality of the mask itself directly affects the quality and yield of the end product. In the display field, the company is the only local mask company in China that can fully support different generations of panel production lines (G2.5-G11), achieving full display technology coverage (LCD, AMOLED, LTPS, LTPO, Mini-LED, Micro-LED, silicon-based OLED, masks for FMM, etc.); In recent years, the company has closely followed the technological frontiers and development dynamics of the downstream flat panel display industry, persisted in R&D and technological innovation, and continued to break through key flat panel display mask technologies. It was the first in the country to break through cutting-edge manufacturing technologies such as high-precision halftone masks. In response to the "stuck neck" problem of upstream raw materials, it has conquered many upstream core technologies in the industry chain such as photoresist coating. The focus of industry chain tracking is: mask manufacturers, semiconductor products covering mature processes and packaging device lithography needs.

mappings.sourceDetail: 掩膜版厂商，半导体产品覆盖成熟制程及封装器件光刻需求。
mappings.detailEn: Mask manufacturer, semiconductor products cover mature process and packaging device lithography needs.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司现有主营产品包括 NOR Flash 存储芯片、基于 Arm® Cortex®-M0+内核架构的通用 32 位 MCU 芯片、大容量存储产品业务和 AI 芯片业务（通用 AI SoC 芯片、AI 算法模型和 AI 模组板卡）。主要产品 （1）NOR Flash 存储芯片公司 NOR Flash 产品在制程、电压、功耗、频率、工作温度及产品稳定性等方面均处于行业主流水平，部分产品技术水平达到行业先进水平。公司自主研发的 NOR Flash 产品，采用高速串行外设接口（SPI）技术，具备高可靠性、低功耗特性、良好的兼容性和成本效益等特点。报告期内，公司同步推进基于 M0+内核的电机控制 MCU 产品 ZB32M013、ZB32M033 的市场推广，公司研发团队完成新一代核心 IP 模块的优化与验证，持续加强在低功耗设计、电机控制融合及多场景适配等关键技术领域的研发。产业链跟踪重点为：NOR Flash及MCU设计厂商，补充端侧系统代码存储环节。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's existing main products include NOR Flash memory chips, general-purpose 32-bit MCU chips based on the Arm® Cortex®-M0+ core architecture, large-capacity storage product business and AI chip business (general-purpose AI SoC chips, AI algorithm models and AI module boards). Main products (1) NOR Flash memory chip company NOR Flash products are at the mainstream level in the industry in terms of process, voltage, power consumption, frequency, operating temperature and product stability, and the technical level of some products has reached the industry's advanced level. The company's independently developed NOR Flash products use high-speed serial peripheral interface (SPI) technology and feature high reliability, low power consumption, good compatibility and cost-effectiveness. During the reporting period, the company simultaneously promoted the market promotion of motor control MCU products ZB32M013 and ZB32M033 based on the M0+ core. The company's R&D team completed the optimization and verification of the new generation core IP module and continued to strengthen research and development in key technical fields such as low-power design, motor control integration and multi-scenario adaptation. The focus of industry chain tracking is: NOR Flash and MCU design manufacturers, supplementing the end-side system code storage link.

mappings.sourceDetail: NOR Flash及MCU设计厂商，补充端侧系统代码存储环节。
mappings.detailEn: NOR Flash and MCU design manufacturers supplement the end-side system code storage link.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司聚焦于光芯片行业，主营业务为光芯片的研发、设计、生产与销售，目前公司的主要产品为光芯片，主要应用于电信市场、数据中心市场、车载激光雷达市场等领域。在光通信领域中，公司主要产品包括 2.5G、10G、25G、50G、 100G、200G 以及更高速率的 DFB、EML 激光器系列产品和 50mW、70mW、100mW 等大功率硅光光源产品，主要应用于光纤接入、4G/5G 移动通信网络和数据中心等领域。在车载激光雷达领域，公司产品涵盖 1550 波段车载激光雷达激光器芯片等产品。产业链跟踪重点为：国内光芯片公开市场份额约7%，并在高速激光器芯片领域持续扩展。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company focuses on the optical chip industry, and its main business is the research and development, design, production and sales of optical chips. Currently, the company's main products are optical chips, which are mainly used in the telecommunications market, data center market, automotive lidar market and other fields. In the field of optical communications, the company's main products include 2.5G, 10G, 25G, 50G, 100G, 200G and higher-speed DFB, EML laser series products and 50mW, 70mW, 100mW and other high-power silicon optical light source products, which are mainly used in optical fiber access, 4G/5G mobile communication networks and data centers. In the field of vehicle-mounted lidar, the company's products cover 1550-band vehicle-mounted lidar laser chips and other products. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: the domestic optical chip open market share is about 7%, and continues to expand in the field of high-speed laser chips.

mappings.sourceDetail: 国内光芯片公开市场份额约7%，并在高速激光器芯片领域持续扩展。
mappings.detailEn: The open market share of domestic optical chips is about 7%, and it continues to expand in the field of high-speed laser chips.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，覆铜板是制作印制电路板的核心材料，印制电路板是电子元器件电气连接的载体。覆铜板及印制电路板是现代电子信息产品中不可或缺的重要部件，被广泛应用于消费电子、计算机、通讯、数据中心、 汽车电子、航空航天和工业控制等终端领域。主要产品及服务情况公司主要产品为覆铜板及粘结片，具体如下： （1）覆铜板覆铜板（Copper Clad Laminate，简称 CCL）全称为覆铜箔层压板，是将增强材料浸以树脂胶液，一面或两面覆以铜箔，经热压而成的一种板状材料，是制作印制电路板的核心材料。覆铜板和粘结片的关系下游多层板或 HDI 客户向覆铜板厂商采购覆铜板的同时，往往需要配套采购同厂商同规格的粘结片产品，用其作为多层板或 HDI 层与层之间的粘结和绝缘材料。产业链跟踪重点为：覆铜板及粘结片供应商，覆盖高速传输和IC封装基材。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, copper-clad laminate is the core material for making printed circuit boards, which are the carrier for electrical connections of electronic components. Copper clad laminates and printed circuit boards are indispensable and important components in modern electronic information products. They are widely used in terminal fields such as consumer electronics, computers, communications, data centers, automotive electronics, aerospace and industrial control. Main products and services The company's main products are copper-clad laminates and adhesive sheets, as follows: (1) Copper Clad Laminate (CCL), the full name of copper-clad laminate, is a plate-shaped material made by soaking reinforcing materials in resin glue, covering one or both sides with copper foil, and hot pressing. It is the core material for making printed circuit boards. The relationship between copper clad laminates and adhesive sheets. When downstream multilayer board or HDI customers purchase copper clad laminates from copper clad laminate manufacturers, they often need to purchase adhesive sheet products of the same specifications from the same manufacturer to use them as bonding and insulating materials between layers of multilayer boards or HDI. The focus of industry chain tracking is: copper clad laminate and adhesive sheet suppliers, covering high-speed transmission and IC packaging substrates.

mappings.sourceDetail: 覆铜板及粘结片供应商，覆盖高速传输和IC封装基材。
mappings.detailEn: Supplier of copper clad laminates and adhesive sheets, covering high-speed transmission and IC packaging substrates.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司拥有自主可控的图形处理器 IP（GPU IP）、神经网络处理器 IP（NPU IP）、视频处理器 IP（VPU IP）、数字信号处理器 IP（DSP IP）、图像信号处理器 IP（ISP IP）和显示处理器 IP（Display Processing IP）这六类处理器 IP，以及 1,700 多个数模混合 IP、射频 IP 和接口 IP。公司还为客户提供软件开发平台、面向应用的软件解决方案、软件开发包、定制软件、软件维护与升级等服务，可大幅降低客户的研发周期和风险，帮助客户快速响应市场。公司还拥有数模混合 IP、射频 IP 和接口 IP 共计 1,700 多个。产业链跟踪重点为：提供GPU、AI处理器等半导体IP及芯片定制服务，连接AI芯片设计与量产。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company has six types of processor IP: independently controllable graphics processor IP (GPU IP), neural network processor IP (NPU IP), video processor IP (VPU IP), digital signal processor IP (DSP IP), image signal processor IP (ISP IP) and display processor IP (Display Processing IP), as well as more than 1,700 digital-analog hybrid IP, radio frequency IP and interface IP. The company also provides customers with software development platforms, application-oriented software solutions, software development kits, customized software, software maintenance and upgrades and other services, which can significantly reduce customers' R&D cycles and risks and help customers quickly respond to the market. The company also has more than 1,700 digital-analog hybrid IP, radio frequency IP and interface IP. The focus of industry chain tracking is: providing GPU, AI processor and other semiconductor IP and chip customization services, and connecting AI chip design and mass production.

mappings.sourceDetail: 提供GPU、AI处理器等半导体IP及芯片定制服务，连接AI芯片设计与量产。
mappings.detailEn: Provides semiconductor IP and chip customization services for GPUs, AI processors, etc., connecting AI chip design and mass production.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，主要产品或服务万物互联时代，数据呈指数级增长，海量数据需要存储，存储形式也更加多元化。公司紧随存储器大容量、大带宽、低延时、低功耗、高安全、小尺寸等升级方向，在智能移动及 AI 新兴端侧、PC 及企业级、智能汽车及其它应用等领域持续创新，打造了全系列、差异化的产品体系及服务，主要产品及服务为半导体存储解决方案和先进封测服务，其中半导体存储解决方案分为 DRAM 解决方案（如 LPDDR 及 DDR）、NAND Flash 解决方案（如 eMMC、UFS 及 SSD）以及多芯片封装(MCP)解决方案（如 uMCP、eMCP 及 ePOP）。公司已小批量出货封装尺寸为 8.26*12.4（mm）的紧凑型 FBGA245 LPDDR5X 产品，能够最大限度减少 PCB 占用空间，为更轻薄的终端提供更大的设计灵活性，支持 48Gb 至 128Gb 的多容量配置，能够满足多样化数据需求。产业链跟踪重点为：存储解决方案厂商，积极布局先进封装与AI端侧存储。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, major products or services In the era of the Internet of Everything, data is growing exponentially, massive data needs to be stored, and storage forms are becoming more diversified. The company follows the memory upgrade directions of large capacity, large bandwidth, low latency, low power consumption, high security, and small size, and continues to innovate in the fields of smart mobile and AI emerging end-side, PC and enterprise level, smart cars and other applications, creating a full range of differentiated product systems and services. The main products and services are semiconductor storage solutions and advanced packaging and testing services. Semiconductor storage solutions are divided into DRAM solutions (such as LPDDR and DDR), NAND Flash solutions (such as eMMC, UFS and SSD) and multi-chip package (MCP) solutions (such as uMCP, eMCP and ePOP). The company has shipped in small batches compact FBGA245 LPDDR5X products with a package size of 8.26*12.4 (mm), which can minimize PCB footprint, provide greater design flexibility for thinner and lighter terminals, support multi-capacity configurations from 48Gb to 128Gb, ​​and can meet diverse data needs. The focus of industry chain tracking is: storage solution manufacturers, actively deploying advanced packaging and AI end-side storage.

mappings.sourceDetail: 存储解决方案厂商，积极布局先进封装与AI端侧存储。
mappings.detailEn: Storage solution manufacturers are actively deploying advanced packaging and AI end-side storage.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司主要从事半导体专用设备的研发、生产和销售，主营产品包括半导体专用温控设备 （Chiller）、半导体专用工艺废气处理设备（LocalScrubber）和晶圆传片设备（Sorter）。在逻辑芯片领域，28nm 以下为业内先进制程，公司产品已经适配国内最先进的逻辑芯片制造产线；在 3DNAND 存储芯片领域，128 层以上（含 128 层）为业内先进制程，公司产品已经适配国内最先进的存储芯片制造产线。产业链跟踪重点为：半导体专用工艺废气处理设备国内市场份额已超过15%，并布局温控与传片设备。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is mainly engaged in the research and development, production and sales of semiconductor-specific equipment. Its main products include semiconductor-specific temperature control equipment (Chiller), semiconductor-specific process waste gas treatment equipment (LocalScrubber) and wafer transfer equipment (Sorter). In the field of logic chips, 28nm and below are advanced processes in the industry, and the company's products have been adapted to the most advanced logic chip manufacturing lines in the country; in the field of 3D NAND memory chips, 128 layers and above (including 128 layers) are advanced processes in the industry, and the company's products have been adapted to the most advanced memory chip manufacturing lines in the country. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: the domestic market share of semiconductor-specific process waste gas treatment equipment has exceeded 15%, and the layout of temperature control and film transfer equipment.

mappings.sourceDetail: 半导体专用工艺废气处理设备国内市场份额已超过15%，并布局温控与传片设备。
mappings.detailEn: The domestic market share of semiconductor-specific process waste gas treatment equipment has exceeded 15%, and temperature control and film transfer equipment have been deployed.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司研发、生产高速通信连接器及组件和汽车连接器及组件。通信产品包括高速背板连接器、I/O连接器、高速铜缆连接器、精密壳体、散热器和液冷散热器，最终应用于服务器、数据中心和通信基站；报告期内112G系列需求增长，224G系列开始量产。汽车产品主要服务新能源汽车电控、电池和高压连接场景。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company develops and produces high-speed communication connectors and components and automotive connectors and components. Communication products include high-speed backplane connectors, I/O connectors, high-speed copper cable connectors, precision housings, radiators and liquid cooling radiators, which are ultimately used in servers, data centers and communication base stations; during the reporting period, demand for the 112G series increased, and the 224G series began mass production. Automotive products mainly serve new energy vehicle electronic control, battery and high-voltage connection scenarios.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司在国内具备先发优势和市场引领地位，产品覆盖从接入层到核心层的以太网交换产品，为我国数字化网络建设提供了丰富的芯片解决方案。主要产品情况公司主要产品包括以太网交换芯片及配套产品。公司主要产品具体情况如下： （1）以太网交换芯片及模组公司以太网交换芯片和芯片模组致力于在企业网络、运营商网络、数据中心网络和工业网络的部署和应用，经过多年行业的深耕和积累，公司现已形成丰富的以太网交换芯片产品序列，覆盖从接入层到核心层的以太网交换产品。公司全系列以太网交换芯片具备高性能、灵活性、高安全、可视化的产品优势，充分融合企业网络、运营商网络、数据中心网络和工业网络各应用领域的增强特性，具备全面的二层转发、三层路由、可视化、安全互联等丰富的特性。公司目前产品主要定位中高端产品线，产品覆盖 100Gbps-25.6Tbps 交换容量及 100M-800G 的端口速率，全面覆盖企业网络、运营商网络、数据中心网络和工业网络等应用领域。产业链跟踪重点为：国产以太网交换芯片厂商，聚焦数据中心和运营商网络。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company has first-mover advantages and market leadership in China. Its products cover Ethernet switching products from the access layer to the core layer, providing a wealth of chip solutions for my country's digital network construction. Main products: The company's main products include Ethernet switching chips and supporting products. The details of the company's main products are as follows: (1) Ethernet switching chips and modules The company's Ethernet switching chips and chip modules are committed to the deployment and application of enterprise networks, operator networks, data center networks and industrial networks. After years of deep cultivation and accumulation in the industry, the company has now formed a rich series of Ethernet switching chip products, covering Ethernet switching products from the access layer to the core layer. The company's full range of Ethernet switching chips has the product advantages of high performance, flexibility, high security, and visualization. It fully integrates enhanced features in various application fields of enterprise networks, carrier networks, data center networks, and industrial networks. It has comprehensive layer 2 forwarding, layer 3 routing, visualization, secure interconnection and other rich features. The company's current products are mainly positioned in the mid-to-high-end product line. The products cover switching capacities of 100Gbps-25.6Tbps and port rates of 100M-800G, fully covering application fields such as enterprise networks, carrier networks, data center networks, and industrial networks. The focus of industry chain tracking is: domestic Ethernet switching chip manufacturers, focusing on data centers and operator networks.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司依靠自主研发的核心技术，致力于为集成电路制造环节提供更先进处理能力和更高生产效率的集成电路设备。公司主要设备相关技术达到国际领先水平，干法去胶设备、快速热处理设备已应用在多家国内外知名集成电路制造商生产线上并实现大规模装机，干法刻蚀及等离子体表面处理设备已应用在多家国内外知名集成电路制造商生产线上，销售收入持续快速增长。主要产品公司目前主要产品情况如下： 产品系列图示应用领域干法去胶设备 Suprema®系列干法去胶设备主要用于集成电路芯片制造、芯片封装、微机电系统 （MEMS）等领域，用于去除光刻后残余光刻胶，刻蚀后表面清洁、残留物清除、 硬掩膜层干法清除等多种干法去胶和干法清除工艺。产业链跟踪重点为：快速热处理设备全球市场份额13.05%，国内去胶设备公开招标样本份额超过80%。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company relies on independently developed core technologies and is committed to providing integrated circuit equipment with more advanced processing capabilities and higher production efficiency for the integrated circuit manufacturing process. The company's main equipment-related technologies have reached the international leading level. Dry degumming equipment and rapid heat treatment equipment have been applied to the production lines of many well-known domestic and foreign integrated circuit manufacturers and have been installed on a large scale. Dry etching and plasma surface treatment equipment have been applied to the production lines of many well-known domestic and foreign integrated circuit manufacturers. Sales revenue has continued to grow rapidly. Main products The company's current main products are as follows: Product series diagram Application fields Dry degumming equipment Suprema® series dry degluing equipment is mainly used in integrated circuit chip manufacturing, chip packaging, micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) and other fields. It is used to remove residual photoresist after photolithography, surface cleaning after etching, residue removal, hard mask layer dry removal and other dry degluing and dry cleaning processes. The focus of industry chain tracking is: the global market share of rapid heat treatment equipment is 13.05%, and the share of domestic public bidding samples for glue removal equipment exceeds 80%.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司的主营业务是非易失性存储器芯片及基于存储芯片的衍生芯片的设计与销售，致力于提供高性能、高可靠性芯片产品及解决方案，公司聚焦于存储器芯片及基于存储芯片的衍生芯片两大产品方向，目前主要产品包括：非易失性存储器芯片 NOR Flash、EEPROM 和 SLC NAND Flash 及其衍生产品 eMMC、MCP；微控制器芯片以及模拟产品。公司 NOR Flash 产品采用电荷俘获（SONOS）及浮栅（ETOX）工艺结构，提供了 512Kbit 到 1Gbit 容量的系列产品，覆盖 1.1V-3.6V 的操作电压区间，具备低功耗、高可靠性、快速擦除和快速读取的优异性能，公司 NOR Flash 产品应用领域集中在蓝牙、IOT、BLE、AMOLED、工业控制等相关市场。产业链跟踪重点为：NOR Flash全球排名前五，历史公开口径显示EEPROM市场份额超过5%。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company's main business is the design and sales of non-volatile memory chips and derivative chips based on memory chips. It is committed to providing high-performance, high-reliability chip products and solutions. The company focuses on the two product directions of memory chips and derivative chips based on memory chips. Its current main products include: non-volatile memory chips NOR Flash, EEPROM and SLC NAND Flash and their derivative products eMMC and MCP; microcontroller chips and analog products. The company's NOR Flash products adopt charge trapping (SONOS) and floating gate (ETOX) process structures, providing a series of products with capacities from 512Kbit to 1Gbit, covering the operating voltage range of 1.1V-3.6V, with excellent performance of low power consumption, high reliability, fast erasure and fast reading. The application fields of the company's NOR Flash products are concentrated in Bluetooth, IOT, BLE, AMOLED, industrial control and other related markets. The focus of industry chain tracking is: NOR Flash ranks among the top five in the world, and historical public records show that the EEPROM market share exceeds 5%.

mappings.sourceDetail: NOR Flash全球排名前五，历史公开口径显示EEPROM市场份额超过5%。
mappings.detailEn: NOR Flash ranks among the top five in the world, and historical public records show that the EEPROM market share exceeds 5%.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年招股书，公司专注于动态随机存取存储器（DRAM）的研发、设计、生产与销售，主要产品为DDR系列和LPDDR系列，包括面向服务器的RDIMM、面向台式机和工作站的UDIMM、面向笔记本电脑的SODIMM及LPCAMM，以及面向移动设备的LPDDR产品。公司还销售少量DRAM晶圆，并提供技术及研发服务、晶圆代工服务和配套光罩产品。产业链跟踪重点为：长鑫存储上市主体，国产DRAM龙头，具备存储芯片研发、设计、制造与销售一体化能力。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 prospectus, the company focuses on the research and development, design, production and sales of dynamic random access memories (DRAM). Its main products are DDR series and LPDDR series, including RDIMM for servers, UDIMM for desktops and workstations, SODIMM and LPCAMM for notebook computers, and LPDDR products for mobile devices. The company also sells a small amount of DRAM wafers and provides technology and R&D services, wafer foundry services and supporting photomask products. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: Changxin Memory is the main listed entity, the domestic DRAM leader, and has the ability to integrate memory chip R&D, design, manufacturing and sales.

mappings.detailEn: Changxin Memory is listed on the market and is the leader in domestic DRAM. It has the ability to integrate memory chip R&D, design, manufacturing and sales.

profiles.sourceSummary: 根据2025年年度报告，公司是一家以数据中心高效冷却技术为核心的数据中心基础设施产品供应商，主营业务为：浸没液冷数据中心基础设施产品、 冷板液冷数据中心基础设施产品及模块化数据中心产品的研究、 开发、 生产及销售，以及围绕上述产品提供系统集成和技术服务。公司于2026 年 4 月 14 日接到控股股东曙光信息产业 （北京） 有限公司 （以下简称“北京曙光信息”） 向公司出具的《关于中科曙光控制权发生变动的通知》，曙光信息产业股份有限公司（以下简称“中科曙光”）控制权状态变为无控股股东，无实际控制人。公司控股股东为北京曙光信息，北京曙光信息控股股东为中科曙光，因此，公司实际控制人变更为无实际控制人。公司经过多年市场化发展，拥有完善的法人治理结构，按照上市公司规范化运作，具有独立完整的经营能力，本次实际控制人变化事项不涉及股份变动，不涉及董事会构成变动，公司管理经营团队不会发生变化，不涉及对公司资产、人员、财务、机构及业务的完整性和独立性产生影响，不涉及对公司的生产经营和持续性发展产生不利影响，不存在损害公司利益的情形。产业链跟踪重点为：2024年中国算力中心液冷温控设备出货量占比55.7%，连续多年位居国内第一。
profiles.summaryEn: According to the 2025 annual report, the company is a data center infrastructure product supplier with high-efficiency data center cooling technology as its core. Its main business is: research, development, production and sales of immersed liquid-cooled data center infrastructure products, cold plate liquid-cooled data center infrastructure products and modular data center products, as well as providing system integration and technical services around the above products. On April 14, 2026, the company received the "Notice on Changes in the Control Rights of Sugon" issued to the company by the controlling shareholder Sugon Information Industry (Beijing) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Beijing Sugon"). The status of the control of Sugon Information Industry Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Sugon") changed to no controlling shareholder and no actual controller. The company's controlling shareholder is Beijing Shuguang Information, and the controlling shareholder of Beijing Shuguang Information is Zhongke Shuguang. Therefore, the company's actual controller has changed to no actual controller. After years of market-oriented development, the company has a complete legal person governance structure, operates in accordance with the standardized operations of listed companies, and has independent and complete operating capabilities. This change of actual controller does not involve changes in shares, does not involve changes in the composition of the board of directors, the company's management team will not change, does not involve an impact on the integrity and independence of the company's assets, personnel, finance, institutions and business, does not involve an adverse impact on the company's production, operation and sustainable development, and does not harm the company's interests. The focus of the industry chain tracking is: China’s computing power center’s liquid cooling temperature control equipment shipments will account for 55.7% in 2024, ranking first in the country for many consecutive years.

mappings.sourceDetail: 2024年中国算力中心液冷温控设备出货量占比55.7%，连续多年位居国内第一。
mappings.detailEn: In 2024, China’s computing power center’s liquid-cooled temperature control equipment shipments accounted for 55.7%, ranking first in the country for many consecutive years.
